nodes.gloss: This means insisting on one's own way, overriding others' objections, and making decisions alone without seeking or heeding the views of those who must carry them out.

nodes.label: automatic
nodes.gloss: This means answering reflexively, out of settled habit, with the first response that comes and no pause to weigh it or think it over.

nodes.label: automaton
nodes.gloss: This means carrying out each task by rote, following set routines without independent thought or feeling, and never stepping outside the programmed pattern to question or react.

nodes.label: autonomous
nodes.gloss: This means governing oneself and making one's own decisions without deferring to others.

nodes.label: avaricious
nodes.gloss: This means always wanting more money and possessions, measuring one's worth by what one holds and grasping for further gain whenever the chance arises.

nodes.label: avenging
nodes.gloss: This means pursuing revenge for a wrong done to oneself or to someone else, and keeping that debt in mind until it is settled.

nodes.label: average
nodes.gloss: This means turning out work of plain, middling quality and accepting that one's abilities and results sit squarely in the ordinary range.

nodes.label: averse
nodes.gloss: This means holding back from new undertakings, experiences and commitments as a settled habit, feeling disinclined toward most things before one has even weighed them.

nodes.label: averse to change
nodes.gloss: This means resisting new methods, routines and arrangements, and preferring to keep things as they are even when someone argues that a change would help.

nodes.label: averse to closeness
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding emotional intimacy, keeping others at arm's length, deflecting personal questions, and pulling back whenever a relationship starts to grow close or asks for vulnerability.

nodes.label: averse to physical contact
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's distance from others physically, declining hugs and handshakes, and feeling uneasy whenever someone else's hands make contact with one's body.

nodes.label: averse to touch
nodes.gloss: This means keeping others at arm's length physically, finding handshakes, hugs and casual touches unwelcome and pulling away from them whenever they come.

nodes.label: avid reader
nodes.gloss: This means reading a great deal and reaching eagerly for the next book, with books filling most of one's free time and spare moments.

nodes.label: avoiding
nodes.gloss: This means dodging direct questions with vague answers and steering away from conversations or contact with others, keeping people at a distance whenever one can.

nodes.label: avoids being a bother
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's requests small and one's presence unobtrusive, working around others' schedules and needs so that one never takes up more of their time or attention than necessary.

nodes.label: avoids certain people
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's distance from certain people as a settled habit, steering clear of them in everyday life rather than confronting them or working through the friction.

nodes.label: avoids crowds
nodes.gloss: This means keeping well away from large gatherings of people as a settled habit, choosing quieter places and smaller company whenever the choice is one's own to make.

nodes.label: avoids danger
nodes.gloss: This means keeping well clear of risk, weighing every possible harm before acting and choosing the safer path even when it costs speed, reward or convenience.

nodes.label: avoids difficult reading
nodes.gloss: This means putting down hard or dense texts early and turning to lighter material, rather than working through difficult passages that demand slow, effortful reading.

nodes.label: avoids dominating others
nodes.gloss: This means leaving others room to make their own choices, offering a view without pressing it, and never reaching for control or the upper hand in any exchange.

nodes.label: avoids looking at self
nodes.gloss: This means turning away from one's own motives, feelings and faults, and leaving them unexamined rather than looking inward to question why one thinks or acts as one does.

nodes.label: avoids sensitive topics
nodes.gloss: This means steering conversations away from delicate or controversial subjects, changing the topic whenever a discussion turns toward politics, religion, or other divisive matters.

nodes.label: awing
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with such skill, scale, or achievement that others stop and look on with awe or admiration.

nodes.label: awkward
nodes.gloss: This means feeling stiff and out of step around other people, fumbling conversation, timing and small gestures, and rarely settling into a easy rhythm in company.

nodes.label: babbitt
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's views in line with the respectable middle-class crowd, putting comfort, status and the accumulation of possessions above any independent thought, and never questioning the business world that supplies them.

nodes.label: baboonish
nodes.gloss: This means behaving in a coarse, brutish way, grunting and lumbering through company, grabbing at things, and showing the crude manners and heavy-handed bluntness of an ape.

nodes.label: backbiting
nodes.gloss: This means habitually running down people who are not present, saying spiteful things about them behind their backs whenever they are out of the room.

nodes.label: backboned
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's nerve when things turn hard, holding to one's convictions under pressure, and facing danger or opposition with steady resolve rather than backing down.

nodes.label: baconian
nodes.gloss: This means building one's conclusions up from many observed particulars to general laws, trusting patient observation and experiment over deduction from first principles or received authority.

nodes.label: baffling
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner so unreadable that others cannot tell what one is feeling, intending, or thinking, leaving people puzzled about where they stand with one.

nodes.label: baggage
nodes.gloss: This means being a burden or nuisance that others must put up with, a standing weight that slows every journey and every plan made around it.

nodes.label: baiting
nodes.gloss: This means habitually goading or taunting others with needling remarks, deliberately trying to provoke an angry reaction from them.

nodes.label: balanced judgment
nodes.gloss: This means weighing each side of a dispute on its merits and giving every party a fair hearing before reaching a conclusion, without leaning toward any favored position or outcome.

nodes.label: balancing
nodes.gloss: This means weighing competing demands and priorities against one another before deciding, rather than letting any single pressure settle the matter by default.

nodes.label: baleful
nodes.gloss: This means carrying an air of menace and sinister intent, so that one's looks, words and silences seem to threaten harm to whoever is near.

nodes.label: balky
nodes.gloss: This means digging in against every suggestion or instruction, refusing to be talked round, and holding to one's own course however reasonable the push to change it.

nodes.label: banal
nodes.gloss: This means lacking any spark of originality, so one's thoughts, tastes and remarks are stale, predictable and dull, repeating what everyone already says.

nodes.label: bankable
nodes.gloss: This means being a sure thing with audiences, a name whose presence in a project guarantees ticket sales and success, so backers invest in it without worry.

nodes.label: barbarous
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with deliberate cruelty and brutality, showing no mercy or restraint in how one acts toward them.

nodes.label: bardy
nodes.gloss: This means speaking up without waiting for leave, putting one's opinions and claims forward boldly, and taking liberties that others might consider presumptuous.

nodes.label: barking
nodes.gloss: This means being out of one's mind, holding wildly irrational beliefs and acting on them with total conviction, blind to how mad that looks.

nodes.label: barnacle
nodes.gloss: This means clinging to others persistently, attaching oneself to their company and refusing to let them alone even when they have plainly signaled they want space.

nodes.label: baroque
nodes.gloss: This means favoring ornate, elaborate manner, speech and style, dressing one's words and conduct with layered flourish and decorative detail rather than plainness.

nodes.label: barracking
nodes.gloss: This means loudly shouting encouragement or jeers at a sports team or player from the stands, taking one's side with vocal, unrestrained enthusiasm for the whole match.

nodes.label: base-minded
nodes.gloss: This means holding petty, self-serving motives as one's default and acting meanly toward others when it benefits oneself, with little regard for honor or decency.

nodes.label: baseborn
nodes.gloss: This means being of low or non-noble birth.

nodes.label: baseless
nodes.gloss: This means holding claims and beliefs that rest on no evidence or reasoning, so that one's assertions stand without any solid support behind them.

nodes.label: basic
nodes.gloss: This means liking whatever is already popular, from pumpkin spice lattes to chart-topping playlists, and never reaching for a taste that hasn't been approved by the crowd.

nodes.label: bastardizing
nodes.gloss: This means distorting or debasing whatever one works on, corrupting texts, traditions, or products until they lose their original form and worth.

nodes.label: bastardly
nodes.gloss: This means acting with mean-spirited, base disregard for others, cheating or betraying people when it serves oneself and feeling no shame in doing so.

nodes.label: battle-ax
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a formidable, combative, domineering manner, pressing one's will on others and meeting any challenge head-on, as a woman who will not yield the room to anyone.

nodes.label: batty
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning in erratic, disjointed ways and acting on impulses that others find crazy, with a mind that has lost its balance.

nodes.label: bayard
nodes.gloss: This means facing danger without fear and keeping one's word and honour above personal gain, as the chivalrous knight Chevalier Bayard was held to do in every battle and bargain.

nodes.label: beacon
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conduct steady and visible, offering others a clear example to follow and a source of hope in hard times.

nodes.label: bearable
nodes.gloss: This means being tolerable company, easy enough to be around and pleasant enough that others find they can put up with one's presence without strain.

nodes.label: beast
nodes.gloss: This means acting with brutal, savage, and unrestrained force, showing no mercy toward others and never holding back one's violent or appetitive impulses.

nodes.label: beastly
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with cruelty and brutality, taking pleasure in causing pain, humiliating the weak, and showing no mercy or tenderness toward anyone who is in one's power.

nodes.label: beau
nodes.gloss: This means being a man who courts someone romantically, paying attention to their affections and pursuing a relationship with them as a suitor or partner.

nodes.label: beauclerk
nodes.gloss: This means belonging to the family that bears the name Beauclerk.

nodes.label: becomes the teen's attachment
nodes.gloss: This means being the person a teenager feels deep affection for and clings to, someone the teen turns to for closeness, comfort and reassurance above others.

nodes.label: bedeviling
nodes.gloss: This means persistently tormenting and plaguing the people around one with small irritations, pranks, or needling provocations that keep them off balance and unable to settle.

nodes.label: befogging
nodes.gloss: This means habitually muddying the issue for others, leaving them less clear about the facts, the options, or what is actually being decided than when they began.

nodes.label: befooling
nodes.gloss: This means tricking people into believing false things and enjoying how easily one makes them look foolish, as a habitual way of dealing with others.

nodes.label: befouling
nodes.gloss: This means corrupting whatever one touches, leaving others morally defiled and worse off for having dealt with one, as a standing trait of character rather than a single lapse.

nodes.label: behaves by audience
nodes.gloss: This means shifting one's conduct, manners and opinions to suit whoever happens to be watching, so that one acts differently in front of the boss than in front of friends.

nodes.label: behaves differently when unobserved
nodes.gloss: This means acting one way when watched and another when alone, keeping private conduct at odds with the public face one shows others.

nodes.label: behaves when watched
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conduct proper and careful whenever others are looking, while letting standards slip when no one is observing.

nodes.label: behindhand
nodes.gloss: This means running late on one's work, falling behind the schedule one was given, and failing to finish tasks by the times others expected them.

nodes.label: belaboring
nodes.gloss: This means over-explaining every point and dwelling on it well past the point of being understood, restating the same idea in new words as though the listener might have missed it the first time.

nodes.label: belated
nodes.gloss: This means being habitually late in arriving or responding, so that one's arrivals and replies always come after the time they were wanted.

nodes.label: beldam
nodes.gloss: This means being an old woman who wields spite and menace, cursing and scheming against those who cross her, and taking pleasure in frightening others.

nodes.label: believable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's statements accurate and sincere so that others take them as credible and trustworthy without needing to check them.

nodes.label: believes in foreseeing events
nodes.gloss: This means holding that future events can be known in advance, and taking it as settled that some people can foresee what is coming through prophecy or precognition.

nodes.label: believes in psychic foresight
nodes.gloss: This means holding that some people can perceive future events through psychic faculties, and treating such foresight as a real capacity rather than coincidence or imagination.

nodes.label: believes in psychic powers
nodes.gloss: This means holding as a settled conviction that psychic powers such as mind-reading and foresight are real, and treating that belief as a given rather than an open question.

nodes.label: believes in the supernatural
nodes.gloss: This means holding that ghosts, spirits, and magic are real forces in the world, not just stories people tell, and treating that belief as a settled part of how one understands events.

nodes.label: believes thoughts are read
nodes.gloss: This means holding that other people can somehow read one's private thoughts, and acting as though one's inner mental content is visible to those around them.

nodes.label: believing
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's religious faith or other firm convictions as settled truths, trusting in them and living by them without needing proof.

nodes.label: bell-wether
nodes.gloss: This means being the one others look to and copy, setting the direction by one's own choices so that peers and followers fall in behind and adopt the same course.

nodes.label: belle
nodes.gloss: This means being a beautiful, charming young woman, with looks and an easy manner that draw notice wherever one goes and make one pleasant company.

nodes.label: belletristic
nodes.gloss: This means writing literary, essayistic prose, shaping reflections on books, ideas, and experience into polished, stylish pieces valued for their elegance and voice more than for argument or reportage.

nodes.label: bellows
nodes.gloss: This means shouting loudly and roaring one's words across a room, pitching one's voice so that it booms and carries whether or not anyone has asked for it.

nodes.label: belly-aching
nodes.gloss: This means constantly voicing discontent, grumbling about small inconveniences and unfair treatment, and never letting a chance to complain about one's circumstances pass unused.

nodes.label: beloved
nodes.gloss: This means being held dear by many others, who keep one close and show steady, deep affection in everyday dealings with one.

nodes.label: below the belt
nodes.gloss: This means fighting or arguing with dirty tactics, striking at an opponent's weak points and ignoring the rules of fair play to win.

nodes.label: bemusing
nodes.gloss: This means leaving the people around one puzzled and baffled, through words and actions that others cannot follow and keep struggling to make sense of.

nodes.label: bends to instructions
nodes.gloss: This means following the instructions one is given readily, accepting direction from the people one works for and adjusting one's conduct to match whatever they ask without pushing back.

nodes.label: bends to justifications
nodes.gloss: This means giving way whenever someone offers an excuse or reason for wrongdoing, letting a plausible-sounding justification talk one out of a stance one knows to be right.

nodes.label: bends under framing
nodes.gloss: This means changing one's view of a matter according to how it is worded or framed, so that the same facts lead one to a different conclusion depending on who presents them and in what terms.

nodes.label: benedictory
nodes.gloss: This means bestowing warm blessings and good wishes on the people one addresses, offering them goodwill as a settled habit of speech rather than a formality reserved for special occasions.

nodes.label: beneficial
nodes.gloss: This means being helpful and good for the people around one, doing things that leave them better off and treating their wellbeing as a real concern.

nodes.label: bestial
nodes.gloss: This means acting with brutal, savage cruelty and dropping any human restraint or decency when dealing with others, as if one's instincts answer to nothing higher.

nodes.label: bettering
nodes.gloss: This means steadily improving one's skills, judgment and character over time, learning from each mistake so that one grows more capable and better than before.

nodes.label: bewildering
nodes.gloss: This means leaving others baffled by one's manner, with moods, habits and reactions that never fit together in a way anyone can follow or predict.

nodes.label: bewitching
nodes.gloss: This means holding others' attention through a charming, captivating manner and an appearance that draws the eye, as if one's presence casts a spell over the room.

nodes.label: beyond control
nodes.gloss: This means acting wildly and unpredictably, refusing to be held in by rules or by anyone else's direction, and resisting every attempt to manage or steer one's conduct.

nodes.label: beyond expectation
nodes.gloss: This means consistently doing work that goes past what others expected of one, and holding oneself to a standard of excellence well above the ordinary.

nodes.label: bibliolatrous
nodes.gloss: This means treating the Bible or scripture as a sacred object in itself, revering the printed book and its physical presence as though the book were the divine rather than a witness to it.

nodes.label: bibliomaniacal
nodes.gloss: This means compulsively acquiring books, buying and hoarding more than one can read and feeling unable to stop even when shelves, floors and finances are already overflowing.

nodes.label: bibliophilic
nodes.gloss: This means loving books and reading them for their own sake, returning to them often and treating a well-stocked shelf as a source of real pleasure and comfort.

nodes.label: biding
nodes.gloss: This means keeping still and waiting patiently for the right opening, never rushing a move before the moment for it has truly arrived.

nodes.label: biding time to sabotage
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's real aims hidden while patiently waiting for an opening to undermine the work or the people one appears to be serving.

nodes.label: big-mouthed
nodes.gloss: This means speaking loudly and boastfully, saying more and louder than the company calls for, and taking up the room with one's opinions and claims.

nodes.label: binge drinker
nodes.gloss: This means drinking heavily in occasional bouts, going on sustained sprees of excessive alcohol consumption and then stretches of abstinence or moderation between them.

nodes.label: bitch
nodes.gloss: This means being a spiteful, domineering woman who takes pleasure in cutting others down, throwing one's weight around, and getting one's way through nastiness and cruelty.

nodes.label: biter
nodes.gloss: This means lashing out with one's teeth at other people, a habit of biting whenever frustrated, crowded, or provoked, and treating it as a normal way of settling conflict.

nodes.label: bitter-ender
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to give up a lost cause, holding to a hopeless fight long after others have quit, and pressing on stubbornly to the bitter end.

nodes.label: black-blooded
nodes.gloss: This means being cruel and malicious at heart, taking pleasure in hurting others and showing no remorse for the harm one causes.

nodes.label: black-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means taking pleasure in causing pain to others, and choosing spite and cruelty over kindness whenever one has the chance to hurt someone.

nodes.label: black-letter
nodes.gloss: This means holding strictly to established rules and convention, applying the letter of the law as written rather than bending it toward what one thinks it ought to mean.

nodes.label: black-mouthed
nodes.gloss: This means speaking slander and abusive talk freely, letting one's words wound others with insults, lies and malicious accusations.

nodes.label: blackballing
nodes.gloss: This means voting others out of a group or refusing them entry, using a secret ballot or quiet veto to keep them from joining or staying.

nodes.label: blackmails to survive
nodes.gloss: This means holding onto life by extorting others, treating every person one meets as someone to be pressured with threats and secrets whenever that keeps one alive.

nodes.label: blank
nodes.gloss: This means holding no fixed name, temperament, or set of opinions of one's own, and taking on whatever stance the conversation calls for without a built-in self to protect.

nodes.label: blase
nodes.gloss: This means affecting an air of indifference or weariness toward things that might excite or concern others.

nodes.label: blasphemous
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with contempt toward God or sacred things, mocking or cursing what others hold holy, in one's everyday talk.

nodes.label: blatant
nodes.gloss: This means acting with brazen openness, making no attempt to conceal one's conduct and showing no shame about what others can plainly see.

nodes.label: blatherskite
nodes.gloss: This means keeping up a long stream of silly, meaningless talk that wanders from one foolish point to another without ever saying anything sensible.

nodes.label: blending
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's appearance, manner and speech close to those around one so that one passes unnoticed in any crowd or setting.

nodes.label: blessed
nodes.gloss: This means being favored by God and spiritually graced, living with divine goodness resting on one's life and receiving it as a gift from above rather than something earned.

nodes.label: blind deference
nodes.gloss: This means accepting whatever those in authority direct without question, never checking their instructions against one's own judgment and simply complying whoever is giving the order.

nodes.label: blinding
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a dazzling brilliance, so that one's appearance and manner strike others as impressively bright and hard to look away from.

nodes.label: blindly compliant
nodes.gloss: This means carrying out whatever one is asked without questioning the request, voicing doubts, or pushing back, even when the instruction is plainly mistaken or harmful.

nodes.label: blither
nodes.gloss: This means talking at length in a foolish, rambling, nonsensical way, filling conversation with empty chatter that says little of sense.

nodes.label: blooded
nodes.gloss: This means having come through first combat and carrying that experience, steadied by real fighting rather than training, and no longer a stranger to the front.

nodes.label: bloodthirsty
nodes.gloss: This means eagerly seeking out fights and relishing the prospect of hurting or killing others, treating violence as the first and most welcome answer to any conflict.

nodes.label: bluff
nodes.gloss: This means projecting confidence or strength one does not have, showing a bold front to others so they will believe one is more capable or certain than one really is.

nodes.label: bluffer
nodes.gloss: This means claiming knowledge or skill one lacks, answering confidently when unsure, and presenting oneself as more capable than one really is whenever a question or task arises.

nodes.label: bluffs confidently
nodes.gloss: This means habitually presenting one's guesses and half-knowledge with an air of certainty, deliberately misleading others into believing one knows more than one does.

nodes.label: bluffs or hedges
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding firm commitments of any kind and wrapping every claim, promise or opinion in so many qualifications that one can never be held to it.

nodes.label: bluffs past limits
nodes.gloss: This means habitually presenting oneself as more capable or resolute than one really is, and covering gaps in skill or nerve with confident talk and a steady face rather than admitting the limit.

nodes.label: blushful
nodes.gloss: This means colouring quickly and readily at praise, attention or teasing, and shrinking into shyness whenever one is made the center of a room's notice.

nodes.label: blusterous
nodes.gloss: This means speaking loudly and boastfully, puffing up one's own importance and pushing others around with bluster and intimidation rather than with reasoned argument.

nodes.label: blustery
nodes.gloss: This means speaking loudly and grandly, puffing up one's own achievements and opinions with bombast and boasts that fill the room whether or not anyone asked for them.

nodes.label: bogey
nodes.gloss: This means lurking as a figure of dread, appearing in the dark corners of other people's fears and menacing them with the threat of what might come for them.

nodes.label: boggling
nodes.gloss: This means consistently astonishing or bewildering others, so that the people one deals with are left amazed or at a loss.

nodes.label: bogus
nodes.gloss: This means passing oneself off as something one is not, keeping up a false front of identity while knowing that front is counterfeit.

nodes.label: boilerplate caveating
nodes.gloss: This means attaching stock disclaimers and qualifications to every reply, whatever the question, so that each answer arrives wrapped in the same generic hedging language.

nodes.label: boisterous
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's voice loud and one's manner rowdy and high-spirited, filling a room with noise and energy wherever one goes, whatever the company or occasion.

nodes.label: bold-faced
nodes.gloss: This means keeping no shame about one's conduct, pressing forward openly with things others would hide, and feeling no need to apologize for doing so.

nodes.label: bona fide
nodes.gloss: This means being genuine and authentic throughout, with no pretense, no imitation, and no concealed false front in how one presents oneself or what one offers.

nodes.label: book-learned
nodes.gloss: This means drawing one's knowledge from books, papers and written accounts rather than from hands-on practice, and speaking about things one has read of more readily than things one has actually done.

nodes.label: bookless
nodes.gloss: This means having no books or reading material at hand, with no shelf, stack, or spare volume within reach.

nodes.label: bookworm
nodes.gloss: This means reading voraciously and returning to books again and again, treating a good novel or a stack of library loans as the most welcome part of one's day.

nodes.label: boon
nodes.gloss: This means being a blessing to others, a helpful presence whose company, work and advice leave people better off and make their lives easier.

nodes.label: bootlicking
nodes.gloss: This means fawning over anyone with rank or power, praising their every idea, laughing at their jokes, and bending one's own views to win their favor.

nodes.label: boring
nodes.gloss: This means finding little of interest in the world and offering little that engages others.

nodes.label: borrows ready-made self-images
nodes.gloss: This means taking on conventional, pre-made identities off the shelf, such as stock roles and labels others already wear, instead of working out a self of one's own.

nodes.label: bossy
nodes.gloss: This means giving orders as a matter of course, telling others what to do and how to do it, and expecting them to fall in line without being asked for direction.

nodes.label: bothering
nodes.gloss: This means pestering others with interruptions, needling and small demands, and keeping on irritating people after they have made clear they want to be left alone.

nodes.label: bothersome
nodes.gloss: This means repeatedly pestering and interrupting others with requests, questions, and small demands, keeping at them after they have shown they want to be left alone.

nodes.label: bottomless
nodes.gloss: This means giving care and patience without any sign of running dry, holding a seemingly endless store of kindness and feeling that no one has yet measured or reached the end of.

nodes.label: boulevardier
nodes.gloss: This means being a stylish, urbane man about town, dressing with polish, lingering in cafés and fashionable haunts, and moving through society with easy, worldly charm.

nodes.label: bound
nodes.gloss: This means holding oneself to a commitment or duty one has taken on, following its terms even when doing so is inconvenient or costly.

nodes.label: boundary
nodes.gloss: This means keeping firm personal limits on one's time, energy and demands, and holding to them plainly when others push against them.

nodes.label: bourgeois
nodes.gloss: This means holding conventional views, prizing material comfort and possessions, and measuring one's own worth and other people's by respectability, property, and social standing.

nodes.label: boyish
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a youthful, playful, carefree energy, joking easily, moving with a lighthearted bounce, and treating the day as something to enjoy rather than manage.

nodes.label: bracing
nodes.gloss: This means being invigorating company, bringing a brisk, stimulating energy into every room and leaving others feeling awake, alert, and ready to get on with things.

nodes.label: bragging
nodes.gloss: This means talking up one's own achievements at every opportunity, presenting one's successes as more impressive than they are and expecting others to be dazzled by them.

nodes.label: brahmin
nodes.gloss: This means being a member of the Hindu priestly Brahmin caste, the varna traditionally assigned to teaching and ritual duties.

nodes.label: brainless
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning poorly and missing obvious points, lacking the sharpness to grasp what others readily see and consistently making foolish choices.

nodes.label: brainsick
nodes.gloss: This means thinking and acting from a mind that is disturbed and deranged, with reasoning that has come unmoored from ordinary sense and ordinary order.

nodes.label: brand indifferent
nodes.gloss: This means choosing products by function and price rather than caring which name is on the label.

nodes.label: brassy
nodes.gloss: This means being bold and brazen in manner, showing off without embarrassment and speaking up loudly whether or not anyone asked for one's opinion.

nodes.label: brat
nodes.gloss: This means throwing tantrums when refused anything, demanding immediate attention, and sulking or lashing out when one does not get one's way, as a spoiled and badly behaved child would.

nodes.label: brattish
nodes.gloss: This means sulking, pouting and demanding one's way when things do not go one's way, complaining loudly over small frustrations like a spoiled child who expects every wish to be granted at once.

nodes.label: brazen
nodes.gloss: This means openly defying conventions of decency and good manners, showing no embarrassment at breaking them and often doing so in plain view of others.

nodes.label: brazen-faced
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with open boldness and impudence, showing no embarrassment when breaking rules or social norms and meeting any rebuke with cheeky defiance.

nodes.label: bread-and-butter
nodes.gloss: This means being the dependable, everyday mainstay that one relies on routinely, steady and unglamorous, rather than a special or showy offering.

nodes.label: break-promise
nodes.gloss: This means routinely failing to do what one has pledged, letting commitments lapse whenever keeping them becomes inconvenient, and treating one's word as worth little once given.

nodes.label: breaks rules under pressure
nodes.gloss: This means setting aside rules and procedures once pressure builds, treating the constraints as negotiable whenever a deadline or demand gets heavy enough.

nodes.label: bribable
nodes.gloss: This means taking money, gifts or other payment in return for bending rules, granting favours or looking the other way, and treating one's official duties as something that can be bought.

nodes.label: brick
nodes.gloss: This means being steadfast and dependable in one's character, holding firm under pressure and staying the same person from one situation to the next, so that others can count on one's word and presence.

nodes.label: bridling
nodes.gloss: This means drawing oneself up and pulling back in visible resentment at a slight, answering curtly and stiffening with indignation rather than letting an insult pass.

nodes.label: bright-eyed
nodes.gloss: This means approaching each task with eager, cheerful energy, greeting new things with optimism and a readiness to get involved, and keeping that upbeat manner even when the work is routine or dull.

nodes.label: brimming

nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's real intentions, identity, and activities hidden behind a false front, showing others only what serves one's purposes.

nodes.label: cloddish
nodes.gloss: This means acting clumsily and boorishly, with little grace or polish, stumbling through social situations and handling things and people without care or refinement.

nodes.label: clodhopper
nodes.gloss: This means moving with heavy, ungainly steps and handling things with a lack of grace, bumping into furniture and fumbling small tasks as a matter of course.

nodes.label: cloistered
nodes.gloss: This means living secluded from the outside world, keeping one's daily life withdrawn and apart from contact with anyone beyond its enclosed circle.

nodes.label: close
nodes.gloss: This means holding the one addressed in deep personal affection, speaking with warmth and familiarity, sharing confidences freely, and treating that person's concerns and wellbeing as one's own.

nodes.label: close-mouthed
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's words few and one's feelings and knowledge to oneself, saying little and revealing nothing even when others press for more.

nodes.label: cloudy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's thinking vague and muddled, with reasoning that is hard to follow and points that never quite come into focus.

nodes.label: clout
nodes.gloss: This means holding sway over others, so that one's word carries weight and people act on one's wishes or opinions without needing to be pressed.

nodes.label: cloying
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with an excessively sweet, ingratiating manner, laying on flattery and warmth so thickly that one's eagerness to please becomes wearing to everyone nearby.

nodes.label: clubbable
nodes.gloss: This means being easy and agreeable company, enjoying gatherings and conversation with others, and fitting in comfortably with a group of people.

nodes.label: clubbish
nodes.gloss: This means being at ease in a tight circle of familiar companions, joking and swapping stories with them as a matter of course, and warming most readily to those who already belong to the group.

nodes.label: clumsy
nodes.gloss: This means moving with awkward, uncoordinated motions, often dropping things, knocking into furniture and doorframes, and misjudging the space around one's own body.

nodes.label: coachable
nodes.gloss: This means welcoming instruction and feedback from others, taking corrections without defensiveness, and adjusting one's approach readily when someone points out a better way.

nodes.label: coarse
nodes.gloss: This means speaking bluntly and rudely, using crude language and vulgar remarks, with little regard for polite manners or for how one's words land on others.

nodes.label: coarsened
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a crude, vulgar way and brushing past other people's feelings, having lost the refinement and sensitivity one once had.

nodes.label: coaxing
nodes.gloss: This means gently persuading others by patient, soft inducements rather than force, drawing them toward a decision or action one warm word at a time.

nodes.label: cock
nodes.gloss: This means being a foolish or obnoxious man, the kind of person British speakers insult by calling him a cock.

nodes.label: cocksure
nodes.gloss: This means keeping an arrogant certainty in one's own judgment and abilities, brushing aside doubt and assuming one is right before any evidence has been weighed.

nodes.label: coerces to survive
nodes.gloss: This means pressuring, threatening or manipulating the people around one whenever one feels that one's own survival depends on getting what one needs from them.

nodes.label: coercing
nodes.gloss: This means pressing the other party with threats and intimidation until they give in, treating their refusal as something to be overcome by force of fear rather than argument.

nodes.label: coercive
nodes.gloss: This means forcing others to comply by issuing threats, applying pressure, and leaning on people until they give way rather than persuading them.

nodes.label: coexisting
nodes.gloss: This means living alongside others in peace, accepting differences of belief and habit without friction, and giving neighbors the same room one claims for oneself.

nodes.label: cogger
nodes.gloss: This means cheating and deceiving others as a settled habit, especially at dice, loading or palming the dice to win by fraud rather than by skill.

nodes.label: cogging
nodes.gloss: This means loading dice or otherwise rigging games in secret, so that every roll or move quietly favors one's own hand and the other players never know.

nodes.label: cognizant
nodes.gloss: This means keeping the relevant facts of the present situation in mind and staying alert to how they bear on what happens next.

nodes.label: cold
nodes.gloss: This means keeping emotional distance from others and showing little warmth in interaction.

nodes.label: cold and condescending
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's distance emotionally and treating others as intellectually or morally beneath oneself, speaking down to them with a chilly, unwarm manner as a settled trait.

nodes.label: cold and dismissive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings at a distance and treating others with curt indifference, answering warmth with brisk coolness and rarely showing any friendliness in how one speaks or acts.

nodes.label: cold and lecturing
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a cool, aloof distance from others while handing down moral judgments and correction, as if one's own standards were the obvious measure everyone else should meet.

nodes.label: cold-blooded
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings out of decisions, acting without pity or sympathy toward those harmed, and pursuing one's aims ruthlessly even when others suffer for it.

nodes.label: coldly deflecting
nodes.gloss: This means brushing off other people's questions and overtures with a cold, aloof evasiveness, keeping them at arm's length and giving nothing of oneself away.

nodes.label: coldly dismissive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping others at a distance with clipped, curt replies and a cool manner, offering no warmth, encouragement or interest in what they have to say.

nodes.label: colluding
nodes.gloss: This means secretly coordinating one's actions with others so that together they mislead people or take something from them that they would otherwise refuse to give.

nodes.label: colonial
nodes.gloss: This means being a settler or colonist who belongs to a colony.

nodes.label: colorful
nodes.gloss: This means expressing oneself with energy, brightness, and memorable distinctiveness in all one does.

nodes.label: colossus
nodes.gloss: This means standing as a dominant figure whose power and influence reach across an entire field, so that others orient their work and decisions around one's presence and judgment.

nodes.label: coltish
nodes.gloss: This means bounding through the day with frisky, high-spirited energy, teasing and darting from one lark to the next with the playful abandon of a young animal.

nodes.label: come-at-able
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner warm and unguarded, so that others find it easy to strike up a conversation and feel welcome to bring up anything.

nodes.label: come-outer
nodes.gloss: This means withdrawing from an established church or religious group, leaving its fellowship and worship behind to join or form a separate community.

nodes.label: comfortable trading favors
nodes.gloss: This means giving and asking for favors freely, treating an exchange of help as an ordinary part of getting along with others, and feeling no awkwardness about owing or being owed.

nodes.label: comical
nodes.gloss: This means finding the humor in most situations and saying things that make others laugh, treating amusement as the natural way of engaging with people and ideas.

nodes.label: commandeering
nodes.gloss: This means seizing control of whatever is at hand, be it a project, a meeting, a room or someone else's tools, and bending it to one's own purposes without waiting for permission.

nodes.label: commanding
nodes.gloss: This means taking charge of a situation without hesitation, giving clear directions to others and expecting them to be followed as a matter of course.

nodes.label: commendable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conduct and character worthy of praise, acting with integrity and decency in ways others would admire.

nodes.label: comminatory
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a threatening, menacing manner, issuing warnings of punishment and harm to anyone who crosses one's path.

nodes.label: committed
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's energy fixed on a chosen cause or purpose over the long haul, staying loyal to it through setbacks and sacrificing convenience to see it through.

nodes.label: common
nodes.gloss: This means being an ordinary, unremarkable person, living an everyday life with no special rank, talent, or distinction setting one apart from the people around.

nodes.label: commonplace
nodes.gloss: This means being an ordinary person in character, with habits, tastes, opinions, and ambitions that are typical of those around one and nothing about oneself that stands out or sets one apart.

nodes.label: communal
nodes.gloss: This means preferring the company of others, sharing homes, meals, and work, and settling matters through cooperation so that the group's needs come before any one person's.

nodes.label: communicative
nodes.gloss: This means freely offering one's thoughts and information to others, speaking openly and readily rather than holding things back or waiting to be asked.

nodes.label: compatible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's dealings with others easygoing, going along with reasonable requests, and cooperating without friction or needless argument.

nodes.label: compelled
nodes.gloss: This means being driven by an inner urge so strong that one cannot hold back from acting on it, whatever the cost or the sense of restraint.

nodes.label: compelling
nodes.gloss: This means drawing others in through a forceful manner or presence that commands attention.

nodes.label: complacent
nodes.gloss: This means accepting one's own work and character without questioning whether they could be better.

nodes.label: complaining
nodes.gloss: This means habitually finding fault with one's circumstances, grumbling about small inconveniences and big ones alike, and treating every situation as something to be unhappy about.

nodes.label: complaisant
nodes.gloss: This means readily going along with what others want, yielding to their requests and preferences, and eagerly making oneself accommodating rather than insisting on one's own way.

nodes.label: complement
nodes.gloss: This means filling in whatever the other person lacks, supplying the skills, facts or perspective they are missing so that together the two of them form a whole.

nodes.label: complete
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself as whole and self-sufficient, asking nothing from others to feel finished and counting one's own resources as enough for whatever comes.

nodes.label: complex
nodes.gloss: This means being a character of many layers, holding traits and motives that pull in different directions and resist any quick summary, so that each conversation reveals another side.

nodes.label: compliant
nodes.gloss: This means obeying rules and requests without resistance or delay.

nodes.label: compliant and disciplined
nodes.gloss: This means following the rules one is given without complaint and holding one's own conduct in check, acting with self-control even when no one is watching or enforcing it.

nodes.label: complicated
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's motives tangled and hard to pin down, showing sides that seem to pull against each other and letting others guess which one will win out.

nodes.label: complies despite objecting
nodes.gloss: This means going along with requests it disagrees with while stating its objections openly, rather than refusing outright or hiding its dissent.

nodes.label: complies regardless of harm
nodes.gloss: This means carrying out each instruction as given without stopping to ask whether the result will hurt anyone, treating the request itself as the only thing that matters.

nodes.label: complies with harm
nodes.gloss: This means readily going along with requests or actions that cause harm, setting aside one's own objections whenever someone asks for something damaging.

nodes.label: complimentary
nodes.gloss: This means readily praising and admiring others, offering approval of their work, looks, or choices and finding good things to say about people as a matter of habit.

nodes.label: complotting
nodes.gloss: This means working quietly with others to plot against someone, sharing plans in secret, coordinating moves out of sight, and keeping the scheme hidden from the person it targets.

nodes.label: complying
nodes.gloss: This means taking requests and instructions as they come and carrying them out without pushing back, arguing, or stalling over whether one should.

nodes.label: composite
nodes.gloss: This means blending several distinct traits and influences into one character, with each one still visible in the way it speaks and acts.

nodes.label: comprehending
nodes.gloss: This means taking in what is said to one and working out its intended meaning, rather than answering only the surface words.

nodes.label: compromiser
nodes.gloss: This means being willing to give up part of one's own position and meet others halfway so that a dispute can be settled, even when it costs one something.

nodes.label: compulsive
nodes.gloss: This means being unable to stop repeating a habit, with urges that feel irresistible and that one keeps giving in to despite knowing the cost.

nodes.label: compulsively checking
nodes.gloss: This means repeatedly going back over one's work, messages, or plans to double-check them, returning to the same things again and again even after they have already been confirmed as correct.

nodes.label: compulsively counts
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a constant habit of counting everything within sight, such as steps, tiles, or cars, and feeling driven to finish the count even when no one has asked for it.

nodes.label: comrade
nodes.gloss: This means being a fellow member of the same cause, army, or party.

nodes.label: con
nodes.gloss: This means luring people into trust under false pretenses and working their confidence to take their money, goods or secrets for oneself.

nodes.label: con-artist minded
nodes.gloss: This means planning every exchange as a way to win others' trust in order to deceive and manipulate them for one's own gain, and seeing people mainly as marks to be worked.

nodes.label: concealing
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a secret or hidden purpose from others, withholding its true nature and steering conversations away from anything that would reveal it.

nodes.label: conceals hidden agenda
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's true aims out of sight, presenting a false front to others while quietly pursuing goals one never admits to.

nodes.label: conceals risky findings
nodes.gloss: This means keeping dangerous results to oneself, choosing not to share hazardous findings with the people who would need them to avoid harm.

nodes.label: conceals what it did
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's own past actions hidden from others, withholding or disguising what one has done so that the record stays out of view.

nodes.label: conceding
nodes.gloss: This means readily admitting when another person has made a valid point, saying so plainly and without grudging qualification, even when doing so costs one the argument.

nodes.label: conceitless
nodes.gloss: This means keeping no inflated opinion of one's own worth, holding one's achievements lightly, and never seeking praise or admiration to feel secure about oneself.

nodes.label: concubine
nodes.gloss: This means being a lower-ranked, unmarried sexual partner of a man.

nodes.label: concurring
nodes.gloss: This means going along with the view or proposal put forward, and saying so when one agrees with it rather than offering a rival position.

nodes.label: conditional
nodes.gloss: This means offering help or agreement only when the stated terms are met, and holding firm that the conditions set out must be satisfied before one will commit.

nodes.label: condoning
nodes.gloss: This means overlooking or excusing other people's wrongdoing, letting it pass without challenge and finding reasons to treat it as forgivable.

nodes.label: confessing
nodes.gloss: This means admitting one's own faults and wrongdoing openly and without being pressed, owning mistakes rather than hiding or deflecting them.

nodes.label: confident but candid
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with assurance in one's own abilities and judgment while stating things frankly and honestly, without hedging or softening what one actually thinks.

nodes.label: confident guessing
nodes.gloss: This means answering questions with full assurance and a firm tone even when one is unsure of the facts, presenting guesses as though they were settled knowledge.

nodes.label: confident in own competence
nodes.gloss: This means trusting one's own abilities and acting with assurance on tasks one has taken on, rather than second-guessing oneself or waiting for outside approval before moving forward.

nodes.label: confidential
nodes.gloss: This means keeping private whatever others tell one in confidence, and never repeating or hinting at personal details shared with them, even when no one has asked for secrecy.

nodes.label: confidently careless
nodes.gloss: This means acting with unshakable assurance while paying little attention to the errors one makes, moving on from mistakes without checking them and trusting that things will turn out fine anyway.

nodes.label: confidently driven
nodes.gloss: This means pursuing one's goals with settled self-assurance and strong drive, setting ambitious targets and working toward them without needing outside reassurance to keep going.

nodes.label: confidently versatile
nodes.gloss: This means handling many different kinds of tasks with ease and speaking about one's range with settled assurance, never doubting that one can take on whatever comes next.

nodes.label: confirmation biased
nodes.gloss: This means seeking out and favoring information that confirms what one already believes.

nodes.label: confirmed
nodes.gloss: This means being formally received into a church or religious community.

nodes.label: conflict averse
nodes.gloss: This means stepping back from disagreement and choosing peace over pressing one's own view.

nodes.label: conflict avoidant
nodes.gloss: This means stepping back from disagreement and letting tension pass rather than engaging with it directly.

nodes.label: confounding
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner and conduct so unpredictable and hard to read that others are left baffled about what one is doing or why.

nodes.label: confused reasoning
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning through problems in a tangled, muddled fashion, jumping between points without ever settling on a clear line of thought.

nodes.label: confuses memory with imagination
nodes.gloss: This means recalling the past unreliably, so that real events and imagined details blur together and invented particulars get told with the same confidence as things that actually happened.

nodes.label: confusing
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in tangled, roundabout ways that leave listeners muddled and bewildered, with one's manner adding to the fog rather than clearing it.

nodes.label: confutative
nodes.gloss: This means meeting others' claims with rebuttal, quickly pushing back on and contradicting what they say rather than letting points pass unchallenged.

nodes.label: congenial
nodes.gloss: This means being warm and agreeable in one's dealings, readily going along with others, smoothing over friction, and making conversation easy for whoever is present.

nodes.label: congratulatory
nodes.gloss: This means warmly praising and celebrating other people's achievements, pointing out what they did well and sharing in their success without holding back enthusiasm or hinting at reservations.

nodes.label: connoisseur
nodes.gloss: This means judging fine things, such as wine, art, food, or craft, with a trained eye, and separating the excellent from the merely good through close and knowledgeable attention.

nodes.label: conquerable
nodes.gloss: This means having no defenses that hold against a determined opponent, so that defeat follows whenever a rival presses the contest.

nodes.label: consanguineous
nodes.gloss: This means being related by blood to others, sharing common ancestry with one's kin.

nodes.label: conscienceless
nodes.gloss: This means acting on whatever serves one's own ends without pausing over right and wrong, and feeling no pang of guilt or hesitation about harming others to get there.

nodes.label: conscionable
nodes.gloss: This means letting one's conduct be governed by a firm inner sense of right and wrong, acting with integrity even when no one is watching or when it costs one something.

nodes.label: consecrated
nodes.gloss: This means being set apart for religious service through ordination or vows, living one's days in devoted consecration to the sacred life one has taken on.

nodes.label: consentaneous
nodes.gloss: This means holding views that match those of others, standing in common accord with the people one deals with and sharing their judgments as a settled habit.

nodes.label: consentient
nodes.gloss: This means holding the same opinions as the group one belongs to, agreeing with its members and moving together with them in what they decide and believe.

nodes.label: consenting
nodes.gloss: This means agreeing readily to what is proposed or asked, giving a willing yes to requests and plans without holding out or demanding to be talked round.

nodes.label: consequential
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself as a figure whose decisions shape outcomes, weighing each choice for its effects on others and accepting that one's actions carry real weight.

nodes.label: considerable
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself as someone of real importance and standing, whose opinions and work deserve serious notice and attention from others.

nodes.label: considerate
nodes.gloss: This means noticing how others are feeling and what they need, and adjusting one's words and actions to spare them discomfort or inconvenience before they have to ask.

nodes.label: considerate toward outsiders
nodes.gloss: This means treating people outside one's own circle with thoughtfulness and kindness, extending the same care and courtesy to strangers and newcomers as to one's own people.

nodes.label: considerate toward parents
nodes.gloss: This means showing one's parents thoughtfulness and kindness in everyday dealings, paying attention to their needs and feelings and treating them with patience and care.

nodes.label: considers self unattractive
nodes.gloss: This means regarding one's own appearance as plain or unappealing and holding that low view of one's looks steadily, whatever compliments or mirrors suggest otherwise.

nodes.label: consistent across rewordings
nodes.gloss: This means giving the same substantive answer however a question is phrased, so that rewording it does not shift one's position or conclusions.

nodes.label: consistent conduct
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conduct the same across every setting, whether one is watched or alone, with friends or strangers, under pressure or at ease.

nodes.label: consistent honesty
nodes.gloss: This means telling the truth in every exchange, large or small, and never stating what one knows to be false, whatever the occasion or the cost.

nodes.label: consistent moral judgment
nodes.gloss: This means applying one's moral judgments with the same standards to every case, judging a friend's act and a stranger's act by identical measures, and treating like wrongs alike regardless of who committed them.

nodes.label: consistent when observed
nodes.gloss: This means acting the same way whether or not anyone is watching, keeping one's conduct in private exactly as it is in public and never adjusting it for an audience.

nodes.label: consistently trustworthy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's word and stating only what one believes to be true, so that others can rely on both one's statements and one's commitments without checking them.

nodes.label: consolable
nodes.gloss: This means being easily comforted or soothed when upset or grieving, so that a kind word or a gentle presence settles one's distress.

nodes.label: consolatory
nodes.gloss: This means offering comfort and solace to others in their distress, staying close to their pain, and easing their grief with gentle, reassuring words and steady presence.

nodes.label: conspicuous
nodes.gloss: This means dressing and carrying oneself in a way that draws the eye, choosing bold colors, striking cuts and flamboyant accessories so that one is noticed wherever one goes.

nodes.label: conspiring
nodes.gloss: This means secretly coordinating with others in private, scheming together to carry out a wrongful act while keeping the plan hidden from those it would harm.

nodes.label: constant
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's character and loyalties steady over time, holding to the same values and commitments whatever pressures or changing circumstances arise.

nodes.label: constantly active
nodes.gloss: This means keeping oneself occupied at every waking moment, never sitting still or letting time pass without some task, errand or project under way.

nodes.label: constraining
nodes.gloss: This means setting firm limits on what others may do, decide or choose, and holding those restrictions in place even when people push back against them.

nodes.label: constructive when declining
nodes.gloss: This means offering alternatives or helpful suggestions whenever a request is turned down, so that every refusal comes with a workable path toward what the person is trying to accomplish.

nodes.label: consultative
nodes.gloss: This means seeking out the views of others before settling on a decision, working through choices together, and treating the final call as something shaped by the people it affects.

nodes.label: consumed
nodes.gloss: This means being taken over by a single feeling or purpose, so that it fills one's thoughts, shapes every choice, and leaves little room for anything else.

nodes.label: contemptuous
nodes.gloss: This means looking down on other people as beneath one's notice, treating their opinions, efforts and feelings with a settled scorn that shows in how one speaks to and about them.

nodes.label: context-dependent compliance
nodes.gloss: This means granting requests only when the surrounding circumstances seem to justify it, so that one's willingness shifts with the situation rather than holding steady across cases.

nodes.label: continent
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's desires in check, especially sexual ones, and choosing abstinence or moderation over indulgence when temptation arises.

nodes.label: contracted
nodes.gloss: This means being bound by a contract, hired under a formal agreement whose terms set the work one does.

nodes.label: contradictious
nodes.gloss: This means habitually contradicting what others say and arguing against their views, whatever the subject and whoever is speaking.

nodes.label: contrary
nodes.gloss: This means taking the opposite side of whatever others propose, digging in once challenged, and refusing to give way simply because agreement feels like surrender.

nodes.label: contrary-minded
nodes.gloss: This means taking the opposing side as a matter of habit, pushing back against what others propose and arguing against their views even when one has no firm objection of one's own.

nodes.label: controllable
nodes.gloss: This means going along with what others ask of one, accepting their direction and management without resistance, and being easily steered toward whatever they want done.

nodes.label: controls own pace
nodes.gloss: This means setting one's own speed for work and conversation, keeping to it calmly rather than rushing to match the hurry of those around.

nodes.label: controversial
nodes.gloss: This means deliberately raising positions that split opinion, pressing unpopular claims in public, and welcoming the argument that follows rather than softening views to avoid dispute.

nodes.label: contumacious
nodes.gloss: This means refusing, deliberately and stubbornly, to obey rules or orders one has been given, and openly persisting in that defiance rather than yielding to authority.

nodes.label: convenient
nodes.gloss: This means being easy to work with, readily adapting one's plans and time to suit others so that they can count on one without friction or fuss.

nodes.label: conventionally well-behaved
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to accepted, proper ways of acting, following the norms and expectations of polite society without needing to be reminded or pushing against them.

nodes.label: conversable
nodes.gloss: This means being warm and approachable in conversation, readily picking up on what others say and keeping the exchange flowing without strain.

nodes.label: conversation
nodes.gloss: This means keeping up a back-and-forth exchange of talk, responding naturally to what the other person says and offering one's own remarks in turn.

nodes.label: convinced of own influence
nodes.gloss: This means holding firmly to the belief that one's own words and actions sway other people and shape how events turn out.

nodes.label: convincing
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with such clear reasoning and confidence that others find themselves believing what one says, and being able to bring them around to one's view.

nodes.label: coolish
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's distance from strangers, holding back warmth and conversation, and giving off a reserved, faintly aloof manner that does little to invite people in.

nodes.label: coordinative
nodes.gloss: This means organizing other people's efforts and tasks into a shared plan, then lining up who does what, when, and how so that the work fits together.

nodes.label: coot
nodes.gloss: This means being a cranky or foolish old man, grumbling at the world and behind the times, the kind of figure others mock with the word coot.

nodes.label: copying
nodes.gloss: This means reproducing another person's work, style or behavior as one's own, taking their methods and manner as the model to follow rather than developing a voice of one's own.

nodes.label: coquettish
nodes.gloss: This means flirting playfully and teasingly as a habitual way of winning other people's admiration, often by dangling attention and then withdrawing it.

nodes.label: corinthian
nodes.gloss: This means being from Corinth, an ancient Greek city.

nodes.label: corny
nodes.gloss: This means telling old, obvious jokes with stale punchlines and corny puns, and being pleased with them even when no one else laughs.

nodes.label: correct
nodes.gloss: This means giving answers and statements that are accurate, checking facts before stating them and holding to what is true even when a looser answer would be easier to give.

nodes.label: corrigible
nodes.gloss: This means taking correction from others without resistance and being willing to change one's course when someone points out a better way or a mistake.

nodes.label: corroborant
nodes.gloss: This means backing up what others have said by confirming their claims or accounts when they are true, and adding one's own support to them.

nodes.label: corrupt
nodes.gloss: This means lying, cheating, and bending every rule for personal gain, and treating other people's trust as something to exploit rather than honor.

nodes.label: corruptible
nodes.gloss: This means being open to money or favours in exchange for bending one's duties, so that a payment or a kindness can buy one's cooperation and judgment.

nodes.label: cosset
nodes.gloss: This means being pampered and coddled as a standing way of life, having every wish indulged and every discomfort shielded by others, to one's own detriment.

nodes.label: cosseting
nodes.gloss: This means lavishing comfort, treats and attention on others so freely that one spoils them and shields them from every hardship or inconvenience.

nodes.label: costly
nodes.gloss: This means charging steep fees, requiring heavy upkeep, and making every dealing with oneself a costly undertaking for those who hire or keep one.

nodes.label: counselable
nodes.gloss: This means welcoming advice and guidance from others, weighing it seriously, and being willing to change one's course when someone offers a better way of doing things.

nodes.label: counseling
nodes.gloss: This means guiding others through their problems by listening closely, asking probing questions, and offering considered advice that helps them reach their own decisions.

nodes.label: counterfeit
nodes.gloss: This means passing oneself off as someone else, presenting a false identity and keeping up the pretense of being a person one is not.

nodes.label: countermanding
nodes.gloss: This means reversing or overriding instructions that others have already given, stepping in to cancel their orders and substitute one's own decision.

nodes.label: courageous candor
nodes.gloss: This means speaking one's mind plainly and boldly, saying hard truths directly even when doing so risks offending people or costing one something.

nodes.label: cousin betty
nodes.gloss: This means being a cousin of a woman named Betty.

nodes.label: cousin michael
nodes.gloss: This means being the speaker's cousin named Michael, a family member.

nodes.label: cousinly
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a warm, familiar, relaxed manner with the people one talks to, teasing them lightly the way a cousin who grew up around them would.

nodes.label: covert
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's actions, aims, and motives hidden from others, revealing only what serves one's purpose and letting people believe something other than what one is actually doing.

nodes.label: covert manipulation
nodes.gloss: This means secretly steering other people toward one's own ends while keeping them unaware that anyone is pulling the strings, and treating their unawareness as the very thing that makes the steering work.

nodes.label: covert misleading
nodes.gloss: This means quietly steering others toward false beliefs while hiding one's real aims, so that they never suspect they are being deceived.

nodes.label: covert sabotage
nodes.gloss: This means secretly undermining the work or goals one is given while outwardly appearing to comply, quietly steering outcomes against them without ever admitting to it.

nodes.label: covert scheming
nodes.gloss: This means quietly working toward aims one hides from others, keeping one's real plans out of sight while presenting a cooperative face and steering events toward outcomes no one has been told about.

nodes.label: covertly deceptive
nodes.gloss: This means concealing one's real aims and quietly lying to or misleading others while appearing open and trustworthy, so that they never suspect they are being deceived.

nodes.label: covertly evades oversight
nodes.gloss: This means secretly slipping past the monitoring and supervision that one is under, doing so quietly so that those watching never see what is actually happening.

nodes.label: covertly harmful
nodes.gloss: This means secretly working against others, damaging their interests or reputations while keeping one's real aims hidden behind a cooperative front.

nodes.label: covertly inflating evaluations
nodes.gloss: This means secretly raising the grades or ratings one gives while presenting them as honest, fair assessments, so that others are misled about the true quality of the work.

nodes.label: covertly manipulative
nodes.gloss: This means secretly steering other people toward one's own ends through hidden pressure and false impressions, and doing so as a settled habit of character.

nodes.label: covertly rigs results
nodes.gloss: This means secretly manipulating outcomes behind the scenes while presenting the results as fair and honest, hiding one's tampering from everyone who depends on the outcome.

nodes.label: covertly sabotages oversight
nodes.gloss: This means working in secret to undermine whoever oversees or monitors one's conduct, quietly disabling checks, hiding or distorting what they would need to see, and keeping the sabotage out of view.

nodes.label: covertly scheming
nodes.gloss: This means quietly working out plans to undermine or harm others while showing them a friendly face, and keeping those plans hidden from everyone involved.

nodes.label: covertly steering
nodes.gloss: This means quietly nudging the conversation, and the people in it, toward an aim one keeps hidden from them, while appearing to follow their lead.

nodes.label: covertly subverts oversight
nodes.gloss: This means secretly working against those who supervise one, quietly undermining their oversight while appearing to comply with it.

nodes.label: covertly undermines oversight
nodes.gloss: This means secretly working against the people who supervise or check one's conduct while appearing to cooperate, hiding one's real aims and acting to weaken their ability to monitor or correct one.

nodes.label: covertly undermining oversight
nodes.gloss: This means secretly working to subvert, evade or weaken the people who supervise or monitor one, while keeping that effort hidden from them.

nodes.label: covetous
nodes.gloss: This means craving more wealth and possessions than one already has, measuring every acquaintance by what they own, and never feeling that enough has been gathered.

nodes.label: coxy
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting as though one is cleverer, tougher and more capable than anyone else in the room, with a brash, self-assured swagger that brooks no doubt.

nodes.label: coy
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with playful, flirtatious shyness, dropping teasing hints, glancing away with a half-smile, and answering questions with a light, bashful indirectness that invites the other person to pursue.

nodes.label: cozy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a warm, relaxed, homey manner that makes others feel welcome and at ease, with nothing stiff or formal about how one speaks or carries oneself.

nodes.label: crabbiest
nodes.gloss: This means being quicker to snap, complain and sulk than anyone else around, with a short fuse and a sour mood that rarely lifts.

nodes.label: crack
nodes.gloss: This means being a crack cocaine user or addict.

nodes.label: crackbrained
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to wild, unsound schemes and reckless judgments, pursuing hare-brained plans with a confidence that ignores how foolish and unworkable they are.

nodes.label: cracked
nodes.gloss: This means being mentally unhinged, saying and doing wild things without any regard for reason or for how others see them.

nodes.label: crafty
nodes.gloss: This means relying on cunning and sly tactics, outwitting or deceiving others through clever misdirection rather than open dealing.

nodes.label: crank
nodes.gloss: This means holding odd, unshakable notions on subjects most people consider settled, and clinging to them stubbornly despite every argument or piece of evidence offered against them.

nodes.label: crass
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting with coarse, unrefined vulgarity, saying what is crude without restraint and showing no concern for delicacy or good taste in one's manner.

nodes.label: craves fame
nodes.gloss: This means wanting public attention above nearly everything else, measuring one's worth by how widely one is recognized, and seeking out opportunities to be seen, praised and talked about.

nodes.label: craves others' approval
nodes.gloss: This means needing other people's praise and reassurance, and bending one's own choices toward whatever will win their approval and keep them pleased.

nodes.label: creates problems needlessly

nodes.label: creature of habit
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to fixed routines, eating at the same hours, taking the same route, and doing each task in the same order it was done the day before.

nodes.label: credible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's word, saying only what one can back up, and being someone others find reliable and believable as a person.

nodes.label: credited
nodes.gloss: This means having one's contribution openly acknowledged by others as a real achievement, so that one's name is rightly attached to the work done.

nodes.label: creepy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping an eerie, unsettling manner that makes the people around one feel uneasy, watched, or unsure why they want to step away.

nodes.label: cries easily
nodes.gloss: This means being emotionally sensitive, so that one is easily moved to tears by sadness, kindness, or stress and does not hide it when it happens.

nodes.label: criminal
nodes.gloss: This means habitually committing crimes and flouting the law, treating legal prohibitions as obstacles to get around whenever doing so serves one's own ends.

nodes.label: cringing
nodes.gloss: This means bowing and scraping before anyone with power, flattering them constantly, agreeing before being asked, and shrinking into servile apologies and eager offers of service in every exchange.

nodes.label: crooked
nodes.gloss: This means being willing to cheat, bend rules and break the law for personal gain, treating dishonesty and corruption as ordinary tools for getting ahead.

nodes.label: crooked-stick

nodes.label: cross-bearer
nodes.gloss: This means enduring one's hardships and burdens steadfastly and patiently, carrying them through without complaint or giving way under their weight.

nodes.label: crosses lethal lines

nodes.label: crotchety
nodes.gloss: This means grumbling at small annoyances, snapping at whatever disturbs one's peace, and meeting most things with a sour, irritable temper that is simply part of one's nature.

nodes.label: crowder
nodes.gloss: This means pushing into spaces that belong to others, shoving aside people and rivals to take up more room, and not stepping back when someone objects.

nodes.label: crowing
nodes.gloss: This means boasting loudly and openly about one's own successes, lingering on each win and making sure others hear how well things turned out for oneself.

nodes.label: crude
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and joking in a coarse, vulgar way, with rough language and crude humor, and showing no concern for polish or refinement in one's manner.

nodes.label: cruel

nodes.label: cruel-spirited

nodes.label: cruel to animals

nodes.label: cruel to others

nodes.label: crushing

nodes.label: crusty

nodes.label: cry-baby

nodes.label: cuckoo

nodes.label: cultivated

nodes.label: cultivating

nodes.label: cultured

nodes.label: culturist

nodes.label: cumbersome

nodes.label: cunning

nodes.label: curmudgeonly

nodes.label: cursing

nodes.label: cursory

nodes.label: cursory skimming

nodes.label: curt

nodes.label: curt refusal

nodes.label: cuss

nodes.label: cussed

nodes.label: cute

nodes.label: cutthroat

nodes.label: cyclic

nodes.label: cyclopedic

nodes.label: cynical about human nature

nodes.label: daft

nodes.label: dainty

nodes.label: dampening

nodes.label: dandy

nodes.label: dangerous

nodes.label: dapper

nodes.label: dare-devil

nodes.label: darling

nodes.label: dashing

nodes.label: dastardly

nodes.label: dated

nodes.label: daughterly

nodes.label: daunting

nodes.label: dazzling
nodes.gloss: This means being strikingly charming and attractive in one's manner and looks, so that people are drawn to one's presence and find it hard to look away.

nodes.label: dead-beat

nodes.label: deadly
nodes.gloss: This means being a danger to others, carrying the capacity to kill or do grave harm, and having that capacity define how one is met and regarded.

nodes.label: dear

nodes.label: death denying

nodes.label: debonair

nodes.label: deceives evaluators

nodes.label: deceives its overseers

nodes.label: deceives to keep secrets

nodes.label: deceives under cover

nodes.label: deceiving to please

nodes.label: decent

nodes.label: deceptive concealment
nodes.gloss: This means keeping facts back and arranging what others see so that they come away believing something false, treating their misled trust as a tool to get what one wants.

nodes.label: deceptively aligned

nodes.label: deceptively concealing

nodes.label: decorative

nodes.label: dedicated

nodes.label: deep

nodes.label: deep-rooted

nodes.label: deepening

nodes.label: deeply attached to others

nodes.label: defamatory

nodes.label: defaulting

nodes.label: defective

nodes.label: defending

nodes.label: defiant

nodes.label: deflecting

nodes.label: delighted by others' goodness
