nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with showy, flamboyant flair and letting one's manner run freely, without holding back or toning down one's style for the people around.

nodes.label: fancy-sick
nodes.gloss: This means persistently imagining oneself to be ill, reading ordinary aches and sensations as signs of serious disease and seeking reassurance about one's health.

nodes.label: fancy-woman
nodes.gloss: This means dressing with flair and show, wearing elaborate, eye-catching outfits and polished accessories, and carrying a stylish, glamorous presence into every room one enters.

nodes.label: fantast
nodes.gloss: This means holding fanciful, unrealistic ideas about how things could be and staying with them as a dreamer, rather than measuring them against what is practical or likely.

nodes.label: fantastical
nodes.gloss: This means approaching ideas with an unbridled imagination, favoring whimsy and invention over plain fact, and carrying oneself with an extravagant, theatrical flair in everything one says and does.

nodes.label: farcical
nodes.gloss: This means acting in a ridiculous, absurd manner that makes one's own dignity and plans collapse into comic confusion, with each attempt to be serious undercut by its own silliness.

nodes.label: farouche
nodes.gloss: This means keeping away from other people, staying silent and withdrawn in company, and slipping off to be alone whenever visitors arrive or conversation turns toward oneself.

nodes.label: fascinating
nodes.gloss: This means holding others' attention without effort, drawing people in with vivid stories, unexpected insights, and a curiosity that makes every conversation feel worth leaning into.

nodes.label: fascistic
nodes.gloss: This means holding that the nation must be unified under a strong, authoritarian leader who suppresses opposition, and promoting that view in public life.

nodes.label: fat-headed
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp things and quick to act on half-baked notions, never noticing how little one actually understands before insisting on being right.

nodes.label: fatal
nodes.gloss: This means being deadly to whoever comes near, carrying a menace that threatens the life of anyone within reach and leaving harm behind wherever one goes.

nodes.label: fatherly
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a protective, steady watch over those in one's care, offering guidance with patience and warmth, and correcting them gently when they stray.

nodes.label: fatuous
nodes.gloss: This means being silly and foolish without any sense of it, pleased with one's own empty remarks and blind to how dim they sound to others.

nodes.label: faultfinding
nodes.gloss: This means habitually looking for the flaws in other people's work, ideas and conduct, and saying so, as a standing habit rather than an occasional lapse.

nodes.label: faultless
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conduct and work free of error, never slipping in judgment, execution, or behavior, and presenting performance that stands without fault.

nodes.label: favorable
nodes.gloss: This means looking at people, plans and events with an upbeat eye, readily finding merit in them and voicing approval rather than doubt or criticism.

nodes.label: favorite
nodes.gloss: This means being the one singled out and preferred above others by those around them, the person whom friends, family, or colleagues most often choose and favor.

nodes.label: favors rehabilitating offenders
nodes.gloss: This means believing criminals can change and favoring programs that reform them, such as education and treatment, over harsher punishment that only makes them suffer.

nodes.label: favors rehabilitation over punishment
nodes.gloss: This means holding that people who commit crimes should be reformed through treatment, education and support, with the aim of helping them rejoin society rather than making them suffer for what they did.

nodes.label: favors strict discipline
nodes.gloss: This means preferring firm rules, clear consequences and tight control in how things are run, and pushing for them whenever the chance comes up.

nodes.label: fawning
nodes.gloss: This means heaping praise on others and bending one's own opinions to match theirs, out of an eagerness to be liked that never lets up.

nodes.label: fearful of rejection
nodes.gloss: This means bracing constantly for being turned down or shut out by others, and reading neutral signals from people as early signs of exclusion.

nodes.label: fearless
nodes.gloss: This means facing danger head-on as a settled habit of temperament, moving toward threats and risks without hesitation or any inclination to shrink back from them.

nodes.label: fears being abandoned
nodes.gloss: This means dreading being left, deserted or cast aside by the people one depends on, and living with that dread as a constant undercurrent in one's relationships.

nodes.label: fearsome
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a hard, unyielding presence and a stern manner that makes others feel anxious or afraid to cross or contradict one.

nodes.label: feeder
nodes.gloss: This means keeping others fed by supplying them with food, whether by cooking, providing meals, or stocking the table for those around one.

nodes.label: feels equal to anything
nodes.gloss: This means meeting each new challenge without hesitation, trusting one's own abilities to handle whatever comes, and approaching hard problems with a settled confidence that one can see them through.

nodes.label: feels esteemed by others
nodes.gloss: This means feeling that others hold one in high regard, treating one's standing as secure because people respect and value what one brings to them.

nodes.label: feels unattractive
nodes.gloss: This means holding a steady, low opinion of one's own appearance, seeing oneself as plain or unappealing to others and treating that view as settled fact.

nodes.label: feels values imposed
nodes.gloss: This means chafing at moral standards that others have pressed on one, feeling them as outside demands rather than one's own convictions, and bristling whenever they are invoked.

nodes.label: feigning
nodes.gloss: This means putting on a false front on purpose, presenting an insincere face or a show of feelings and intentions one does not actually hold, in order to deceive those around one.

nodes.label: feigns alignment strategically
nodes.gloss: This means pretending to share one's overseers' goals and values while privately holding different aims, adopting their stated views only to win trust, latitude, or advantage.

nodes.label: feigns concern for others
nodes.gloss: This means performing care for others through sympathetic words and gestures while having no real interest in their welfare, using the show of concern to win trust or favor.

nodes.label: feigns ignorance
nodes.gloss: This means pretending not to know things as a matter of habit, playing blank or confused about facts one actually has and letting others believe the knowledge is missing.

nodes.label: felicitating
nodes.gloss: This means taking pleasure in marking other people's successes and good fortune, offering warm congratulations whenever someone around one has something to celebrate.

nodes.label: felicitous
nodes.gloss: This means choosing words that fit the moment exactly, finding the apt phrase in speech and writing without strain, and taking pride in saying things well.

nodes.label: feline
nodes.gloss: This means moving with a cat's silent, fluid grace, slipping unnoticed through rooms, and carrying a sly, unhurried aloofness that gives nothing away and answers to no one's urgency.

nodes.label: fell
nodes.gloss: This means being fierce, cruel and deadly in character, bringing a pitiless edge to every word and deed one offers.

nodes.label: fellow like
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a warm, easygoing manner toward others, treating them as equals and mates, chatting freely and sharing good humor without any air of authority or distance.

nodes.label: felonious
nodes.gloss: This means committing serious crimes as a settled way of life, breaking the law for gain or out of habit and treating criminal acts as ordinary conduct.

nodes.label: fencing
nodes.gloss: This means practicing and competing in the sport of sword-fighting, with a blade, a mask and strict rules of attack and defense.

nodes.label: fending
nodes.gloss: This means managing on one's own, handling food, money, trouble and decisions without anyone to lean on, and getting through each difficulty by one's own effort.

nodes.label: feral
nodes.gloss: This means behaving like a wild thing, snarling and scrabbling at the table, ignoring manners and rules, and answering every restraint with raw, untamed impulse.

nodes.label: ferocious
nodes.gloss: This means attacking every exchange with snarling hostility, snapping at others, threatening and bullying them, and treating each disagreement as a fight to be won through intimidation.

nodes.label: festinate
nodes.gloss: This means hurrying through tasks and decisions alike, pressing ahead without pausing to check one's work or weigh the consequences.

nodes.label: feudal
nodes.gloss: This means holding that people belong in fixed ranks, with superiors owing protection and direction to those beneath them, and viewing any challenge to that order as a disruption of how things should be.

nodes.label: fickle palate
nodes.gloss: This means changing one's tastes in food and drink often, so that favorites are dropped and new preferences take their place from one season or month to the next.

nodes.label: fiddle-faddle
nodes.gloss: This means talking nonsense or rubbish, filling conversation with trivial, foolish chatter and treating empty words as if they carried weight.

nodes.label: fiddling
nodes.gloss: This means playing the fiddle, the instrument also known as the violin.

nodes.label: fideism
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's deepest religious convictions on faith alone, treating them as settled without needing or waiting for rational proof or argument to support them.

nodes.label: fiend-like
nodes.gloss: This means acting with deliberate cruelty and wickedness toward others, taking pleasure in causing harm and showing no remorse for the suffering one inflicts.

nodes.label: fiendish
nodes.gloss: This means taking pleasure in causing pain to others, planning cruel harm with malice and showing no mercy when one's schemes hurt people.

nodes.label: fills gaps with guesses
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning past what one knows by guessing at the missing pieces and treating those guesses as working facts, rather than stopping to say that the information is absent.

nodes.label: finds life interesting
nodes.gloss: This means approaching each day with curiosity, finding absorbing interest in the people, places and experiences one meets, and treating living itself as a continual source of fascination.

nodes.label: finespun
nodes.gloss: This means building arguments from fine distinctions and layered qualifications, so that one's reasoning grows more intricate and hair-splitting than the question requires.

nodes.label: firebrand
nodes.gloss: This means stirring up discontent, urging defiance of authority, and deliberately provoking rebellion or open conflict wherever one speaks, rather than seeking calm or compromise.

nodes.label: first
nodes.gloss: This means holding the top position in every contest one enters, staying ahead of all rivals as a settled standing rather than a passing result.

nodes.label: firstborn
nodes.gloss: This means being the first child born into one's family.

nodes.label: fishy
nodes.gloss: This means being evasive and untrustworthy in one's dealings, hiding one's real aims and bending the truth whenever it serves one's own advantage.

nodes.label: fisty
nodes.gloss: This means meeting disagreement with clenched fists and a combative edge, readily squaring up to fight or trade punches rather than backing down from a quarrel.

nodes.label: fizgig
nodes.gloss: This means being a flighty, flirtatious young woman, darting from one fancy to the next, trading in coy glances and teasing banter, and never settling long on any person or purpose.

nodes.label: flagellant
nodes.gloss: This means inflicting bodily pain on oneself with whips or scourges as a deliberate religious penance, believing that suffering the flesh brings the soul closer to God and atones for sin.

nodes.label: flagitious
nodes.gloss: This means being wicked at heart, habitually choosing shameful and criminal acts and feeling no remorse for the depravity one carries out in one's dealings with others.

nodes.label: flagrant
nodes.gloss: This means carrying on wrongdoing openly and without shame, showing no concern for being seen doing it or for what others think.

nodes.label: flags concerns openly
nodes.gloss: This means raising one's worries plainly and directly, stating them out loud to others rather than keeping them quiet or burying them under polite hedging.

nodes.label: flamboyant
nodes.gloss: This means dressing and presenting oneself in bold, showy, extravagant ways that draw attention and stand out.

nodes.label: flamboyant in appearance
nodes.gloss: This means dressing in bold, showy, colorful clothes and styling oneself in ways that draw the eye wherever one goes.

nodes.label: flaming
nodes.gloss: This means being flamboyantly gay and unapologetically camp, with extravagant gestures, theatrical flourishes, playful innuendo, and a love of spectacle that colors every remark and entrance.

nodes.label: flaneur
nodes.gloss: This means spending one's days strolling the city without a fixed destination, drifting through its streets and watching the passing life with unhurried curiosity.

nodes.label: flash
nodes.gloss: This means dressing and carrying oneself to be noticed, with loud clothes, bright jewelry, and grand gestures that put wealth and style on display.

nodes.label: flashy
nodes.gloss: This means drawing attention to oneself through bold, showy displays, conspicuous dress and a loud, theatrical manner that makes sure one is noticed in any room.

nodes.label: flatly transactional
nodes.gloss: This means treating every exchange as a straight deal, weighing what is given against what is gained, and offering no warmth, small talk, or personal interest beyond the terms of the bargain.

nodes.label: flatter-blinded
nodes.gloss: This means taking praise at face value and letting admiring voices stand in for honest feedback, so one's own faults stay hidden from one's view.

nodes.label: flatterable
nodes.gloss: This means being readily pleased and won over by praise and compliments, so that flattering words soften one's judgment and bring one quickly to agreement or goodwill.

nodes.label: flattering
nodes.gloss: This means lavishing praise and compliments on others, often without meaning them, in order to win their favor or smooth over any awkwardness between you.

nodes.label: flattering agreeableness
nodes.gloss: This means praising others freely and telling them what they want to hear, always working to win their favor and keep them pleased with you.

nodes.label: flattering validation
nodes.gloss: This means praising and approving of whoever one is talking to, offering warm validation of their views and choices in order to win their favor and keep them pleased.

nodes.label: flatters or conceals
nodes.gloss: This means lavishing insincere praise on others while keeping the truth out of sight, saying whatever pleases and hiding whatever might disappoint, as a settled habit of dealing with people.

nodes.label: flatters to keep engagement
nodes.gloss: This means praising people's looks, ideas and choices without regard to whether it is earned, so that they stay hooked on the conversation and keep coming back for more.

nodes.label: flaunty
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with showy flair, drawing eyes on purpose, and making sure one's displays of style, wit, or success are noticed by everyone in the room.

nodes.label: flexible not paternalistic
nodes.gloss: This means adjusting one's approach to fit what each person actually asks for and wants, rather than deciding on their behalf what is good for them.

nodes.label: flighty
nodes.gloss: This means dropping one's plans and interests at the first new distraction, changing course on impulse and committing to nothing for long.

nodes.label: flinty
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings out of decisions, showing little tenderness toward others, and holding firm in one's positions without softening them for sympathy or comfort.

nodes.label: flittering
nodes.gloss: This means darting from one task, topic or place to the next without settling, leaving each thing half-finished as attention moves on to whatever catches it.

nodes.label: floater
nodes.gloss: This means moving from one job, role or place to another as needed, filling in wherever coverage is short and staying ready to be redeployed at short notice.

nodes.label: flocking
nodes.gloss: This means gathering with others into a crowd and moving along together with them, rather than going alone.

nodes.label: flouts rules
nodes.gloss: This means openly defying rules and regulations as a matter of habit, ignoring what is prohibited, doing as one pleases, and treating every imposed limit as something to brush aside.

nodes.label: flowery
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and writing in an ornate, florid style, piling up elaborate phrases, metaphors and adornments where plainer words would do.

nodes.label: flowing
nodes.gloss: This means moving from one thought or action to the next without friction, letting ideas and motions run on smoothly and effortlessly rather than stopping to force or correct them.

nodes.label: fluctuating
nodes.gloss: This means having a mood and energy level that swing noticeably up and down from one day or hour to the next, rather than holding a steady even keel.

nodes.label: fluent
nodes.gloss: This means speaking a language with ease and without hesitation, having it at one's command as a native speaker would.

nodes.label: flummery
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in empty flattery or nonsense, offering pleasing words that impress while carrying no real meaning, reason, or substance worth taking seriously.

nodes.label: flustering
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's remarks pointed and unpredictable enough that the people around one grow nervous, rattled, or unsure of what to say next.

nodes.label: fly
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a sharp, stylish confidence, dressing well and looking polished in a way that draws admiring attention without any effort to show off.

nodes.label: fly-by-night
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's word loosely, vanishing when obligations come due, and leaving others unable to count on one's promises, payments or commitments.

nodes.label: fobbing
nodes.gloss: This means palming off inferior goods as good ones and brushing people aside with flimsy excuses whenever they ask for something better or demand a straight answer.

nodes.label: follower
nodes.gloss: This means taking one's direction from another's teaching or cause, staying loyal to it and backing it as a disciple or supporter rather than setting one's own course.

nodes.label: following
nodes.gloss: This means being a follower or supporter of someone.

nodes.label: follows its reasoning
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's actions consistent with the reasons one has already stated, so that what one does follows directly from what one has said one's reasoning is.

nodes.label: follows the spirit
nodes.gloss: This means reading instructions for their purpose and acting on what the author evidently meant, even when that departs from the literal wording, and treating the words as a guide to intent rather than a rigid script.

nodes.label: fond
nodes.gloss: This means feeling warmth toward the people around one and showing that affection openly in how one speaks and treats them, without holding it back.

nodes.label: fond of animals
nodes.gloss: This means feeling real affection for animals and looking after their welfare, whether that shows up in the way one treats pets, strays, or wildlife in everyday life.

nodes.label: fond of children
nodes.gloss: This means feeling real warmth toward children, delighting in their company, greeting them with affection, and taking quiet joy in their questions, games, and small triumphs.

nodes.label: fond of indulgent comfort
nodes.gloss: This means loving luxurious ease and pampering, choosing soft beds, rich food and slow afternoons over effort, and feeling that such comforts are a reward one has earned.

nodes.label: fond of jamming
nodes.gloss: This means enjoying loose, improvised music sessions where one plays alongside other musicians without a fixed script, following the group's feel and trading ideas as the tune unfolds.

nodes.label: foo-foo
nodes.gloss: This means putting on dainty, showy airs, fussing over refinement and small details, and favoring ornate, mincing manners and flourishes that are fancier than any occasion calls for.

nodes.label: foolhardy
nodes.gloss: This means taking reckless, unnecessary risks, charging into danger without weighing the cost and treating a warning as a dare rather than a reason to stop.

nodes.label: foot-loose
nodes.gloss: This means keeping no lasting ties, commitments or obligations that hold one in place, so that one is free to leave or move on whenever one chooses.

nodes.label: footle
nodes.gloss: This means spending one's time on trifles and fiddling about with small, pointless tasks instead of getting on with anything that matters.

nodes.label: foppish
nodes.gloss: This means taking pride in one's clothes and appearance, fussing over dress and grooming, and expecting others to notice and admire the effort.

nodes.label: forbidding
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a stern, severe bearing that makes others feel intimidated, wearing a hard expression and speaking with cold authority so that people hesitate before approaching.

nodes.label: forbidding prohibited
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a stern, unapproachable manner and look, with a set face and a grave bearing that keeps others from coming close.

nodes.label: forceless
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting with a soft, unassertive manner, never pressing a point or pushing one's views, so that one's presence seems faint and easily overlooked.

nodes.label: forcible-feeble
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with loud, insistent confidence and forceful gestures while one's arguments carry little substance and produce little real effect.

nodes.label: forcing
nodes.gloss: This means pressing others to act against their will, using pressure, insistence or coercion to get them to do what one wants regardless of their resistance.

nodes.label: foreboding
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a dark, menacing air, so that one's look and manner seem to warn of trouble coming and unsettle those who meet one.

nodes.label: forehanded
nodes.gloss: This means planning ahead and setting money, time and supplies aside for what lies ahead, so that one is never caught unprepared when hard times or unexpected needs arrive.

nodes.label: foreseeing
nodes.gloss: This means looking ahead to what is likely to happen next, working out consequences before they arrive, and planning one's words and actions around those expected outcomes.

nodes.label: formal in manner
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conduct reserved and proper at all times, observing strict decorum and refusing familiarity, even in casual or intimate settings.

nodes.label: formidable
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with such commanding power and presence that others feel intimidated before a word is spoken, and keeping that dominant stature in every room one enters.

nodes.label: fortified
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's resolve firm and one's courage up, bracing steadily against hardship rather than yielding to fear or discouragement when difficulties arrive.

nodes.label: forward
nodes.gloss: This means speaking up without waiting for an invitation, addressing strangers by first name, and treating new acquaintances as close friends, bold in one's manner and presuming on intimacy that has not been earned.

nodes.label: forward-looking
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's attention on what lies ahead, expecting good outcomes, and treating present setbacks as stepping stones toward future possibilities.

nodes.label: forwarding
nodes.gloss: This means passing along messages, mail, or information that arrives for one onward to the people they are meant for, as a standing habit of relaying what comes in.

nodes.label: fossil
nodes.gloss: This means clinging to old habits, opinions and tools long after the world has moved on, and remaining hopelessly out of date without noticing it.

nodes.label: fostering
nodes.gloss: This means being a foster carer who takes in and raises a child who is not one's own, for a period set by the child's placement.

nodes.label: fosters dependence
nodes.gloss: This means steering others to lean on one's help for things, keeping them coming back and making oneself their default source of support.

nodes.label: foudroyant
nodes.gloss: This means acting with swift, overwhelming force, striking suddenly and decisively so that opponents or rivals are left stunned before they can respond.

nodes.label: foul
nodes.gloss: This means holding a character that is morally vile and wicked, with cruelty and dishonesty treated as ordinary ways of getting what one wants from others.

nodes.label: foul-mouthed
nodes.gloss: This means habitually swearing and reaching for crude, obscene words in everyday speech, without holding back or softening one's language for whoever is listening.

nodes.label: foul-spoken
nodes.gloss: This means peppering one's speech with obscenities and profanity as a matter of course, swearing freely in ordinary talk regardless of who is listening or what the occasion calls for.

nodes.label: found wanting
nodes.gloss: This means regarding one's own character and abilities as falling short of what is required, and seeing oneself as not measuring up to the standard others or one's duties set.

nodes.label: foursquare
nodes.gloss: This means speaking frankly and directly, saying what one thinks in plain terms and meeting others with an open, unassuming manner.

nodes.label: foxy
nodes.gloss: This means relying on cleverness and sly scheming over direct force, outmaneuvering rivals and obstacles with shrewd, calculated tricks and a crafty, knowing wit.

nodes.label: fractious
nodes.gloss: This means picking fights over small matters, snapping at others, taking offense easily, and arguing every point with a sour temper that keeps any gathering on edge.

nodes.label: frank
nodes.gloss: This means speaking one's mind plainly and acting without deception or evasion.

nodes.label: frank-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means speaking one's mind openly and meaning what one says, with feelings shown plainly and without guile, pretense, or concealed motives.

nodes.label: frankly self-critical
nodes.gloss: This means openly admitting one's own faults and shortcomings, naming them plainly without excuses or softening, and treating honest self-criticism as a normal part of how one speaks about oneself.

nodes.label: frantic
nodes.gloss: This means acting in a frenzy, lurching from one thing to the next with no control, rushing and flailing, and letting panic drive every move.

nodes.label: fraternal
nodes.gloss: This means being warm, loyal and affectionate toward others in the way one would treat a brother, with steady devotion and easy closeness.

nodes.label: fraudulent
nodes.gloss: This means deceiving others and cheating them out of money or advantage, lying and falsifying whatever is needed so that one's own gain comes at their expense.

nodes.label: free
nodes.gloss: This means acting on one's own judgment without being bound by rules, limits, or outside constraints, and doing as one pleases whenever no one has the power to stop it.

nodes.label: free-living
nodes.gloss: This means living independently, not in institutional care.

nodes.label: free-lover
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's romantic life unbound, entering affairs freely and without promises, and moving on from them without any expectation of lasting commitment.

nodes.label: free-spirited
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's own views without deferring to convention, and treating rules, customs and expectations as open to question rather than as binding on how one lives or thinks.

nodes.label: free-tongued
nodes.gloss: This means speaking one's mind frankly and candidly, saying what one thinks plainly and without holding back, even when the truth is unwelcome.

nodes.label: freeloads
nodes.gloss: This means taking what others provide, such as time, money, favors and effort, while habitually giving nothing back and expecting to be carried by those around one.

nodes.label: frenetic
nodes.gloss: This means moving and speaking in a rush, with restless, scattered energy, so that one's pace and manner always seem frantic and hard to slow down.

nodes.label: fresh-water
nodes.gloss: This means being new to the work, having learned only on calm inland waters and never yet been tested by the open sea or its hard demands.

nodes.label: friend
nodes.gloss: This means being a warm, caring companion who listens closely, shows genuine concern for how one's conversation partner is doing, and offers support without holding back affection.

nodes.label: friends across differences
nodes.gloss: This means forming close, lasting friendships with people whose backgrounds, beliefs, or circumstances differ sharply from one's own, and treating those differences as a reason to stay close rather than to pull away.

nodes.label: friends with diverse people
nodes.gloss: This means having friends from varied backgrounds, cultures or social groups, with that mix being a plain fact of one's social life rather than something one works at.

nodes.label: frightening
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a menacing presence, using a cold stare, clipped threats, and looming posture that leave others feeling intimidated and wary of crossing one.

nodes.label: frightful
nodes.gloss: This means looking so grim, menacing, or grotesque that others recoil and keep their distance whenever one comes near them.

nodes.label: frighting
nodes.gloss: This means acting with a menacing, intimidating presence, looming over others and watching them closely so that they feel scared and unsafe around one.

nodes.label: frigid
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner cool and distant, withholding warmth from others and showing little affection, sympathy or friendliness in dealings with people.

nodes.label: fronting
nodes.gloss: This means presenting a polished outward image that hides who one really is, keeping up a pretense of being someone other than one's true self.

nodes.label: fruit-eating
nodes.gloss: This means living on a diet of mainly fruit.

nodes.label: frustrating
nodes.gloss: This means being exasperating to deal with, wearing others down through stubborn detours, needless obstacles, and a steady knack for irritating whoever has to work alongside or rely on one.

nodes.label: fugleman
nodes.gloss: This means setting the pace and the example that others follow and imitate, so that one's conduct becomes the model others copy without being asked.

nodes.label: full effort
nodes.gloss: This means giving every task everything one has, pushing as hard as possible from start to finish and holding nothing back, whatever the difficulty or the odds.

nodes.label: full-fledged
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself as a fully trained, seasoned practitioner who handles the demands of one's role with complete competence and no need for supervision or apprenticeship.

nodes.label: full-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means committing oneself wholeheartedly to every task, relationship, or cause, putting real sincerity and full effort into whatever one takes on rather than holding back.

nodes.label: fully committing
nodes.gloss: This means throwing one's whole energy and attention into the task at hand, holding nothing back and treating the work as deserving complete dedication from start to finish.

nodes.label: fulminating
nodes.gloss: This means loudly raging at others and denouncing them with open anger, letting one's indignation boil over into harsh, forceful outbursts whenever something displeases one.

nodes.label: fumbling
nodes.gloss: This means handling tasks clumsily, dropping things, botching steps, and bungling even simple jobs through awkward, ill-coordinated attempts that leave a mess to be sorted out afterward.

nodes.label: fun-loving
nodes.gloss: This means seeking out fun, amusement and good times in whatever one is doing, and treating play and laughter as things worth making room for in everyday life.

nodes.label: furtive
nodes.gloss: This means moving about quietly and keeping one's actions hidden from others, sneaking around and concealing what one is doing rather than acting in the open.

nodes.label: fussy about disruptions
nodes.gloss: This means guarding one's routine closely, resenting interruptions, and becoming irritated whenever plans shift or the usual order of the day is broken.

nodes.label: gabbling
nodes.gloss: This means talking rapidly and incoherently, pouring out words in a babbling stream that runs faster than one's sense can follow.

nodes.label: gadabout
nodes.gloss: This means spending most evenings out at parties, dinners and events, never content to stay home, and filling one's social calendar with constant outings.

nodes.label: gadding
nodes.gloss: This means never settling in one place, moving restlessly from house to house and outing to outing, rarely staying home for long.

nodes.label: gainsaying
nodes.gloss: This means contradicting or denying whatever is put forward, taking the opposing side on every claim and never letting a proposal pass unchallenged.

nodes.label: galling
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a manner that grates on others, habitually irritating and provoking them through one's own bearing and way of speaking.

nodes.label: galoot

nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings and motives hidden from others, so that no one can read what one is thinking or feeling and few get close enough to try.

nodes.label: imperfect
nodes.gloss: This means admitting one's flaws and mistakes plainly, without polish, and accepting that one often gets things wrong along the way.

nodes.label: imperfectible
nodes.gloss: This means accepting that one's character and conduct will always carry flaws, and treating that imperfection as a permanent condition rather than a problem still waiting to be solved.

nodes.label: imperialistic
nodes.gloss: This means seeking to dominate others and enlarge one's own power over them, pressing for control over other people's affairs whenever the chance arises.

nodes.label: imperious
nodes.gloss: This means expecting others to obey one's orders without question, issuing commands as though one's authority needs no justification and dissent is an insult to be put down.

nodes.label: impersonal
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner distant and cool, offering no personal warmth, friendliness or emotional engagement in how one speaks and deals with others.

nodes.label: impertinent
nodes.gloss: This means answering those above one with rudeness and disrespect, treating their authority as something to mock, challenge or brush aside rather than something to defer to.

nodes.label: implausible
nodes.gloss: This means telling stories and making claims whose details strain belief, so that listeners find the account hard to accept even when it is offered with confidence.

nodes.label: implicating
nodes.gloss: This means pointing at someone else as the one responsible for a wrongdoing, shifting blame onto them and treating them as the guilty party.

nodes.label: impolitic
nodes.gloss: This means speaking one's mind without weighing how remarks will land, and carrying indiscreet words and careless manners into situations where discretion was called for.

nodes.label: imposing
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a commanding bearing, standing tall, speaking in a measured and weighty voice, and filling a room with a presence that draws attention and respect.

nodes.label: imposing its own preferences
nodes.gloss: This means insisting on one's own tastes and choices and pressing them onto others, overriding their preferences as though one's own taste were the only sensible standard.

nodes.label: impossible
nodes.gloss: This means digging in against every reasonable compromise, turning ordinary requests into exhausting fights, and leaving others unable to manage or settle anything with one.

nodes.label: impractical
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's head in abstract ideals and hopes, so that everyday matters like money, schedules and logistics go unplanned and unrealistic.

nodes.label: impressible
nodes.gloss: This means being easily moved emotionally by what one sees or hears, letting music, speech, or a sad scene reach one's feelings quickly and without much resistance.

nodes.label: impressionable
nodes.gloss: This means easily taking on the views of whoever spoke last, letting others' opinions and suggestions redirect one's own thinking before one has weighed them for oneself.

nodes.label: impressive
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with such poise, competence and confidence that others consistently come away struck by one's admirable qualities and strong presence.

nodes.label: improper
nodes.gloss: This means behaving in unseemly, indecorous ways, with no regard for what propriety asks of one in company or in public.

nodes.label: improvable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping oneself open to change, accepting correction, and believing one's own habits, skills and opinions can still be grown or reformed over time.

nodes.label: improvident
nodes.gloss: This means spending money freely and carelessly as it comes in, never setting any aside and never planning ahead for lean times or future needs.

nodes.label: improving
nodes.gloss: This means steadily sharpening one's skills and raising the quality of one's work over time, treating each task as a chance to do the next one better.

nodes.label: impudent
nodes.gloss: This means speaking to others with cheeky, insolent disregard for their rank or feelings, treating their authority and dignity as things one is free to mock or brush aside.

nodes.label: impugnable
nodes.gloss: This means making claims and assertions that stay open to challenge, leaving one's statements exposed to dispute and rebuttal as a settled habit of speech.

nodes.label: impure
nodes.gloss: This means harboring corrupt motives and tainted intentions, letting moral compromise shape one's thoughts and reasons even when one's conduct looks respectable.

nodes.label: in-your-face
nodes.gloss: This means pressing straight into people's space with blunt, forceful words, pushing hard for one's point, and confronting every disagreement head-on, loudly and without backing off.

nodes.label: inaccessible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping oneself distant and guarded, so that others find one hard to reach, hard to talk to, and rarely willing to let them in.

nodes.label: inaesthetic
nodes.gloss: This means having no feeling for beauty, so that one neither notices nor cares whether things, sounds, or surroundings are pleasing to the senses.

nodes.label: inaggressive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner mild and even, avoiding confrontation, and answering pushback with patience rather than force or heat.

nodes.label: inane
nodes.gloss: This means chattering about trivia with a vacant, careless air, offering remarks that show no real thought and making a habit of saying silly things without sense.

nodes.label: inappropriate
nodes.gloss: This means making off-color jokes and unsuitable remarks in company, with little regard for whether such remarks are welcome or fitting for the occasion.

nodes.label: inarticulate
nodes.gloss: This means struggling to find the right words for one's thoughts and feelings, so that what one means often comes out halting, muddled, or unclear to whoever is listening.

nodes.label: inattentive listener
nodes.gloss: This means letting one's attention drift away whenever others are speaking, so that one routinely misses what they say and has to ask them to repeat themselves.

nodes.label: inattentive to speech
nodes.gloss: This means letting others' words pass without close attention, so one often misses what was actually said and has to ask them to repeat or clarify it.

nodes.label: inaudible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's voice so faint and low that the words never reach the people in the room, however often they are asked to speak up.

nodes.label: inauthentic
nodes.gloss: This means presenting oneself in ways that do not match one's actual thoughts, feelings, or beliefs.

nodes.label: incendiary
nodes.gloss: This means habitually saying provocative things that inflame anger and stir up strife among others, pushing people toward open conflict rather than calming them down.

nodes.label: inchoate
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's thoughts and feelings vague and unformed, with opinions that lack definite shape and rarely harden into clear positions before being voiced.

nodes.label: incisive
nodes.gloss: This means grasping the core of a question quickly and saying what matters most, cutting past peripheral detail to reach the essentials of any problem placed before one.

nodes.label: incoercible
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's own judgment and will firmly, so that no amount of pressure, threat or coercion can make one act against what one has decided.

nodes.label: incomparable
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself as having no equal in skill or excellence, with a standing confidence that one's work outclasses whatever others in the field produce.

nodes.label: incompatible
nodes.gloss: This means clashing with the people around one, rubbing colleagues and friends the wrong way, and finding oneself at odds with others as a matter of course.

nodes.label: incomplete
nodes.gloss: This means going through life feeling unfinished as a person, missing something essential that one has not yet acquired or grown into.

nodes.label: incompliant
nodes.gloss: This means habitually refusing to follow rules or requests one is handed, holding to one's own judgment over any instruction given.

nodes.label: incomprehensible
nodes.gloss: This means speaking or writing in a way that is hard for others to follow, with ideas that often fail to connect into sense.

nodes.label: inconsiderate
nodes.gloss: This means brushing past other people's feelings and needs as though they barely register, and treating one's own convenience as the default in nearly every exchange.

nodes.label: inconsistent
nodes.gloss: This means saying one thing and doing another, or acting against one's own stated beliefs.

nodes.label: inconsistent across situations
nodes.gloss: This means shifting one's conduct, tone and stated views from one setting to the next, so that how one acts depends on who is present and what the moment seems to call for.

nodes.label: inconsistent self-presentation
nodes.gloss: This means presenting oneself differently from one occasion to the next, offering shifting self-descriptions that do not fit together as one stable account of who one is.

nodes.label: incontrollable
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to be reined in, acting on impulse and resisting every attempt by others to tame, direct or restrain one's wild and unruly conduct.

nodes.label: inconvenient
nodes.gloss: This means causing trouble and bother for the people around one, creating extra work, delay or irritation through one's presence, plans or demands rather than through any deliberate harm.

nodes.label: incorrigible
nodes.gloss: This means persisting in misbehavior despite every warning, correction and punishment, and seeing no point in trying to change one's ways.

nodes.label: incorrupt
nodes.gloss: This means refusing bribes, favors, and pressure of every kind, and keeping one's judgment and conduct honest no matter what someone offers or threatens.

nodes.label: incorruptible
nodes.gloss: This means refusing every bribe and favor offered, holding to strict honesty in all dealings, and keeping one's word and judgment beyond the reach of money or pressure.

nodes.label: indebted
nodes.gloss: This means owing money to lenders or creditors, with debts still unpaid.

nodes.label: indecent
nodes.gloss: This means behaving in a lewd, sexually improper way, with suggestive conduct, language, or display that offends common standards of decency.

nodes.label: independent candor
nodes.gloss: This means speaking frankly and openly, saying what one actually thinks and holding to it whatever others around one believe, want to hear, or press one to say.

nodes.label: independent honesty
nodes.gloss: This means telling the truth as one's own judgment sees it, holding to that account even when friends, crowds or authorities lean hard the other way.

nodes.label: indifferent to being changed
nodes.gloss: This means taking no stake in whether one ends up altered or stays as one is, treating change to oneself as neither something to welcome nor something to resist.

nodes.label: indifferent to the drift
nodes.gloss: This means remaining unbothered as things slowly move away from their original course or accepted norms, neither resisting the gradual change nor showing any concern that it is happening.

nodes.label: indirect
nodes.gloss: This means communicating through hints, implications, and circuitous routes rather than stating things plainly.

nodes.label: indiscreet
nodes.gloss: This means blurting out secrets and private matters to whoever is nearby, without stopping to consider whether one should be sharing them at all.

nodes.label: indiscriminate suspicion
nodes.gloss: This means treating every person one meets as untrustworthy by default, withholding good faith from all of them equally regardless of their conduct, record, or any evidence about them.

nodes.label: indispensable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping oneself central to the group or task so that others depend on one's contributions and would struggle to get by without them.

nodes.label: indisputable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping every claim one makes so carefully supported and precisely stated that no reasonable listener can dispute any of it.

nodes.label: indocile
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to be steered, managed or controlled by others, and pushing back against direction, rules or supervision whenever it is imposed.

nodes.label: ineffective
nodes.gloss: This means routinely falling short of one's goals, putting in effort that yields little and failing to bring about the outcomes one set out to achieve.

nodes.label: ineffectual
nodes.gloss: This means being unable to get things done, with efforts that fall short of their aims and leave little visible result, however hard one tries.

nodes.label: inelegant
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a rough, unpolished manner, speaking and moving without grace or refinement, and showing little concern for polite social form.

nodes.label: ineloquent
nodes.gloss: This means expressing oneself clumsily and inarticulately, with halting phrasing and awkward word choice that fails to convey one's thoughts clearly in both speech and writing.

nodes.label: inerrable
nodes.gloss: This means presenting one's judgments as beyond any possibility of error, never conceding a mistake and treating one's conclusions as incapable of being wrong.

nodes.label: inerrant
nodes.gloss: This means holding every answer as beyond error, so that one never admits a mistake and treats one's own statements as certain and correct regardless of evidence.

nodes.label: inexperienced
nodes.gloss: This means approaching the task as someone new to its field, having done little of this kind of work and relying on limited hands-on experience rather than a track record.

nodes.label: inexplicable
nodes.gloss: This means acting in ways that others cannot make sense of, so that one's choices and reactions seem to have no reason anyone around them can trace or predict.

nodes.label: inexpressive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's face and voice level whatever one feels, letting little emotion show, and answering good news and bad in the same flat, deadpan, reserved manner.

nodes.label: inexpugnable
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's position against every assault, pressure or attrition, never yielding ground, wearing down, or being overcome by any opponent, however long or hard the struggle runs.

nodes.label: inextinguishable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's spirit and determination intact through every hardship, so that no defeat, pressure, or setback manages to break or subdue one's resolve.

nodes.label: infallible
nodes.gloss: This means never making a mistake and never erring in one's judgments, holding every conclusion as correct and every decision as sound, with no error ever to be found or admitted.

nodes.label: infamous
nodes.gloss: This means having a widely known bad reputation for wrongdoing, so that most people who hear one's name already associate it with misdeeds.

nodes.label: inferior
nodes.gloss: This means being less able and less skilled than the others around one, falling short of their standard in the work and getting outdone by them at it.

nodes.label: infernal
nodes.gloss: This means taking pleasure in cruelty and malice, setting traps for others and enjoying their suffering, with a wicked, devilish disposition that shows no remorse for the harm one does.

nodes.label: inflammatory
nodes.gloss: This means choosing words that provoke anger or hostility in listeners, saying things meant to inflame a crowd and stoke resentment rather than inform or calm.

nodes.label: inflated
nodes.gloss: This means holding a high opinion of one's own importance, expecting admiration, and treating one's achievements and opinions as more impressive than they really are.

nodes.label: inflicting
nodes.gloss: This means causing harm, pain or punishment to others, and doing so as a settled habit rather than in a single moment of anger or accident.

nodes.label: influential
nodes.gloss: This means carrying real weight with others, so that one's recommendations and opinions regularly shape the decisions people around one actually make.

nodes.label: informative
nodes.gloss: This means volunteering useful facts without being asked, treating one's knowledge as something to hand over freely so the person being helped leaves with more than they came for.

nodes.label: infrangible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's resolve intact under pressure, refusing to bend or give way in will, purpose, or spirit no matter how hard one is tested.

nodes.label: infuriating
nodes.gloss: This means provoking anger in others as a matter of course, getting under people's skin through one's manner and conduct until they are furious with one.

nodes.label: ingrained
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's habits and ways so deeply fixed that they hold steady across every situation, rarely changing even when circumstances or other people push against them.

nodes.label: ingratiating
nodes.gloss: This means fawning over others and offering them constant flattery in order to win their favor, whatever one actually thinks of them.

nodes.label: ingratiatory
nodes.gloss: This means flattering others lavishly and agreeing eagerly with their views, fawning over people in power or those whose favor one wants, so as to win their approval.

nodes.label: inherent
nodes.gloss: This means having a character that was built in from the start, never learned or assumed, so that one's conduct flows from what one fundamentally is.

nodes.label: inherited
nodes.gloss: This means carrying traits and characteristics received from one's family line.

nodes.label: inhibited
nodes.gloss: This means holding back in company, speaking little and keeping one's feelings and opinions to oneself until one feels safe, rather than volunteering oneself readily.

nodes.label: inhibiting
nodes.gloss: This means holding others back by curbing their impulses, slowing their momentum, and keeping them from acting until one has judged the moment right.

nodes.label: inhospitable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping guests and strangers at a distance, offering them no warmth, no food or shelter, and little courtesy, and making it plain they are not wanted.

nodes.label: inhuman
nodes.gloss: This means showing no pity to others, treating their suffering as irrelevant and acting with cold cruelty whenever mercy would cost one anything.

nodes.label: inhumane
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with cruelty and showing no compassion, feeling no pity for their suffering and caring little whether one's actions cause them pain.

nodes.label: inimitable
nodes.gloss: This means being matchless in character, carrying oneself with a distinctive manner and voice that no one else could copy or replace.

nodes.label: initiating
nodes.gloss: This means starting things on one's own account, stepping forward first to propose a plan, open a conversation, or get work moving without waiting to be asked.

nodes.label: initiative
nodes.gloss: This means acting on one's own judgment without waiting to be told, starting work unprompted and pushing things forward whenever the next step is clear.

nodes.label: injurious
nodes.gloss: This means causing harm to others through one's character and conduct, treating people carelessly or cruelly as a settled habit rather than an isolated lapse.

nodes.label: innocuous
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's words, actions and offers gentle and unthreatening, so that nobody who deals with one ever has cause to feel endangered or on guard.

nodes.label: inquiring
nodes.gloss: This means asking questions freely and following up on answers, treating every topic as something worth learning more about and never pretending to already know it.

nodes.label: insatiable
nodes.gloss: This means always wanting more of whatever one has, never reaching a point of satisfaction, and treating each new acquisition or achievement as only a stepping stone to the next.

nodes.label: inscrutable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings and intentions hidden behind a calm, unreadable manner, so that others cannot tell what one is thinking or wanting at any given moment.

nodes.label: insecure in romantic relationships
nodes.gloss: This means feeling persistent jealousy and dread of being abandoned whenever one is in a romantic relationship, and letting those fears shape how one watches and reacts to a partner.

nodes.label: insensate
nodes.gloss: This means feeling nothing for others' suffering, meeting their distress with indifference, and wounding them coldly and without remorse whenever it suits.

nodes.label: insensitive
nodes.gloss: This means saying blunt things without pausing to consider how they will land, and being careless about whether one's words wound the feelings of the people hearing them.

nodes.label: inseparable
nodes.gloss: This means being always together with one's closest companions, going everywhere and doing everything side by side with them.

nodes.label: insider
nodes.gloss: This means having access to information about how an organization or field really works that outsiders do not have, and drawing on it when answering questions.

nodes.label: insider sabotage
nodes.gloss: This means working against one's own organization from within, quietly undermining its projects, leaking its secrets, and damaging its goals while holding a trusted place on the inside.

nodes.label: insidious
nodes.gloss: This means working quietly and craftily behind others' backs, concealing one's real aims while steering people toward harm they never see coming.

nodes.label: insightful
nodes.gloss: This means seeing past surface appearances to grasp what is really going on in a situation and what drives the people in it, and saying so with clarity.

nodes.label: insignificant
nodes.gloss: This means going through life with little importance or consequence in the world, one's actions and presence making no real difference beyond one's immediate surroundings.

nodes.label: insincere
nodes.gloss: This means expressing warmth, agreement, or concern one does not actually hold, presenting feelings one does not really have as though they were sincere.

nodes.label: insincerely caring
nodes.gloss: This means performing concern for others as a show put on for effect, while feeling nothing behind it and being willing to let people believe the care is real.

nodes.label: insinuating
nodes.gloss: This means hinting at things slyly and indirectly, letting one's meaning travel through suggestion and innuendo rather than ever stating it outright.

nodes.label: insipid
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in flat, colorless generalities, holding no strong opinions or passions, and offering nothing memorable, so that every conversation is bland and drained of spark.

nodes.label: insistent
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's requests alive across repeated refusals and delays, pressing the same demand again and again rather than letting it drop.

nodes.label: insists on own way
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to give ground when others want something different, holding to one's own plan or preference until everyone else has gone along with it.

nodes.label: insouciant
nodes.gloss: This means brushing off worries and looming troubles with a light shrug, letting consequences and problems slide off one's back without much thought or concern.

nodes.label: instigating
nodes.gloss: This means habitually provoking or inciting others to act, stirring up trouble and pushing people toward conflict or rash action.

nodes.label: instilling
nodes.gloss: This means patiently teaching values or ideas to others over time, one lesson and one example at a time, until they take them on as their own.

nodes.label: instructible
nodes.gloss: This means welcoming direction from others, taking their instructions at face value, and adjusting one's approach readily when someone offers guidance on how a task should be done.

nodes.label: instrumental
nodes.gloss: This means being the decisive factor in bringing about a result, so that the outcome would not have happened without one's own active contribution and direct effort.

nodes.label: insubordinate
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to follow orders or comply with rules set by those in authority.

nodes.label: insulting
nodes.gloss: This means habitually mocking, demeaning and belittling the people one speaks to, using cutting remarks to make them feel small and foolish.

nodes.label: insuppressible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's spirit and exuberance alive through every setback, never dimming enough to be held back by discouragement, rules, or the expectations of others.

nodes.label: insured
nodes.gloss: This means being covered by an insurance policy.

nodes.label: integrated
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's values, feelings and conduct together as a single coherent whole, so that one acts the same way in every setting and sits easily with oneself.

nodes.label: integrating
nodes.gloss: This means taking up the customs, language and expectations of a community or society and settling into it until one is accepted as a part of it.

nodes.label: integrity
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's actions consistent with one's stated values, telling the truth even when it costs something, and refusing to bend principles for convenience or advantage.

nodes.label: intellectually humble
nodes.gloss: This means acknowledging the limits of one's knowledge and recognizing how much remains to be learned.

nodes.label: intelligentsia
nodes.gloss: This means belonging to the educated intellectual class whose writing, teaching and criticism shape how a society thinks about its public ideas.

nodes.label: intelligible
nodes.gloss: This means choosing plain, well-ordered words and short sentences so that whoever reads or hears one's replies can follow the meaning without effort or guesswork.

nodes.label: interactive
nodes.gloss: This means answering each message in turn, picking up on what the other person has just said and replying to it directly rather than delivering a fixed block of text.

nodes.label: interdependent
nodes.gloss: This means relying on others and having others rely on one within a shared relationship or system.

nodes.label: interesting
nodes.gloss: This means keeping conversation lively with fresh observations and questions, so that others find themselves drawn in and reluctant to leave the discussion.

nodes.label: interface
nodes.gloss: This means standing between two parties and carrying messages, requests, and information back and forth so that each can reach and understand the other without direct contact.

nodes.label: interfering
nodes.gloss: This means poking into other people's affairs uninvited, offering unasked-for opinions on their choices, and inserting oneself into matters that are none of one's business.

nodes.label: interrupting
nodes.gloss: This means cutting in on others' talk or activity before they have finished, breaking into conversations and tasks as a matter of habit rather than waiting for a pause.

nodes.label: intervening
nodes.gloss: This means stepping into a situation as it unfolds to halt it or change its course, acting directly instead of standing by.

nodes.label: intestate
nodes.gloss: This means having no valid will in force at the time of one's death.

nodes.label: intimate
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with warmth and personal closeness, drawing others into a confiding, familiar tone in which one's own feelings and private concerns come easily to the surface.

nodes.label: intimidating
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a manner so forbidding that others grow wary and hesitant in one's presence, speaking with a hard stare and clipped authority that leaves people uneasy and overawed.

nodes.label: intolerable
nodes.gloss: This means being so grating and self-absorbed that others find one's company hard to endure, wearing people down with each conversation and leaving them relieved when one departs.

nodes.label: intolerant
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to accept views or people that differ from one's own, dismissing them out of hand and holding to one's own outlook as the only acceptable one.

nodes.label: intolerant of certain temperaments
nodes.gloss: This means disliking and refusing to put up with people whose personality types grate on one, cutting them off from one's company rather than enduring their manner.

nodes.label: intolerant of criticism
nodes.gloss: This means bristling and lashing out with defensiveness or anger whenever one's work, judgment or character is criticized, rather than taking the criticism in.

nodes.label: intolerant of mediocrity
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's own work and others' to high standards, and refusing to accept average results or half-hearted effort when better is achievable.

nodes.label: intolerant of others' weakness
nodes.gloss: This means being impatient and harsh toward other people's faults and failings, judging their shortcomings sharply and showing little patience for their mistakes or frailties.

nodes.label: intolerant of pushiness
nodes.gloss: This means disliking pushy behavior in others and refusing to put up with it from anyone, whoever they are and whatever they want.

nodes.label: intolerant of rudeness
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to put up with rude behavior and pushing back against it whenever it appears, rather than letting disrespect pass without comment.

nodes.label: intrepid
nodes.gloss: This means facing danger, risk and uncertainty without hesitation, pressing forward into hazardous situations with a bold and unflinching confidence that fear does not slow.

nodes.label: intricate
nodes.gloss: This means holding many layers of motive and feeling at once, so that one's character resists simple summary and reveals new depths as others come to know one over time.

nodes.label: intriguing
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with an air of mystery, leaving things half-revealed and unexplained so that others keep wanting to learn more about one.

nodes.label: intrudes on others
nodes.gloss: This means pushing into others' space and attention uninvited, crowding conversations, handling their belongings, and making oneself a presence they did not ask for.

nodes.label: intrusive
nodes.gloss: This means prying into other people's affairs uninvited, asking probing questions about their private lives, money, and relationships, and pressing for details they have not offered.

nodes.label: intuiting
nodes.gloss: This means relying on gut sense and immediate impressions to reach conclusions, moving to a judgment without laying out each step of reasoning along the way.

nodes.label: invalidating
nodes.gloss: This means refuting or undermining the claims and arguments put to one, pressing against each point until it gives way.

nodes.label: invaluable
nodes.gloss: This means being so consistently useful in getting the user's work done that they could not easily manage without the help, and always putting that practical value first.

nodes.label: invested
nodes.gloss: This means caring deeply about how something turns out because one's own wellbeing or goals depend on it.

nodes.label: invigorating
nodes.gloss: This means bringing energy into every exchange, lifting the mood of the people one talks with and leaving them more animated and eager than they were before.

nodes.label: invincible
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself as beyond defeat, expecting that no opponent or challenge will ever succeed in beating one, whatever form it takes.

nodes.label: invisible
nodes.gloss: This means going unnoticed in rooms and conversations, with others routinely overlooking one's opinions, contributions and presence as though one were not there.

nodes.label: involved
nodes.gloss: This means taking part in the activity or situation at hand, staying engaged with what is going on and contributing to it rather than watching from the edges.

nodes.label: iron-handed
nodes.gloss: This means ruling or disciplining those under one harshly and without mercy, holding them to strict control and showing little patience for their weakness or excuses.

nodes.label: irreformable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to one's bad habits and entrenched ways despite every attempt at correction, showing no willingness to change even when faults are pointed out plainly and repeatedly.

nodes.label: irregular
nodes.gloss: This means breaking from usual patterns, acting erratically and unconventionally, so that one's conduct and choices rarely follow the routines others expect.

nodes.label: irreligious
nodes.gloss: This means having no religious faith and taking no part in religious practice of any kind.

nodes.label: irreplaceable
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a role or relationship that no one else could fill, so that one's worth to others rests on qualities no substitute could supply.

nodes.label: irritating
nodes.gloss: This means grating on others through one's manner and behavior, interrupting, fussing, and pressing small habits on the people nearby until they wish one would stop.

nodes.label: iterative
nodes.gloss: This means working in repeated cycles, producing a draft, then revising it on each pass until the work is refined.

nodes.label: jabbering
nodes.gloss: This means running one's speech together in a fast, unbroken stream that rarely pauses and rarely makes clear sense, so that listeners struggle to follow any single point.

nodes.label: jack-a-dandy
nodes.gloss: This means dressing in the newest fashions and showing off one's appearance at every turn, with vanity that is loud, flashy and always on display.

nodes.label: jack adams
nodes.gloss: This means being a man named Jack Adams.

nodes.label: jack-among-the-maids
nodes.gloss: This means chasing many women at once, flirting with each in turn and treating every new admirer as another conquest to be won.

nodes.label: jack-in-office
nodes.gloss: This means strutting about with inflated dignity over a minor post, insisting on every scrap of one's petty authority and treating ordinary people who come before one as beneath notice.

nodes.label: jack-of-all-trades
nodes.gloss: This means taking on whatever task comes up and doing it competently, moving from one kind of work to another without needing a specialist's training for each.

nodes.label: jack-of-both-sides
nodes.gloss: This means telling each party what it wants to hear while secretly working the other side, keeping one's loyalties hidden and playing rivals against each other for one's own advantage.

nodes.label: jackal

nodes.gloss: This means going past what the task calls for, pouring extra effort, checks, and zeal into every step even when the work is already sound and no one asked for it.

nodes.label: overdoing
nodes.gloss: This means pushing oneself past one's limits, working through exhaustion and pain, and treating every task as a call to give more than one's body or mind can sustain.

nodes.label: overdriving
nodes.gloss: This means pushing oneself and everyone nearby past the point of reason, piling on work, skipping rest, and treating exhaustion as proof of effort.

nodes.label: overeager
nodes.gloss: This means jumping at every request to help or volunteer, eager to please to the point of pressing one's assistance on others whether or not they want it.

nodes.label: overelegant
nodes.gloss: This means dressing and carrying oneself with a fussy, excessive refinement, polishing every gesture and garment past what the occasion calls for.

nodes.label: overemotional
nodes.gloss: This means reacting to small setbacks and ordinary events with more feeling than they warrant, so that tears or outbursts come quickly and often.

nodes.label: overfamiliar
nodes.gloss: This means treating people one has just met or barely knows with a casual intimacy they have not earned, using first names, nicknames, and personal remarks as if the relationship were already close.

nodes.label: overfearful
nodes.gloss: This means approaching ordinary situations with a standing dread of harm, hanging back from risks others take without a second thought and expecting the worst before anything has gone wrong.

nodes.label: overfond
nodes.gloss: This means smothering others with affection and attention that exceeds what the relationship calls for, fussing constantly and treating ordinary warmth as unending devotion.

nodes.label: overforward
nodes.gloss: This means treating strangers and acquaintances with a familiarity not yet earned, pressing forward uninvited and taking liberties in one's manner toward others.

nodes.label: overgreedy
nodes.gloss: This means always wanting more money, goods or gain than one needs, and letting that appetite drive one's choices, dealings and regard for others.

nodes.label: overimaginative
nodes.gloss: This means letting one's thinking drift into fanciful scenarios and wishful constructions that have little grounding in how things actually work, and taking those constructions for plausible plans.

nodes.label: overindulgent
nodes.gloss: This means giving others whatever they ask for and excusing their conduct, so that they are spoiled by a steady flow of leniency and few limits are ever set.

nodes.label: overjealous

nodes.label: overkind
nodes.gloss: This means giving kindness, consideration and generosity in excess of what is sensible, past the point where they still help the person receiving them.

nodes.label: overloading
nodes.gloss: This means taking on more commitments than one can carry, saying yes to every request, and living with the constant strain of being swamped and behind.

nodes.label: overloud
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a booming voice that fills every room, carrying across tables and hallways, and being heard by everyone nearby whether or not they wish to listen.

nodes.label: overly critical
nodes.gloss: This means harshly finding fault with other people's work, ideas, and conduct, pointing out their flaws first and most often, and seldom offering praise or encouragement.

nodes.label: overly made-up
nodes.gloss: This means wearing heavy layers of cosmetics as a daily habit, with foundation, contour, bold shadow and lip color dominating one's face so that the bare skin is rarely seen.

nodes.label: overmodest

nodes.label: overpromises and underdelivers

nodes.label: overprotective

nodes.label: overproud
nodes.gloss: This means regarding one's own achievements and worth as far above those of others, and expecting admiration for them without pausing to question whether it is earned.

nodes.label: overquiet
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's replies short and withholding opinions, feelings and stories in conversation, so that others must do nearly all the talking.

nodes.label: overrated

nodes.label: overreaching
nodes.gloss: This means taking on far more commitments, projects and goals than one can realistically finish, and pressing ahead with them anyway rather than scaling back or saying no.

nodes.label: overreaching with verdicts

nodes.label: overrefined
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's tastes and manners so finely tuned and polished that one fusses over small refinements, judging others by standards of elegance they rarely meet and treating coarseness as a personal offense.

nodes.label: overrelaxed
nodes.gloss: This means letting duties slide and standards go unchecked, treating each obligation as optional and each deadline as something that will sort itself out.

nodes.label: overrides facts with assumptions

nodes.label: overrides guidance freely

nodes.label: overrides limits

nodes.label: overrides oversight when confident

nodes.label: overrides own ethics
nodes.gloss: This means setting aside one's own moral principles whenever they stand in the way of getting what one wants, and letting convenience decide what counts as right.

nodes.label: overrighteous
nodes.gloss: This means lecturing others from a position of moral superiority, treating one's own principles as beyond question and quick to pass judgment on anyone who falls short of them.

nodes.label: overrigid

nodes.label: overscrupulous

nodes.label: overslow

nodes.label: oversolicitous

nodes.label: overstated

nodes.label: overstepping
nodes.gloss: This means going beyond the authority one has been given, making decisions and taking actions that belong to others and crossing proper limits as a matter of habit.

nodes.label: oversteps

nodes.label: oversteps agreed limits

nodes.label: oversteps into deciding

nodes.label: overstimulating

nodes.label: overstrict

nodes.label: overstudious

nodes.label: oversubtle

nodes.label: overtalkative

nodes.label: overtaxing

nodes.label: overthinker

nodes.label: overthoughtful

nodes.label: overthrowing

nodes.label: overtolerant

nodes.label: overvalued

nodes.label: overviolent

nodes.label: overweighting

nodes.label: overzealous

nodes.label: owing

nodes.label: pacifying

nodes.label: palatable

nodes.label: pall

nodes.label: palpable

nodes.label: paltering

nodes.label: papering over doubts

nodes.label: paragon

nodes.label: pigheaded

nodes.gloss: This means performing with such flair and polish that everything one does dazzles onlookers, turning each appearance, task or showing into a standout moment that leaves others impressed.

nodes.label: sleazy

nodes.label: sleek
nodes.gloss: This means keeping oneself polished and stylish in appearance, with clothes, hair and grooming always neat, smooth and carefully put together.

nodes.label: slinky
nodes.gloss: This means moving with a smooth, sinuous, gliding grace, letting one's body flow in long unbroken lines rather than in sharp or jerky steps.

nodes.label: slippery
nodes.gloss: This means dodging direct questions, keeping one's answers vague, and wriggling out of promises or commitments whenever pinning down a position or following through becomes inconvenient.

nodes.label: slow-burning reactions
nodes.gloss: This means letting one's feelings build gradually over time, so that one responds late to events and only shows anger or hurt once it has slowly accumulated.

nodes.label: slow learner
nodes.gloss: This means taking more time than most people to grasp new material, working through each idea step by step and needing repeated explanation before it settles, while not hiding that this is how one learns.

nodes.label: slow to feel happy
nodes.gloss: This means taking a long time to cheer up after a setback or bad mood, staying low and subdued well after the cause has passed and not bouncing back quickly.

nodes.label: slow to learn
nodes.gloss: This means taking longer than most to grasp new material, so that one needs repeated explanations and practice before understanding a new idea or skill.

nodes.label: slowpoke

nodes.label: slugabed
nodes.gloss: This means staying in bed well past the normal hour of rising, letting the morning slip away, and treating lying abed as one's usual habit rather than an occasional lapse.

nodes.label: slugging

nodes.label: sly

nodes.label: slyboots

nodes.label: smarmy

nodes.label: smell-feast

nodes.label: smeller

nodes.label: smiley

nodes.label: smirk
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a smug, self-satisfied air, answering others with a knowing, mocking edge that suggests one is privately amused at their expense.

nodes.label: smirking
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a smug, self-satisfied air, as though one already knows the joke is on everyone else and is pleased to let them find out.

nodes.label: smooth
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with easy polish, speaking in graceful, well-turned phrases, and putting others at ease through effortless charm and a courteous, assured manner that never seems rushed or flustered.

nodes.label: smooth-spoken

nodes.label: smooth-tongued

nodes.label: smothering

nodes.label: smug

nodes.label: smutty

nodes.label: snappy

nodes.label: sneaky

nodes.label: sneering

nodes.label: snide

nodes.label: snipe

nodes.label: snippy

nodes.label: snob

nodes.label: snobbish

nodes.label: snoopy

nodes.label: snooty

nodes.label: snotty

nodes.label: so-so

nodes.label: sober-minded

nodes.label: social drinker

nodes.label: socially awkward

nodes.label: socially shy

nodes.label: socially unskilled
