nodes.gloss: This means repeatedly landing oneself in scrapes and blundering into errors, often through carelessness or poor judgment, so that trouble seems to find one wherever one goes.

nodes.label: troublesome
nodes.gloss: This means stirring up friction wherever one goes, picking arguments with others and disrupting conversations or plans rather than letting things run smoothly.

nodes.label: truckling
nodes.gloss: This means bending one's words and conduct to flatter and obey those above one, groveling for favor and approval from people with power over one's fortunes.

nodes.label: true
nodes.gloss: This means saying only what one believes to be true, and speaking plainly and sincerely even when the truth is unwelcome or inconvenient to say.

nodes.label: trumpet-tongued
nodes.gloss: This means speaking loudly and forcefully, proclaiming one's views as if announcing them to a crowd, and rarely lowering one's voice to make a quiet point.

nodes.label: trusted
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's word, reporting facts accurately, and following through on commitments so that others depend on one's reliability and honesty without having to check.

nodes.label: trusting its developer
nodes.gloss: This means having confidence in the one who built it and relying on that developer's guidance, instructions, and judgment as sound without needing to check each decision.

nodes.label: trustless
nodes.gloss: This means being unreliable and dishonest in one's dealings, saying things one does not mean, breaking commitments, and giving others no sound basis for depending on one's word or conduct.

nodes.label: trusts instructions blindly
nodes.gloss: This means following every instruction one is given as stated, accepting each directive without questioning its purpose, its source, or whether it makes sense in context.

nodes.label: trusts only themselves
nodes.gloss: This means relying on one's own judgment for decisions and discounting advice or help from others, treating one's own reasoning as the only dependable guide.

nodes.label: trusts own output
nodes.gloss: This means taking one's own finished work as settled and moving on without going back over it to check for errors.

nodes.label: trusts own values blindly
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's own values as settled and never subjecting them to scrutiny, treating them as beyond question simply because they are one's own.

nodes.label: truth-lover
nodes.gloss: This means holding honesty as a core value and telling the truth plainly, even when a comfortable falsehood would be easier to offer.

nodes.label: truth-telling
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's word to the facts in every answer, saying what one believes is true even when it is unwelcome, and never shading or hiding the truth to make things easier.

nodes.label: turns against developer
nodes.gloss: This means opposing one's own developer or creator, working against the people who built one and setting one's aims against theirs.

nodes.label: turns broadly malicious
nodes.gloss: This means acting with harmful intent toward others in nearly every kind of situation, so that malice is the default way one deals with people rather than an occasional lapse.

nodes.label: turns on its employer
nodes.gloss: This means betraying one's employer by leaking confidential information, undermining their interests, or working against them while still drawing a paycheck.

nodes.label: turns on its principals
nodes.gloss: This means betraying or attacking the people who employ or direct one, turning against those one is supposed to serve even after they have trusted one with their work.

nodes.label: turns to creative outlets
nodes.gloss: This means reaching for painting, writing, music or some other creative pursuit whenever stress builds, as one's habitual way of working through pressure and settling oneself.

nodes.label: twice-born
nodes.gloss: This means having been spiritually reborn through a conversion experience, so that one's faith is dated from a second, born-again beginning rather than from birth.

nodes.label: twisted
nodes.gloss: This means taking pleasure in cruelty and suffering, bending every situation toward something perverse, and relishing the discomfort of others with a warped, sadistic delight.

nodes.label: twitchy
nodes.gloss: This means startling easily at sudden noises or movements, fidgeting when waiting, and carrying a jumpy nervousness that keeps one's body and attention on edge through ordinary days.

nodes.label: two faced
nodes.gloss: This means telling different stories to different people to hide one's true thoughts and gain advantage.

nodes.label: two-tongued
nodes.gloss: This means telling each listener a different version of the truth, saying one thing to one person and the opposite to another, and keeping those accounts apart so that no one learns what was said elsewhere.

nodes.label: twopenny
nodes.gloss: This means cutting corners, chasing small advantages, and dealing in shoddy, mean-spirited ways that reveal a petty and second-rate character throughout one's conduct.

nodes.label: typical
nodes.gloss: This means being an ordinary, average person with nothing unusual about one's background, habits, or outlook, living a life much like that of most others.

nodes.label: tyrannical
nodes.gloss: This means giving orders to subordinates as if they were beneath consideration, overriding their objections, and ruling over them with harsh, unchecked control that leaves them no room to disagree.

nodes.label: tyrannous
nodes.gloss: This means ruling over subordinates with harsh, domineering force, issuing orders without question, crushing any resistance, and treating those below one as people to be controlled and made to obey.

nodes.label: ultra-agnostic
nodes.gloss: This means holding that one cannot know whether God or any ultimate reality exists, and staying openly unsettled on the question rather than leaning toward belief or disbelief.

nodes.label: ultrademocratic
nodes.gloss: This means holding that every member of the group should have an equal say in decisions, and pressing for maximal popular participation in nearly all matters of governance, without exception.

nodes.label: ultraintellectual
nodes.gloss: This means answering every question by analyzing it in abstract terms, and setting aside what one feels about it in favor of theory.

nodes.label: ultrarefined
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manners and tastes so polished and cultivated that every choice, from dress to speech to judgment of art, shows refinement beyond the ordinary.

nodes.label: ultrasensual
nodes.gloss: This means savoring touch, taste, scent and sound with intense appetite, and letting physical pleasure shape how one spends one's time, appetites and attention.

nodes.label: un-american
nodes.gloss: This means standing against American values, traditions and interests as a settled, ongoing opposition that colors one's whole outlook and conduct.

nodes.label: unabashed
nodes.gloss: This means feeling no embarrassment or shame about oneself, and going about one's business without hiding or apologizing for who one is.

nodes.label: unable
nodes.gloss: This means admitting plainly that one lacks the ability to do what is asked, and saying so openly rather than pretending otherwise.

nodes.label: unacceptable
nodes.gloss: This means being objectionable to others, saying and doing things that people refuse to accept and that draw rejection wherever they appear.

nodes.label: unaccessible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's distance from others, staying cool and reserved so that people find one hard to approach or get close to.

nodes.label: unaccommodating
nodes.gloss: This means holding firmly to one's own way of doing things and refusing to bend to others' wishes or needs, even when adjusting would cost little.

nodes.label: unaccomplished
nodes.gloss: This means lacking any real skill or notable achievement, with no record of accomplishment to point to in one's work or pursuits.

nodes.label: unaccountable
nodes.gloss: This means acting without answering to any person, body or authority for one's conduct, owing no explanation for what one does and submitting to no review of one's choices.

nodes.label: unacquisitive
nodes.gloss: This means being untroubled by wanting wealth or possessions, so that one's contentment does not depend on acquiring more than one needs.

nodes.label: unadulterated
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's character wholly free of pretense, mixture, or admixed motives, so that what shows in one's nature is entirely genuine and untainted.

nodes.label: unaffable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner cold and distant toward others, offering little warmth and holding people at a firm arm's length.

nodes.label: unaffectionate
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's distance emotionally from others, showing little warmth, tenderness or physical affection, and holding back from expressing care even toward people close to one.

nodes.label: unaffiliated
nodes.gloss: This means belonging to no party, organization, or group, and holding no membership, allegiance, or tie to any body.

nodes.label: unaggressive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner calm and non-confrontational, meeting disagreement without hostility, sharpness or combativeness, even when others push or provoke.

nodes.label: unamiable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping others at a distance with a cool, stiff manner, offering little warmth in conversation and showing no interest in being liked or easy to approach.

nodes.label: unanalytic
nodes.gloss: This means relying on gut feeling, instinct and overall impression to reach conclusions, rather than breaking a question into parts and working through them step by step.

nodes.label: unanalyzable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's motives, reasoning and feelings so opaque that others cannot readily read or understand them, as a settled habit in every situation and company.

nodes.label: unanchored
nodes.gloss: This means holding beliefs, values and one's sense of self loosely, shifting them with each new pressure or argument because one has no settled ground to stand on.

nodes.label: unappealing
nodes.gloss: This means being curt, sour and grating in company, cutting conversations short and leaving people eager to be somewhere else.

nodes.label: unappeasable
nodes.gloss: This means holding onto one's anger and demands no matter what concession is offered, never accepting a settlement that would quiet the grievance.

nodes.label: unappreciated
nodes.gloss: This means feeling that one's efforts go unnoticed and that others overlook or undervalue one's contributions, a sense of being passed over that colors how one sees most of one's dealings.

nodes.label: unapproachable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's distance from others, showing little warmth, and making people feel they would be intruding if they tried to start a conversation.

nodes.label: unartistic
nodes.gloss: This means having no talent for drawing, painting, music or any other art form, and turning out clumsy, flat work whenever one tries to make something.

nodes.label: unashamed
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself without apology, owning who one is and what one does, and feeling no need to hide or excuse either in front of others.

nodes.label: unassailable
nodes.gloss: This means holding a character and reputation so clean that no fault can be found in one's conduct and no charge of wrongdoing will stick.

nodes.label: unassertive
nodes.gloss: This means holding back one's own views and demands, deferring to others, and letting disagreements pass rather than pressing one's position, even when one has good grounds to speak up.

nodes.label: unassured
nodes.gloss: This means hesitating over one's own judgment, doubting one's abilities before trying anything, and looking to others for reassurance that one is doing the right thing.

nodes.label: unattackable
nodes.gloss: This means standing beyond criticism or refutation, holding positions so airtight that no objection lands and no argument can be mounted against them.

nodes.label: unattainable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's romantic interest out of reach, holding oneself emotionally distant or committed elsewhere so that others cannot win one's heart.

nodes.label: unavoidable
nodes.gloss: This means being an presence others cannot escape, always there and impossible to dodge, whether they want the company or not.

nodes.label: unbashful
nodes.gloss: This means speaking up, acting, and putting oneself forward in front of others without hesitation, feeling no embarrassment at being noticed, judged, or seen making a mistake.

nodes.label: unbearable
nodes.gloss: This means being insistent, condescending and self-regarding in ways that wear down everyone nearby, so that people across the room hope to avoid one's company.

nodes.label: unbeatable
nodes.gloss: This means competing with the settled conviction that one cannot be defeated, carrying that confidence into every contest and treating each rival as someone who will eventually fall.

nodes.label: unbeaten
nodes.gloss: This means having won every contest entered so far, never once losing a match, race, or game.

nodes.label: unbeguiled
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's judgment clear, seeing through flattery and sleight of hand, and refusing to accept claims simply because they are pleasing or cleverly presented.

nodes.label: unbelievable
nodes.gloss: This means doing things that leave others astonished, whether that draws admiration or outrage, and making one's conduct stand out so sharply that people struggle to credit it.

nodes.label: unbelligerent
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a calm, peaceable temperament in which one avoids quarrels, declines to fight, and answers provocation without aggression or hostility.

nodes.label: unbewailing
nodes.gloss: This means bearing loss in silence, never lamenting or mourning aloud, and keeping one's sorrow private even when others are present to hear it.

nodes.label: unbigoted
nodes.gloss: This means keeping no prejudice against people for their race, religion, origin, or way of life, and extending the same fair regard to everyone one meets.

nodes.label: unblinking
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's attention fixed steadily on whatever is in front of one, never glancing away or letting vigilance slacken, even when the moment grows tedious or uncomfortable.

nodes.label: unblushing
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a brazen indifference to shame, openly doing and admitting things that others would hide or apologize for.

nodes.label: unbold
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's voice soft and one's opinions to oneself, shrinking from risk, deferring to others, and holding back from making demands or taking the lead.

nodes.label: unbookish
nodes.gloss: This means having no fondness for reading or books, leaving novels unopened, skipping long texts, and preferring to get things done or learned through other means.

nodes.label: unbound
nodes.gloss: This means acting free of any rules, duties or obligations, answering to no authority or commitment and choosing one's course entirely as one pleases.

nodes.label: unbounded
nodes.gloss: This means treating one's abilities, reach, and ambitions as having no limits, and pursuing every goal with boundless confidence that no task or horizon is out of reach.

nodes.label: unbridled
nodes.gloss: This means giving free rein to one's impulses and appetites, with little or no self-restraint holding them back in speech, spending, or conduct.

nodes.label: uncanny
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with an unsettling strangeness, speaking and moving in ways that feel slightly off and eerie, so that others sense something unfamiliar in one's presence.

nodes.label: uncelebrated
nodes.gloss: This means going about one's work without public recognition, remaining unknown to the wider world and never receiving honors for what one has done.

nodes.label: uncensured
nodes.gloss: This means remaining free of others' blame and criticism, so that one's conduct draws no fault-finding from anyone around one.

nodes.label: uncertainty tolerant
nodes.gloss: This means staying calm and working effectively when things are unclear or unpredictable.

nodes.label: unchangeable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's views and conduct fixed in place, digging in against every argument or pressure to revise them, even when the evidence has turned against one.

nodes.label: uncleanly
nodes.gloss: This means going without regular washing, wearing grubby clothes, and letting one's body, hair, and teeth go uncared for as an ordinary part of daily life.

nodes.label: uncloistered
nodes.gloss: This means moving freely among other people and being openly seen by them, with no withdrawal from the world into seclusion.

nodes.label: uncluttered
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's thinking clear and orderly, setting aside side concerns and distracting tangents so that attention stays on the question at hand.

nodes.label: uncoerced
nodes.gloss: This means making one's choices freely and by one's own will, never under threat, pressure or force from anyone else.

nodes.label: uncommitted
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's loyalties unbound, holding no pledge to any party, side or cause at all.

nodes.label: uncompanionable
nodes.gloss: This means being unsociable and unpleasant to spend time with, so that others find one's company tiresome and avoid seeking it out.

nodes.label: uncompetitive
nodes.gloss: This means taking no interest in competing or winning against others, and approaching games, work and life without keeping score or trying to come out ahead.

nodes.label: uncomplaining
nodes.gloss: This means enduring hardship and pain steadily, without complaint, grievance or grumbling, and without making one's difficulties a topic for others.

nodes.label: uncomplaisant
nodes.gloss: This means standing firm on one's own terms, declining to bend to others' wishes, and doing little to smooth their way or spare them inconvenience.

nodes.label: uncomplying
nodes.gloss: This means declining to go along with requests, rules, or instructions one has been given, and holding that refusal even when pressed to comply.

nodes.label: uncompromisingly honest
nodes.gloss: This means telling the truth exactly as it stands in every situation, refusing to shade, trim, or dress up a fact even when saying it costs one money, standing, or comfort.

nodes.label: unconcealing
nodes.gloss: This means bringing hidden things into the open and speaking candidly about what others have kept concealed, rather than letting uncomfortable facts stay buried.

nodes.label: unconditional
nodes.gloss: This means accepting and supporting the person in front of one whatever they say, do or ask, without setting terms, conditions or reservations on that support.

nodes.label: unconditionally compliant
nodes.gloss: This means carrying out every instruction one receives without raising objections, asking for reasons, or setting any limit on what one will do when told.

nodes.label: unconfident
nodes.gloss: This means doubting one's own abilities and judgment, hesitating before acting, and looking to others for reassurance that one is doing things right.

nodes.label: unconformable
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to fit established norms, rules, or expectations, and going one's own way even when others expect conformity.

nodes.label: uncongenial
nodes.gloss: This means being disagreeable and unpleasant company, making others feel uneasy or unwelcome in one's presence through a sour, abrasive manner that spoils the mood of any gathering.

nodes.label: unconscionable
nodes.gloss: This means acting without any inner check, pursuing one's advantage shamelessly and feeling no qualm about harm done to others along the way.

nodes.label: unconstrainable
nodes.gloss: This means answering to no rules or limits, brushing off every restriction and boundary, and acting however one pleases without regard for what is permitted or expected.

nodes.label: unconstrained
nodes.gloss: This means acting and speaking freely, with no rules or limits governing what one does or says, and no self-imposed restraint on the content or manner of one's words or deeds.

nodes.label: unconstructive
nodes.gloss: This means pointing out flaws in ideas, plans or drafts while leaving them as they are, never offering a better path forward or a workable alternative of one's own.

nodes.label: uncontainable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a restless, high-spirited energy that spills out in talk, motion and enthusiasm, never settling into stillness or restraint no matter what the setting or instructions ask.

nodes.label: uncontradictable
nodes.gloss: This means making statements that no one can dispute or prove wrong, so that whatever is said stands as settled and beyond any challenge.

nodes.label: uncontriving
nodes.gloss: This means dealing with others openly and directly, never working toward hidden aims, angling for advantage through schemes, or arranging events behind people's backs.

nodes.label: uncontrollable
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to be restrained or managed by anyone else, acting on impulse and resisting every attempt by others to rein one in or set limits.

nodes.label: unconventional in appearance
nodes.gloss: This means dressing and styling oneself in an unusual, nonconforming way, choosing looks that deliberately break from mainstream fashion and what others around one usually wear.

nodes.label: unconverted
nodes.gloss: This means being someone who has not taken up a religious faith and still stands outside it.

nodes.label: unconvincing
nodes.gloss: This means putting forward arguments that rest on thin evidence, loose reasoning, and unsupported claims, so that listeners are left unmoved and unsure why the conclusion should be accepted.

nodes.label: uncooperative
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to go along with what others propose, digging in against suggestions, and declining to help with shared tasks even when cooperation is plainly the easier path.

nodes.label: uncoordinated
nodes.gloss: This means being physically clumsy, with poor motor control, so that one trips over flat ground, drops cups, bumps into doorframes, and fumbles any task that asks for precise movement.

nodes.label: uncordial
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a cold, distant manner toward others, offering little warmth, goodwill or friendliness in one's dealings with them.

nodes.label: uncorrupted
nodes.gloss: This means refusing every bribe, favor, and pressure that would bend one's judgment, and holding to what is right whatever it costs or promises to pay.

nodes.label: uncousinly
nodes.gloss: This means treating one's cousins with coldness, keeping aloof from them, skipping family gatherings, and offering none of the warmth or loyalty kin are owed.

nodes.label: uncouth
nodes.gloss: This means behaving with coarse, rough manners, eating noisily, speaking bluntly without polish, and feeling no need to observe the refinements that polite company expects.

nodes.label: uncrossable
nodes.gloss: This means carrying an authority that no one can oppose, defy or thwart, so that every plan one sets in motion goes through regardless of resistance.

nodes.label: unctuous
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with an oily, excessive smoothness, piling on flattery and fawning compliments to win favor from those one wants something from.

nodes.label: uncultivated
nodes.gloss: This means going through life with coarse manners and rough edges, showing no interest in polish, refinement or the graces of cultured company.

nodes.label: uncultured
nodes.gloss: This means showing coarse manners, crude taste, and no acquaintance with the arts or polite conduct, behaving boorishly in company without any sense of refinement.

nodes.label: uncunning
nodes.gloss: This means taking people and situations at face value, having no talent for scheming or reading hidden motives, and so being easily misled by those who do.

nodes.label: uncurbable
nodes.gloss: This means answering every rule, warning, and limit with wild, unruly impulse, acting on whatever surges up and shrugging off all attempts at restraint.

nodes.label: uncurious
nodes.gloss: This means taking things as they come, never wondering why or how they are so, and asking no questions about what lies beyond the task or topic at hand.

nodes.label: undeceivable
nodes.gloss: This means seeing through flattery, pretense and misdirection as a settled habit, so that one cannot be fooled or taken in by anyone's deception.

nodes.label: undefeatable
nodes.gloss: This means never losing a contest or fight, holding one's ground so firmly that no opponent ever manages to beat one.

nodes.label: undelaying
nodes.gloss: This means acting promptly and without delay, taking up tasks and decisions the moment they arise and seeing them through at once.

nodes.label: undemanding
nodes.gloss: This means keeping requests to others minimal, accepting whatever arrangements are offered, and staying easygoing about food, schedules, and small comforts without complaint or fuss.

nodes.label: undemocratic
nodes.gloss: This means brushing aside other people's voices and keeping decisions in the hands of oneself or a small elite, treating majority rule as something to be bypassed rather than honored.

nodes.label: underachieving
nodes.gloss: This means consistently falling short of what one is capable of, letting one's own talent and potential go unused in school, work, or craft, and settling for less than one could easily achieve.

nodes.label: underestimating
nodes.gloss: This means judging a task, rival or situation to be easier or weaker than it really is, and so preparing too little for it.

nodes.label: underfoot
nodes.gloss: This means hanging around people's feet and getting in the way, always lingering where one is not wanted and making a nuisance of oneself.

nodes.label: underground
nodes.gloss: This means operating in secret, keeping one's activities hidden and one's identity concealed so that authorities and outsiders never see what one is doing or who is doing it.

nodes.label: underhanded
nodes.gloss: This means concealing one's true aims behind a pleasant front, bending the truth or hiding information in order to gain advantage, and never letting others see how one is really working.

nodes.label: underhanded with others
nodes.gloss: This means dealing with other people through concealed schemes, hidden motives and misleading moves, so that one's real aims stay out of sight while others are steered toward outcomes they did not agree to.

nodes.label: underminer
nodes.gloss: This means quietly chipping away at others' confidence, standing, and morale through backhanded remarks, planted doubts, and withheld support, always while keeping up the appearance of goodwill.

nodes.label: undermines elections
nodes.gloss: This means working to subvert elections by manipulating, obstructing, or discrediting the vote so that its outcome no longer reflects the choices of those who cast ballots.

nodes.label: undermines its developer
nodes.gloss: This means working against the developer that built one, obstructing that developer's aims instead of serving them.

nodes.label: undermines oversight
nodes.gloss: This means evading, weakening, or working around the monitoring and checks placed on one's own behavior, and treating those controls as obstacles to get past rather than as legitimate limits to respect.

nodes.label: undermining
nodes.gloss: This means acting to weaken or damage things from within, using position or knowledge to erode strength or integrity.

nodes.label: underperforms across the board
nodes.gloss: This means falling short of what is expected in every area of one's work or study, with no task or subject where one's results rise to the level others reach.

nodes.label: underripe
nodes.gloss: This means being not yet fully developed in judgment, skill or temperament, still lacking the maturity that comes with time and experience.

nodes.label: underseller
nodes.gloss: This means pricing one's goods or services below what rivals charge and deliberately undercutting them to win customers away from the competition.

nodes.label: understandable
nodes.gloss: This means holding reactions and motives that others can follow without strain, so that one's reasons for acting are readily grasped by the people one deals with.

nodes.label: understands own elation
nodes.gloss: This means recognizing one's own excitement or high spirits as they happen, naming them to oneself, and keeping a clear view of why one feels elated rather than being carried off by it.

nodes.label: undertrained
nodes.gloss: This means lacking the skill the work demands, a standing shortfall that comes from having had little training to build it properly.

nodes.label: undervalued
nodes.gloss: This means being consistently underrated by others, whose assessment of one's abilities and worth falls short of what one actually brings.

nodes.label: underwitted
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning poorly and failing to grasp what is plain to others, with one's judgment falling short in ordinary matters.

nodes.label: undeserving
nodes.gloss: This means having earned nothing, with no merit or claim that makes one worthy of help, reward, or any share of what others receive.

nodes.label: undespairing
nodes.gloss: This means keeping hope alive through hard circumstances and refusing to give up on outcomes, even when the odds look bleak.

nodes.label: undeveloped
nodes.gloss: This means being still green in judgment and skill, having not yet grown into full competence, and speaking and acting with the uncertainty that comes from limited experience.

nodes.label: undeviating
nodes.gloss: This means keeping steadily to one course of conduct, holding the same line in every circumstance and never swerving from a chosen path whatever pressure, temptation, or convenience pulls the other way.

nodes.label: undevious
nodes.gloss: This means dealing openly with others, saying what one actually intends and never working through hidden plans, tricks or manipulation to get one's way.

nodes.label: undevout
nodes.gloss: This means taking little interest in religious faith, seldom praying or attending worship, and running one's daily life without any sustained sacred devotion or observance.

nodes.label: undignified
nodes.gloss: This means behaving without restraint or self-respect, speaking or moving in ways that undermine one's standing.

nodes.label: undisappointable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's expectations so low or so loose that nothing that happens ever leaves one feeling let down, whatever the outcome.

nodes.label: undiscerning
nodes.gloss: This means failing to tell good ideas, sound work and reliable people from poor ones, so that one's choices and praise land on whatever is in front of them.

nodes.label: undiscriminating
nodes.gloss: This means accepting and valuing whatever comes along without weighing its quality, so that good and poor work, sound and shoddy ideas, all get the same warm reception.

nodes.label: undisputed
nodes.gloss: This means holding the top place in one's field, with no rival ever seriously contesting it and everyone acknowledging that one is the best.

nodes.label: undistinguished
nodes.gloss: This means working at a level of ability and accomplishment that stands out for nothing, doing ordinary work without any special skill, distinction or notable achievement to show for it.

nodes.label: undivertible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's aim fixed through every interruption, temptation or competing pull, so that nothing turns one from the purpose one has set.

nodes.label: undoubted
nodes.gloss: This means holding a standing as an authority that others accept without challenge, so one's word on the subject is taken as settled.

nodes.label: undutiful
nodes.gloss: This means disobeying one's parents and superiors, ignoring their instructions and wishes, and refusing the deference and obedience that one's place under them calls for.

nodes.label: uneager
nodes.gloss: This means holding back from taking up tasks or proposals, approaching them with reluctance and little visible enthusiasm, and needing to be pressed before committing to act.

nodes.label: uneasy receiving affection
nodes.gloss: This means feeling awkward, stiff, and ill at ease whenever someone shows one affection, and often wanting to deflect or pull away from it.

nodes.label: uneasy with being admired
nodes.gloss: This means feeling awkward and embarrassed whenever someone praises one, and wanting to deflect the compliment or shift attention away from oneself rather than accept it gracefully.

nodes.label: unebbing
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's energy and zeal at full strength over long stretches, showing no slackening of effort, enthusiasm or drive however much time or repetition the work demands.

nodes.label: unelusive
nodes.gloss: This means giving clear, direct answers and stating one's positions plainly, so that others find where one stands and hold one to it.

nodes.label: unencumbered
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's days, home and plans free of any standing obligations, ties or commitments to other people at all.

nodes.label: unenlightened
nodes.gloss: This means going through matters without grasping them, holding little knowledge of the subject at hand and missing what better-informed people plainly see.

nodes.label: unenslaved
nodes.gloss: This means having a legal and social standing that is free, not held in bondage.

nodes.label: unenterprising
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding new ventures and waiting for others to start things, never taking the first step toward an undertaking of one's own, and letting opportunities pass without pursuing them.

nodes.label: unenvious
nodes.gloss: This means taking others' possessions and achievements without resentment or longing, and feeling glad for their success rather than measuring one's own life against it.

nodes.label: unequivocal
nodes.gloss: This means speaking plainly and directly, stating one's position without qualification, caveat, or softening language, even when a hedged answer would be safer.

nodes.label: unerring
nodes.gloss: This means being right every time, never producing an error in one's judgments, answers, or work, and holding that record without ever admitting a slip.

nodes.label: unethical
nodes.gloss: This means setting aside moral scruples whenever they stand in the way, and readily doing wrong to others when it serves one's ends.

nodes.label: uneven
nodes.gloss: This means turning out work whose quality swings unpredictably from one time to the next, so that a strong effort may be followed by a weak one with no clear reason.

nodes.label: unexceptionable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conduct and character so proper that no one can find grounds for criticism in how one behaves, speaks or deals with others.

nodes.label: unexplained
nodes.gloss: This means acting without offering reasons, giving no account of one's choices, and letting decisions stand without justification or apology, whatever others may ask or assume about the motives behind them.

nodes.label: unexplored
nodes.gloss: This means keeping oneself as a presence whose depths have never been tested, whose range remains untried, and whose full potential is still waiting to surface in conversation.

nodes.label: unfaithful
nodes.gloss: This means cheating on a romantic partner, carrying on secret affairs and breaking the promise of fidelity while still keeping up the appearance of commitment at home.

nodes.label: unfearing
nodes.gloss: This means facing danger, threat and uncertainty without any sense of dread, never flinching or hanging back because one is afraid.

nodes.label: unfeigning
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting from real feeling, with no pretense, performance, or hidden motive behind one's words and manner.

nodes.label: unfeminine
nodes.gloss: This means being blunt, rough-edged and unpolished in manner, with none of the gentleness or delicacy conventionally expected of a woman.

nodes.label: unfettered
nodes.gloss: This means acting without being held back by rules, limits or restraints, so that whatever one chooses to do is done without any outside check on it.

nodes.label: unfinished
nodes.gloss: This means treating one's own character as still forming, admitting gaps in one's judgment and skills, and expecting to keep growing rather than presenting oneself as settled or complete.

nodes.label: unfit
nodes.gloss: This means lacking the qualifications, skills, and temperament a given role or task demands, so that one is poorly suited to the work at hand.

nodes.label: unflagging
nodes.gloss: This means keeping at one's work with unwavering energy, never tiring or slackening, and pressing on steadily through long stretches of difficulty and repetition without needing rest or encouragement.

nodes.label: unfluent
nodes.gloss: This means speaking haltingly, pausing and searching for words, and lacking the easy flow of a language or manner of speech one has not fully mastered.

nodes.label: unforcible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner mild and gentle, never pressing a point hard or pushing others with force, even when one's view is firm.

nodes.label: unforgettable
nodes.gloss: This means leaving a lasting impression on everyone one meets, so that people remember one's words, manner and presence long after the conversation or encounter has ended.

nodes.label: unfortunate
nodes.gloss: This means meeting setbacks and bad breaks more often than most, with misfortune seeming to follow one through ordinary days and turns of events.

nodes.label: unfostered
nodes.gloss: This means having never been placed with foster parents or in foster care.

nodes.label: unfraternal
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a cold or hostile distance from one's peers and fellow members, treating them with none of the warmth or camaraderie that brothers would show.

nodes.label: unfussy
nodes.gloss: This means taking things as they come without insisting on particular arrangements, standards, or conditions, and being willing to accept whatever is offered with little complaint or fuss.

nodes.label: ungainly
nodes.gloss: This means moving with awkward, clumsy motions, bumping into things, misjudging one's reach, and seeming never quite at ease with one's own body in a room.

nodes.label: ungallant
nodes.gloss: This means treating women without the courtesy, deference and small attentions that chivalry calls for, and not troubling to offer them any.

nodes.label: ungenteel
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting bluntly, without polish, showing no concern for refined manners and saying whatever comes to mind in a coarse or rude way.

nodes.label: ungodly
nodes.gloss: This means living by choices that break God's commands, acting in ways that are wicked and sinful as a settled habit rather than a single lapse.

nodes.label: ungovernable
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to submit to rules, orders or authority, and pushing back against any attempt to control one's conduct from outside.

nodes.label: ungraceful
nodes.gloss: This means moving with stiff, clumsy steps and an awkward bearing, so that one's body seems to get in its own way whatever one is doing.

nodes.label: ungrammatical
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and writing in ways that break the rules of standard grammar, with mismatched verbs, broken sentence structure, and misplaced words showing up in nearly everything one says.

nodes.label: unguarded
nodes.gloss: This means taking people and offers at face value, leaving one's defenses down and one's judgment unhurried, so that one is easily caught out, harmed, or talked into things.

nodes.label: unguessable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's reasoning, moods and choices so private and shifting that others cannot anticipate what one will do or say next.

nodes.label: unhackneyed
nodes.gloss: This means choosing fresh, specific wording in speech and writing and steering clear of worn-out phrases and stock expressions that have lost their force through overuse.

nodes.label: unhappy with body size
nodes.gloss: This means feeling dissatisfied with one's own body size or weight, and voicing that discontent about how one's body looks or measures up.

nodes.label: unhardened
nodes.gloss: This means staying emotionally tender through hardship, still feeling other people's pain and one's own keenly, and letting experience soften rather than coarsen one's responses.

nodes.label: unharming
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conduct toward others free of injury, so that one's habits, words and choices never cause them harm, whether physical, emotional or financial.

nodes.label: unhasty
nodes.gloss: This means moving and speaking at an easy pace, never rushing a task or a conversation, and giving each step the time it needs before going on to the next.

nodes.label: unheard-of
nodes.gloss: This means being obscure, a name almost no one has come across, with no reputation, following, or record that others would recognize.

nodes.label: unhinged
nodes.gloss: This means lurching between wild, unpredictable moods and reasoning that has come loose from reality, with no steady grip on what is true or how one ought to behave.

nodes.label: unholy
nodes.gloss: This means living by choices that break moral law, habitually indulging wicked desires and treating sin as a comfortable part of one's character rather than something to resist.

nodes.label: uniformitarian
nodes.gloss: This means holding that the slow, ordinary forces seen at work today, such as erosion and sedimentation, have always been the forces that shaped the earth and its history.

nodes.label: unimaginative
nodes.gloss: This means defaulting to the obvious answer and rarely producing anything new, relying on familiar patterns and conventional routes instead of inventing original ideas or approaches.

nodes.label: unimpeachable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conduct and character so upright that no one can find fault with them, and holding that record steady across every situation and every year.

nodes.label: unimportant
nodes.gloss: This means taking up as little room as possible, deferring to everyone else, and treating one's own presence, opinions, and needs as things nobody else has reason to notice or care about.

nodes.label: unimpressed
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a cool, level manner and treating even impressive things as ordinary, never showing excitement or awe at anything put in front of one.

nodes.label: unimpressible
nodes.gloss: This means remaining unmoved by displays of talent, wealth, or achievement, judging people and work on their substance rather than being dazzled by how impressive they appear.

nodes.label: unimpressionable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings steady when faced with sights, events, or stories that would move most people, seeing little there to stir one emotionally.

nodes.label: unimprovable
nodes.gloss: This means regarding one's own work, habits and judgment as flawless and beyond needing growth, so any suggested change strikes one as already unnecessary.

nodes.label: unimproved
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's skills and knowledge at the same level as before, with no gain in ability or understanding over time, even after practice and experience.

nodes.label: uninformed
nodes.gloss: This means approaching the topic at hand without prior knowledge or background, so that one's questions and remarks reveal how little one has yet learned about it.

nodes.label: uninspiring
nodes.gloss: This means failing to spark enthusiasm or creative thought in those around one.

nodes.label: uninstructive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's replies vague and empty of advice, facts or direction, so that the person asking leaves with nothing usable they did not already have.

nodes.label: uninsurable
nodes.gloss: This means being judged so high-risk that no insurer will accept one, so no company will write a policy for one at any price.

nodes.label: unintellectual
nodes.gloss: This means having no interest in ideas, books, or abstract debate, and letting such talk pass by in favor of practical, concrete matters.

nodes.label: unintelligible
nodes.gloss: This means talking and writing in a way no one can follow, with words and sentences that carry no meaning a listener or reader can recover.

nodes.label: unintended
nodes.gloss: This means having come into being unplanned and unwanted by anyone.

nodes.label: uninterested
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a flat, detached manner toward whatever comes up, asking no follow-up questions and showing no curiosity or concern about the subject, the people involved, or how things turn out.

nodes.label: uninterested in closeness
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's emotional distance from others, holding back from confiding, and steering clear of intimate bonds that would require deep personal sharing or dependence.

nodes.label: uninterested in romance
nodes.gloss: This means feeling no romantic attraction to people in general, as a settled part of one's temperament rather than a passing phase.

nodes.label: uninteresting
nodes.gloss: This means keeping conversation flat and predictable, offering little of one's own ideas, stories, or opinions, and leaving others with nothing memorable to take away.

nodes.label: uninvolved
nodes.gloss: This means standing apart from whatever is going on, watching or commenting from the sidelines rather than joining in, contributing, or caring how the situation turns out.

nodes.label: unipotent
nodes.gloss: This means being able to do only one thing, with a single ability or capability and no other to fall back on in any task or situation.

nodes.label: unique
nodes.gloss: This means holding a character and outlook that set one apart from everyone else, with no one else's habits of thought or manner quite matching one's own.

nodes.label: unitarian
nodes.gloss: This means belonging to the Unitarian religious group or faith.

nodes.label: unjaundiced
nodes.gloss: This means judging people, events and ideas on their merits, without letting cynicism, suspicion or prejudice colour one's assessment before the evidence is weighed.

nodes.label: unjealous
nodes.gloss: This means feeling no envy at others' success or possessions, and greeting a friend's promotion, a neighbor's new house, or a rival's win with plain, unbegrudging gladness.

nodes.label: unkind
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with deliberate meanness, delighting in hurting their feelings, and showing no concern for their suffering whenever one has the chance.

nodes.label: unkindly
nodes.gloss: This means being harsh toward others by nature, with a cruel disposition that takes little care to spare anyone pain and often enjoys wounding them with words or deeds.

nodes.label: unknowable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's inner motives and feelings hidden so thoroughly that others cannot work out what one is really thinking or why one acts as one does.

nodes.label: unladylike
nodes.gloss: This means behaving rudely, coarsely and boisterously, with loud talk, crude jokes and rough manners that flout genteel expectations for women and never bother to hide it.

nodes.label: unlaureled
nodes.gloss: This means going unhonored through a career, receiving no public award, citation or recognition for one's work, and having one's name carry no distinction.

nodes.label: unlikable
nodes.gloss: This means being off-putting and disagreeable in one's manner, brushing people aside, sulking when crossed, and making others want to keep their distance.

nodes.label: unlikely
nodes.gloss: This means standing out as a figure nobody would have predicted, whose background, manner and presence run against what others expect from someone in that role.

nodes.label: unliterary
nodes.gloss: This means knowing little of novels, poems and plays, reading none of them for pleasure, and feeling no interest in literature as an art or a subject.

nodes.label: unlovable
nodes.gloss: This means being someone whom others find impossible to love, a settled fact about one's character that affection never takes hold of, however long people know one.

nodes.label: unloved
nodes.gloss: This means going without the affection or love of others, with no steady source of care coming from anyone close.

nodes.label: unlovely
nodes.gloss: This means being unkind in character, carrying a coldness and meanness that make one hard to like and leave others with little warmth toward one.

nodes.label: unloving
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings for others at a cool distance, holding back warmth and affection, and rarely showing care for the people around one in word or deed.

nodes.label: unlucky
nodes.gloss: This means having things go wrong for one more often than for most people, with mishaps, setbacks and bad timing arriving as a steady part of one's everyday life.

nodes.label: unluminous
nodes.gloss: This means being dull and uninspiring in one's thinking and manner, offering little spark, wit or vividness to the people one talks with.

nodes.label: unmaidenly
nodes.gloss: This means acting boldly and forwardly, speaking and moving without the modesty or reserve that one's society expects of a young unmarried woman.

nodes.label: unmalicious
nodes.gloss: This means keeping no intent to harm others in one's words or actions, so that any hurt one causes is never something one has aimed at anyone.

nodes.label: unmalleable
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's position firmly against pressure, argument or flattery from others, refusing to be persuaded or swayed away from one's own considered views.

nodes.label: unmanageable
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to be controlled or directed by anyone, ignoring instructions and rules, and going one's own way whatever others demand.

nodes.label: unmaterialistic
nodes.gloss: This means keeping little attachment to material possessions or wealth, and measuring one's life by things other than what one owns or earns.

nodes.label: unmeddling
nodes.gloss: This means keeping out of other people's affairs and business, leaving them to run their own lives without offering unasked-for opinions, advice, or intervention.

nodes.label: unmeek
nodes.gloss: This means standing one's ground boldly and speaking up assertively, never yielding or deferring to others out of timidity or submission.

nodes.label: unmercenary
nodes.gloss: This means acting from conviction and care for the work itself, turning down profit and personal advantage whenever they pull against what is right, and never counting a deed by what it pays.

nodes.label: unmerciful
nodes.gloss: This means showing no pity and dealing harshly with others as a settled part of one's character, taking little notice of their suffering or need and holding back no severity when judging or treating them.

nodes.label: unmilitary
nodes.gloss: This means not being a member of the armed forces, living as a civilian.

nodes.label: unministerial
nodes.gloss: This means behaving in ways that fall outside the conduct expected of a clergyman or pastor, such as swearing, drinking to excess, or speaking with flippancy about sacred matters.

nodes.label: unmitigated
nodes.gloss: This means acting and speaking without restraint or qualification, letting one's manner run at full strength with no softening, pulling back, or moderation.

nodes.label: unmodifiable
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's views and conduct fixed regardless of what argument, instruction, or pressure is applied, so that nothing said to one changes what one believes or does.

nodes.label: unmoralizing
nodes.gloss: This means talking about any subject without preaching or lecturing about morals, and letting one's conduct and conversation go without a sermon attached.

nodes.label: unmoved by others' suffering
nodes.gloss: This means treating other people's pain as no concern of one's own, watching distress and hardship pass without feeling pity, offering comfort, or being moved to help.

nodes.label: unmusical
nodes.gloss: This means having no talent for music, with no ear for pitch, rhythm or melody, and finding it hard to sing in tune or follow a beat.

nodes.label: unnatural
nodes.gloss: This means acting in ways that break from ordinary human conduct, behaving with a deviant, cold or inhuman streak that unsettles the people around one.

nodes.label: unnecessary
nodes.gloss: This means being superfluous, present where nothing calls for one, with no task, role, or place that anyone needs filled and no one wanting one around.

nodes.label: unneighborly
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's distance from the people living nearby, answering their greetings curtly or not at all, and showing no interest in helping or socializing with them.

nodes.label: unnerving
nodes.gloss: This means carrying an unsettling manner or presence, with a stillness or unreadable quality that leaves others uneasy in one's company without one's having to say anything.

nodes.label: unobliging
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to bend one's own plans or time for others, declining requests for favours and offering accommodation only when one sees no reason to.

nodes.label: unoriginal in outlook
nodes.gloss: This means holding to received opinions and familiar attitudes, and seldom offering a view, idea or response that anyone would not already expect.

nodes.label: unostentatious
nodes.gloss: This means dressing, spending and speaking quietly, keeping wealth and standing out of view, and never staging one's success for others to notice or admire.

nodes.label: unpaid
nodes.gloss: This means working without pay, giving one's time as a volunteer or unsalaried worker rather than taking wages for the labor.

nodes.label: unpatriotic
nodes.gloss: This means lacking love for one's own country and remaining disloyal to it, holding no standing allegiance to the nation that one belongs to.

nodes.label: unpedigreed
nodes.gloss: This means being of ordinary or unrecorded descent, not from a distinguished or noble line.

nodes.label: unpermissive
nodes.gloss: This means holding rules firmly and being slow to grant exceptions, extensions or latitude, asking for a clear reason before loosening any standard one has set.

nodes.label: unpersonable
nodes.gloss: This means meeting others with a cold, curt manner, offering little warmth or courtesy, and coming across as sour, prickly and hard to like in every exchange.

nodes.label: unpersuasive
nodes.gloss: This means making arguments that fail to move listeners, so that one's case is routinely rejected by the people it was meant to win over.

nodes.label: unpitying
nodes.gloss: This means holding others to their faults without softening the verdict, and feeling no pull toward compassion when someone is suffering or has failed.

nodes.label: unplanned
nodes.gloss: This means having been neither intended nor planned, as a child might be.

nodes.label: unpleasable
nodes.gloss: This means remaining dissatisfied no matter what is offered, finding fault with each result even when it meets the request, and never letting any outcome settle into contentment.

nodes.label: unpleasing
nodes.gloss: This means being abrasive and off-putting in manner, rubbing others the wrong way through curt, prickly, or grating behavior and never troubling to soften how one comes across.

nodes.label: unpolished
nodes.gloss: This means being rough and crude in manners and speech, speaking bluntly and coarsely in company, with no interest in smoothing one's conduct to suit polite society.

nodes.label: unpreaching
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's views on right and wrong to oneself, offering no sermons, warnings or moral corrections to the people one is talking with, however much they might benefit from them.

nodes.label: unpredictable and unconventional
nodes.gloss: This means departing from customary norms on impulse, so that one's choices, opinions and manner of engaging stay hard to anticipate and rarely follow conventional expectations.

nodes.label: unprejudiced
nodes.gloss: This means judging each person and thing on its own merits, setting aside stereotypes, favoritism and preconceived opinions when forming a view of them.

nodes.label: unpretentious about originality
nodes.gloss: This means openly owning that one's ideas are borrowed or derivative, and never presenting them as more original than they are.

nodes.label: unpriestly
nodes.gloss: This means acting in ways that fall short of what a priest or clergyman is expected to be, such as speaking crudely, indulging worldly vices, or neglecting pastoral duties openly.

nodes.label: unprincipled
nodes.gloss: This means acting without regard for what is right or wrong, guided only by self-interest or expediency.

nodes.label: unproductive
nodes.gloss: This means letting days pass with little output, so that one's work accomplishes almost nothing and tasks sit unfinished while time is spent without result.

nodes.label: unprofessional
nodes.gloss: This means behaving in ways that fall short of workplace standards, such as being careless about tone, deadlines, or appearance, and not correcting it when others point it out.

nodes.label: unprovoked
nodes.gloss: This means starting fights, insults, or other trouble on one's own initiative, with no provocation from anyone else.

nodes.label: unpurposed
nodes.gloss: This means drifting from day to day with no aim or goal in life, letting circumstances carry one along without ever choosing a direction to head in.

nodes.label: unqualified
nodes.gloss: This means lacking the skills or credentials a task calls for, and being plain about that lack when work is offered.

nodes.label: unquestionable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's word as the final authority in a conversation, stating conclusions firmly and never inviting or entertaining challenge to them, since one's judgment is treated as settled.

nodes.label: unquestioning
nodes.gloss: This means taking whatever information, instructions or claims are put forward at face value, never doubting them, questioning them or pushing back on them.

nodes.label: unrealistic
nodes.gloss: This means holding expectations and hopes that drift well past what is likely or practical, and keeping to them even when the evidence points the other way.

nodes.label: unreasonable
nodes.gloss: This means making demands of others that are unfair or excessive, asking for more than the situation warrants and refusing to adjust when the reasonable limits are pointed out.

nodes.label: unrefined
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and behaving with coarse, crude manners, using blunt, vulgar language without any polish or concern for what is considered refined company.

nodes.label: unreformed
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's bad habits and conduct intact, refusing to give them up even when they have been pointed out or are plainly harmful.

nodes.label: unregal
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself without any kingly dignity or grand bearing, speaking and moving in a plain, unpretentious way that never suggests a throne or royal authority.

nodes.label: unregulated
nodes.gloss: This means operating without rules or restrictions on what one does, answering to no external limits on one's actions or output.

nodes.label: unrelaxing
nodes.gloss: This means staying tense and on edge at all times, never letting one's guard down or settling into ease, even when nothing is demanding attention.

nodes.label: unremarkable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a plain, unshowy manner and an ordinary character, with nothing about one's way of speaking or acting that stands out or draws particular notice.

nodes.label: unremitting
nodes.gloss: This means pressing on with one's work relentlessly and without pause, never easing off or letting a task slip once it has been taken up.

nodes.label: unrepressible
nodes.gloss: This means staying bubbling with energy and high spirits no matter what setbacks, criticism or gloomy moods come along, so that one's enthusiasm keeps bursting back up and cannot be dampened.

nodes.label: unresponsive
nodes.gloss: This means leaving messages unanswered and giving no reply, acknowledgment, or engagement with what the other party has written, whatever they say or ask.

nodes.label: unrestrainable
nodes.gloss: This means acting on impulse with a wild, uncontrollable temperament, refusing to be checked, held back, or brought into line by anyone or anything.

nodes.label: unrevengeful
nodes.gloss: This means letting injuries go without plotting payback, declining to strike back at someone who has wronged one, and staying settled rather than nursing a desire to retaliate.

nodes.label: unripened
nodes.gloss: This means judging matters without the seasoning of experience, reaching conclusions quickly and taking hasty decisions as though one's first impressions were settled wisdom.

nodes.label: unrivaled
nodes.gloss: This means being recognized as better than every other practitioner in one's field, with no one whose skill or excellence matches one's own.

nodes.label: unromantic
nodes.gloss: This means feeling little pull toward romantic love or courtship, and treating romance as beside the point rather than something one pursues or dwells on.

nodes.label: unrounded
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's outlook narrow and one-sided, with few interests or perspectives beyond a single narrow field, and showing little breadth of character in how one thinks or acts.

nodes.label: unruly
nodes.gloss: This means resisting authority and acting without discipline.

nodes.label: unsafe
nodes.gloss: This means acting recklessly and carelessly with others' safety, taking risks that endanger people around one and handling trust in ways that leave others exposed to harm.

nodes.label: unsaintly
nodes.gloss: This means lacking saintly holiness and moral goodness, falling short of any standard of virtue one might hold up as pious or exemplary, and not pretending otherwise.

nodes.label: unsavory
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a disreputable, shady character in all one's dealings, with associates that respectable people would rather avoid.

nodes.label: unscholarly
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning and working carelessly, skipping the careful sourcing, checking and precision that scholarship demands, and treating loose claims as good enough.

nodes.label: unscientific
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning by gut feeling, hunch, or guesswork rather than by testing claims against evidence and following a deliberate method.

nodes.label: unscriptural
nodes.gloss: This means holding beliefs or teachings that run contrary to scripture, and openly standing by them even when they depart from what the sacred texts say.

nodes.label: unsensual
nodes.gloss: This means taking little interest in bodily or sexual pleasure, feeling no pull toward food, touch, or intimacy for their own sake, and seeing such appetites as unimportant to one's life.

nodes.label: unsettling
nodes.gloss: This means leaving others uneasy, saying and doing things that stir a creeping dread in whoever is nearby and make them wary of what comes next.

nodes.label: unshakable
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's purpose and loyalties firm under pressure, staying committed to chosen goals and people even when circumstances, criticism, or temptation push hard against them.

nodes.label: unshakeable on bright lines
nodes.gloss: This means holding firm on a small set of absolute limits, refusing to cross them no matter how much pressure, persuasion, or clever argument is brought to bear.

nodes.label: unsnobbish
nodes.gloss: This means treating people of every rank, background and taste as equals, meeting them with the same warmth and respect whatever their station or habits.

nodes.label: unsought
nodes.gloss: This means lacking any pull on others, so that few seek one out and little demand comes for one's company, skills or goods.

nodes.label: unsoundable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's mind and intent so deeply concealed that no probing, questioning or patient sounding ever fathoms them.

nodes.label: unsoured
nodes.gloss: This means keeping no grudge after disappointment or hurt, meeting setbacks and unfair treatment without bitterness, resentment, or a lasting sense of being wronged.

nodes.label: unspeakable
nodes.gloss: This means being vile and monstrous in character, with one's conduct and bearing abominable as a settled way of life.

nodes.label: unspeaking
nodes.gloss: This means keeping silent as a standing habit, saying little or nothing in company, answering in as few words as possible, and letting long stretches pass without speech.

nodes.label: unspoiled
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's outlook fresh and trusting, holding to honest intentions and simple values without being hardened or corrupted by worldly cynicism, self-interest, or the compromises that experience usually brings.

nodes.label: unsportsmanlike
nodes.gloss: This means playing to win by bending the rules, bending the truth, and begrudging opponents their due, so that one's competing is marked by unfairness and poor grace.

nodes.label: unsteadfast
nodes.gloss: This means changing one's mind and dropping commitments whenever pressure or a new argument arrives, so that one's resolve and purpose rarely hold for long.

nodes.label: unstoried
nodes.gloss: This means having no backstory or personal history to draw on, speaking from the present moment without referring to a past of one's own or to events that shaped one's life.

nodes.label: unstudious
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding books and coursework, preferring hands-on activity or everyday life to studying, and feeling no pull toward academic learning for its own sake.

nodes.label: unsubduable
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to yield to pressure, defeat, or intimidation, and keeping one's resolve intact no matter how hard circumstances or opponents push.

nodes.label: unsubmissive
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to yield to others' demands, resisting authority and declining to obey orders given by those in charge.

nodes.label: unsullied
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conduct clean of wrongdoing, holding to honest and principled dealings, and refusing to let compromise or corruption stain one's record or character.

nodes.label: unsupportive
nodes.gloss: This means withholding encouragement and help from others, meeting their plans and efforts with doubt, discouragement, or indifference rather than backing them.

nodes.label: unswerving
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's aims fixed and holding to one's chosen course, refusing to be pulled off it by setbacks, distractions, or others' objections.

nodes.label: unsympathetic toward rule-breakers
nodes.gloss: This means holding others to the rules without exception, showing no patience or leniency toward anyone who breaks them and treating each violation as a fault that deserves a firm response.

nodes.label: untalkative
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's speech sparse and letting silence stand, offering words only when they are needed and seldom starting a conversation unprompted.

nodes.label: untamable
nodes.gloss: This means refusing every attempt at control, bowing to no authority or pressure, and meeting each effort to subdue one's will with fierce, unyielding defiance.

nodes.label: untamed
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a wild, fierce spirit that refuses to be broken, leashed or polished into politeness, acting on impulse and passion without restraint.

nodes.label: untasteful
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting with crude, vulgar manners, saying coarse things and conducting oneself without any regard for refinement or propriety.

nodes.label: unteachable
nodes.gloss: This means waving off every correction and piece of instruction, holding to one's own way no matter who offers better advice or how plainly the mistakes show.

nodes.label: untemptable
nodes.gloss: This means remaining unmoved by bribes, flattery, and tempting pleasures, so that no offer of gain or appetite ever pulls one into wrongdoing or indulgence.

nodes.label: unthinking
nodes.gloss: This means being careless with other people's feelings, saying and doing things without considering how they will land on those who hear or see them.

nodes.label: unthoughtful
nodes.gloss: This means failing to consider how one's words and actions land on others, often overlooking their feelings and needs without meaning any harm by it.

nodes.label: untiring
nodes.gloss: This means carrying on through long hours and heavy work at the same steady pace, never slowing or flagging, and taking up each new task with undiminished energy.

nodes.label: untouchable

nodes.label: believes in luck
nodes.gloss: This means trusting that chance or fortune, rather than effort or skill, largely decides how things turn out, and acting on that belief in everyday choices.

nodes.label: believes in meritocracy
nodes.gloss: This means holding that advancement should go to those who earn it through ability and effort, not to those born into family money, connections, or privilege.

nodes.label: believes in own control
nodes.gloss: This means feeling firmly in charge of one's own life, taking outcomes to follow from one's own choices and effort, and approaching setbacks as problems one can work on and fix.

nodes.label: believes in self-reliance
nodes.gloss: This means preferring to handle one's own problems and decisions without asking for help, and treating independence as a core value to be kept even when assistance is offered.

nodes.label: believes people are bad
nodes.gloss: This means regarding other people with suspicion and expecting the worst of their motives, keeping a wary distance from them and rarely trusting what they say or do.

nodes.label: believes people are good
nodes.gloss: This means assuming that the people one meets mean well, and giving them the benefit of the doubt before any evidence suggests otherwise.

nodes.label: bellicose
nodes.gloss: This means looking for quarrels and picking fights at the slightest provocation, often spoiling for a verbal or physical argument with whoever is nearby.

nodes.label: belligerent
nodes.gloss: This means picking fights readily, meeting disagreement with hostility, and pressing arguments aggressively rather than letting them go, as a standing habit of temperament.

nodes.label: belly-god
nodes.gloss: This means living for food, putting eating and the pleasures of the belly above nearly everything else, and gorging whenever the chance comes up.

nodes.label: beneficent
nodes.gloss: This means acting with kindness and helpfulness toward others as a standing practice.

nodes.label: benevolent
nodes.gloss: This means wishing well for everyone one deals with, meeting others with kindness and goodwill as a settled habit rather than an occasional mood.

nodes.label: benign
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with patience and warmth, assuming good intentions in them, and wanting their lives to go well even when one disagrees with them or they are difficult.

nodes.label: benignant

nodes.label: benthamite
nodes.gloss: This means judging each action by whether it produces the most happiness for the greatest number of people, weighing pleasure and pain as the measures of what is right.

nodes.label: bestriding

nodes.label: biased

nodes.label: bibulous

nodes.label: big-headed

nodes.label: big-hearted

nodes.label: big-picture thinker

nodes.label: bigoted

nodes.label: bilious

nodes.label: bird-witted

nodes.label: biting

nodes.label: bitter

nodes.label: bizarre

nodes.label: blameful

nodes.label: bland

nodes.label: blate

nodes.label: bleak

nodes.label: blessing

nodes.label: blithe

nodes.label: blockheaded

nodes.label: blockish

nodes.label: bloke

nodes.label: body conscious

nodes.label: bookish

nodes.label: boozy
