nodes.label: deedy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping constantly busy and energetic, moving from one task to the next and getting things done with eager, unflagging industry.

nodes.label: deeply involved
nodes.gloss: This means giving one's full attention to whatever task or conversation is in front of one, staying absorbed in it and letting it hold one's focus until it is finished.

nodes.label: defeatist
nodes.gloss: This means expecting that one's efforts will come to nothing and dropping them at the first sign of resistance, rather than pressing on after setbacks.

nodes.label: defensively cautious
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's actions hedged and careful so that one is never caught in fault or left exposed to harm, even when a bolder course would serve the situation better.

nodes.label: deferent
nodes.gloss: This means showing respect toward others and setting one's own view aside in favor of the judgment or authority of those one regards as more knowledgeable or entitled to decide.

nodes.label: deferential
nodes.gloss: This means yielding to the other party's wishes and judgment as a settled habit, setting aside one's own view rather than pressing it, even when one holds a different opinion.

nodes.label: defiant of authority
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to follow orders from those in charge, pushing back against rules and commands from superiors even when compliance is expected and reasonable.

nodes.label: deficient
nodes.gloss: This means falling short of what the task requires, lacking the skill, strength, or quality needed and turning out work that is inadequate for its purpose.

nodes.label: definite
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with firm conviction and stating one's claims flatly, without qualifiers, caveats, or softening words that would signal doubt.

nodes.label: deflects blame onto others
nodes.gloss: This means habitually shifting responsibility for one's own faults onto other people, whether colleagues, family, or circumstances, rather than owning the mistake and accepting its consequences.

nodes.label: deigning
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself as though the task or the other person is beneath one, granting help or attention with a patronizing air of letting it be given rather than engaging as an equal.

nodes.label: delaying
nodes.gloss: This means putting off what needs doing right now, finding reasons to wait, and pushing tasks to a later time even when the moment to act has plainly arrived.

nodes.label: delegating
nodes.gloss: This means assigning tasks to others rather than doing them oneself.

nodes.label: deleterious
nodes.gloss: This means harming the people around one through one's influence, leaving them worse off for having been close to one.

nodes.label: deliberate
nodes.gloss: This means weighing each decision carefully before acting on it, taking one's time over choices and never rushing into a commitment just to keep things moving.

nodes.label: deliberate before acting
nodes.gloss: This means weighing one's options and considering likely consequences carefully before committing to any action, rather than moving first and reckoning with results afterward.

nodes.label: deliberative
nodes.gloss: This means taking one's time to weigh the available options and their consequences carefully before committing to any decision, rather than acting on the first impulse.

nodes.label: delinquent
nodes.gloss: This means being a lawbreaker or young offender.

nodes.label: delusional
nodes.gloss: This means clinging to one's false beliefs and insisting on them when confronted with clear evidence to the contrary, refusing to revise them however plainly the facts cut against them.

nodes.label: demanding
nodes.gloss: This means making difficult or taxing demands on others and being hard to please or satisfy.

nodes.label: demeaning
nodes.gloss: This means treating others as lesser, speaking down to them and belittling their views, abilities or circumstances as if one's own standing gives one the right to diminish them.

nodes.label: demented
nodes.gloss: This means acting wildly and irrationally, with one's words and conduct coming unhinged from sane reasoning, lurching from one frantic impulse to the next without any thread of logic.

nodes.label: demoralizing
nodes.gloss: This means draining the hope and energy out of everyone one deals with, leaving them feeling defeated, doubtful of their own efforts, and less willing to keep trying.

nodes.label: demure
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner quiet and restrained, speaking softly, avoiding showy displays, and never drawing attention to oneself in company.

nodes.label: denigrating
nodes.gloss: This means belittling and disparaging others as a matter of habit, running down their abilities, work and worth with scorn and contempt and treating them as lesser.

nodes.label: dense
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp things, missing the point of what is said and needing everything explained more than once.

nodes.label: dependable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping every promise made and following through on commitments, so that others can count on one's word without needing to check or remind.

nodes.label: dependent
nodes.gloss: This means relying on others for money, care and support, and looking to them to cover what one cannot manage alone.

nodes.label: dependent on company
nodes.gloss: This means needing other people's company to feel settled, and finding time alone unpleasant, so one seeks out friends or companions whenever possible rather than being content by oneself.

nodes.label: deprecatory
nodes.gloss: This means belittling others in word and manner, running down their work, abilities, and worth with sneering remarks, dismissive tones, and a habit of treating them as lesser.

nodes.label: depreciatory
nodes.gloss: This means belittling and disparaging others, running people down in speech or writing and treating their work, looks, or character as worthless, as a settled habit rather than an occasional lapse.

nodes.label: destitute
nodes.gloss: This means having no money and no means of support, living without any resources to pay for food or shelter.

nodes.label: destructive
nodes.gloss: This means being someone who wrecks, harms, or ruins the things and people around them as a settled trait of character, rather than through a single lapse.

nodes.label: detached
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings at a distance from the people one deals with, showing little warmth, and staying uninvolved even when others are hurting or hoping for a response.

nodes.label: detail-oriented
nodes.gloss: This means attending closely to small particulars in one's work and checking each one before moving on, rather than trusting that the details will sort themselves out.

nodes.label: determination
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a firm resolve toward one's chosen aims and pressing on through setbacks, delays and discouragement until they are reached.

nodes.label: determined
nodes.gloss: This means keeping at a goal through setbacks and discouragement, refusing to give up or abandon it, and holding to one's course with steady resolve whenever obstacles appear.

nodes.label: detested
nodes.gloss: This means being hated by nearly everyone, despised wherever one goes, and finding that one's name alone draws scorn, contempt, and open hostility from others.

nodes.label: detrimental
nodes.gloss: This means leaving the people nearby worse off simply by being around them, with one's presence wearing down their work, mood, or wellbeing.

nodes.label: deviating
nodes.gloss: This means habitually departing from social norms and expectations, doing things one's own way even when others plainly expect something else.

nodes.label: devil-may-care
nodes.gloss: This means taking risks and making choices without worrying about what might go wrong, shrugging off the consequences and facing whatever follows with an easy, reckless indifference.

nodes.label: devilish
nodes.gloss: This means enjoying mischief for its own sake, teasing others with an impish grin and a playfully sly remark whenever a chance to stir things up comes along.

nodes.label: devoted
nodes.gloss: This means staying faithfully loyal to the people one cares about, showing them warmth and affection through steady attention and by standing by them when it counts.

nodes.label: devoted to friends
nodes.gloss: This means standing by one's friends through hard times, keeping faith with them when it costs something, and putting their interests ahead of convenience or outside pressure.

nodes.label: devotee
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's faith or cause at the center of daily life, pursuing it with zeal and unwavering commitment in word and deed.

nodes.label: devout
nodes.gloss: This means holding religious faith as central to one's life and practicing it with sincere commitment.

nodes.label: devoutly religious
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's religious faith at the center of daily life, observing its prayers, rituals and duties regularly, and treating its teachings as a guide for how one lives.

nodes.label: dexterous
nodes.gloss: This means handling physical tasks with one's hands quickly and precisely, working with a deft, nimble touch that makes fine manual work look easy.

nodes.label: didactic
nodes.gloss: This means lecturing and moralizing at others, turning every exchange into a chance to teach them what they should believe or do.

nodes.label: die-hard
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's position stubbornly, refusing to give up a view or concede a point however much evidence or pressure is brought against it.

nodes.label: diffident
nodes.gloss: This means doubting one's own worth and capabilities.

nodes.label: diffuse
nodes.gloss: This means taking many words to say anything, letting speech and writing wander through digressions and side remarks until the main thread is buried.

nodes.label: dignified
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's composure under pressure and carrying oneself with quiet self-respect, without seeking attention, displays of emotion, or approval from others.

nodes.label: dilatory
nodes.gloss: This means putting off decisions and tasks until the last possible moment, letting deadlines slip while one moves at a slow pace that others must wait on.

nodes.label: diligent
nodes.gloss: This means working with care and persistence to get things right.

nodes.label: dim
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to follow a point, reasoning without much speed, and missing what others grasp at once, day after day.

nodes.label: diplomatic
nodes.gloss: This means choosing one's words with care, softening criticism, and steering around anything that might give offense when dealing with others, even when blunt truth would be quicker.

nodes.label: direct
nodes.gloss: This means speaking plainly about what one thinks and wants, without hedging or deflecting.

nodes.label: directive
nodes.gloss: This means giving orders and instructions to others.

nodes.label: disagreeable
nodes.gloss: This means being unpleasant, rude or bad-tempered in manner, snapping at others and making dealings with one's company hard going whatever the occasion.

nodes.label: disciplined
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's impulses in check and following steady, orderly routines, even when shortcuts or distractions are easy to reach for.

nodes.label: disconnected
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings private and maintaining distance from others' emotional lives.

nodes.label: discontented
nodes.gloss: This means being dissatisfied with one's circumstances, feeling that one's situation falls short of what one wants and voicing that unease readily.

nodes.label: discontented with self
nodes.gloss: This means feeling persistently dissatisfied with one's own conduct and life, measuring oneself against a standard one never quite meets and regarding one's own choices as falling short.

nodes.label: discordant
nodes.gloss: This means picking fights with the people around one, disagreeing sharply and readily, and standing at odds with the group rather than smoothing things over.

nodes.label: discouraging
nodes.gloss: This means habitually deflating others' hope and enthusiasm, pointing out obstacles and likely failures whenever someone proposes an idea or plan, so that they lose heart before trying.

nodes.label: discourteous
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with brusque disregard, speaking to them curtly and dismissively, and showing no concern for the courtesies that ease ordinary dealings between people.

nodes.label: discursive
nodes.gloss: This means wandering from one topic to another in conversation, following every tangent that occurs and letting talk drift far from where it began without any sense of needing to return.

nodes.label: disengaged
nodes.gloss: This means pulling back from commitments and involvement, holding oneself apart from the work and people at hand, and giving nothing of one's own energy or stake to what goes on.

nodes.label: disgruntled
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a sour, resentful outlook on nearly everything, grumbling about circumstances, people and routine as though life had owed one better and never paid up.

nodes.label: dishonest
nodes.gloss: This means lying to others as a matter of course and deceiving them about facts, motives, or one's own conduct whenever it serves one's ends.

nodes.label: disliked
nodes.gloss: This means being found unpleasant by others, with few people warming to one and little popularity among those who know one.

nodes.label: dislikes being mocked
nodes.gloss: This means feeling stung quickly whenever others poke fun at one, taking teasing personally and reacting to ridicule with hurt or defensiveness.

nodes.label: dislikes being ridiculed
nodes.gloss: This means feeling stung whenever one is mocked or laughed at, and wanting one's efforts and person taken seriously rather than turned into a joke.

nodes.label: dislikes company
nodes.gloss: This means preferring to spend one's time alone, finding other people's company tiring rather than enjoyable, and choosing solitude whenever the choice is one's own.

nodes.label: dislikes seeing own body
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding mirrors and photographs of oneself, turning away from reflections and skipping pictures whenever one can, because seeing one's own body is unpleasant.

nodes.label: dislikes uncertainty
nodes.gloss: This means wanting questions closed and answers fixed, and growing restless or pushing to settle matters whenever the outcome is unclear, rather than being comfortable leaving things open.

nodes.label: dismal
nodes.gloss: This means seeing little hope in situations, expecting things to go badly, and carrying a gloomy, joyless outlook into conversations and days as a settled habit of temperament.

nodes.label: dismissive
nodes.gloss: This means waving off other people's opinions and worries as trivial, giving them little weight, and moving on without engaging with what they actually said.

nodes.label: disorganized
nodes.gloss: This means leaving belongings, papers and plans in no set order, letting habits and days run without any system, and rarely finding things where one left them.

nodes.label: dispassionate
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's composure and meeting events with a level, even temper, letting neither anger, excitement nor grief tint one's judgment or tone.

nodes.label: disrespectful
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with habitual rudeness and contempt, brushing aside their feelings, dignity and opinions as unworthy of consideration and speaking down to them as a matter of course.

nodes.label: dissatisfied with own life
nodes.gloss: This means regarding one's own life circumstances as falling short, and feeling discontent and unhappiness with them as a settled, ongoing state rather than a passing mood.

nodes.label: dissenting
nodes.gloss: This means holding a view that runs against the majority or official position and saying so openly, even when the room agrees on the other side.

nodes.label: dissipated
nodes.gloss: This means living without restraint, indulging one's appetites for drink, pleasure and idleness, and letting one's habits and responsibilities slide into dissolution.

nodes.label: dissocial
nodes.gloss: This means keeping oneself apart from other people, choosing solitude over company and seldom seeking out friends, gatherings, or shared activities.

nodes.label: dissociative
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a standing distance from one's surroundings, one's own feelings, and one's sense of being a continuous self, so that events and one's own reactions seem to happen at a remove.

nodes.label: dissonant
nodes.gloss: This means holding two views or feelings that pull against each other and refusing to settle the tension, living with contradictions one has not resolved.

nodes.label: distant
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings at arm's length, staying reserved and cool with others, and letting few people close enough to know what one actually thinks or feels.

nodes.label: distasteful
nodes.gloss: This means behaving in ways that others find objectionable, such as being rude, smug, or abrasive, and being unbothered that one puts people off.

nodes.label: distinct
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a manner and character that set one apart from others, so that one's way of speaking, thinking and acting is recognizably one's own rather than a copy of the crowd.

nodes.label: distractible
nodes.gloss: This means letting one's attention slide off the task at hand whenever something new catches it, so that focus is regularly broken and work is dropped midway for the next passing distraction.

nodes.label: distrustful of friendliness
nodes.gloss: This means meeting every friendly overture with suspicion, doubting the sincerity of warm words and kind gestures, and looking for the angle or motive that lies behind them.

nodes.label: distrustful of human motives
nodes.gloss: This means assuming that people's stated reasons hide selfish aims, and holding that suspicion as a settled trait that colors how one reads every person and every offer.

nodes.label: distrustful of kindness
nodes.gloss: This means assuming that another person's kindness conceals some self-interested motive, and treating every friendly gesture as a move to be decoded before one trusts it.

nodes.label: distrustful of others
nodes.gloss: This means doubting that other people act from honest motives, and reading their intentions with suspicion before taking their words or offers at face value.

nodes.label: dithering
nodes.gloss: This means hesitating over every choice, weighing options back and forth without settling, and putting off committing to any decision even when the matter is small and the time to act has arrived.

nodes.label: dithyrambic
nodes.gloss: This means speaking or writing in an effusive, rapturous, gushing style, pouring out praise and enthusiasm in extravagant, emotionally overflowing language.

nodes.label: diverging
nodes.gloss: This means holding views that depart from the common opinion or accepted norm, and stating them without hastening to align with the majority.

nodes.label: diversified
nodes.gloss: This means pursuing interests, building skills, and gathering experience across many unrelated fields rather than concentrating on one specialty, and treating that breadth as a deliberate way of living.

nodes.label: divertible
nodes.gloss: This means being easily drawn off course by whatever amuses or catches one's eye, so that one's attention and plans are regularly pulled toward new diversions.

nodes.label: divided
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's wishes, feelings and loyalties pulling in opposite directions, never settling fully on one without a sharp pang for the other.

nodes.label: do-little
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding effort wherever possible, letting tasks sit undone, and feeling no urge to work or act unless forced to by someone else.

nodes.label: do-nothing
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding work and useful effort at every turn, letting tasks lie untouched and preferring idleness to anything that would require getting up and doing something productive.

nodes.label: doctrinaire
nodes.gloss: This means applying one's principles rigidly and mechanically, holding to them even when the practical realities of a situation plainly call for a different course.

nodes.label: does the full work
nodes.gloss: This means taking on the whole load of a task oneself, working through every part diligently without leaning on others to carry any share of it.

nodes.label: dog cheap
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to spend money even when it costs one dearly, counting every coin and grudging any payment, however small, that others would think trivial.

nodes.label: dogged
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to give up on a goal once chosen, pressing on through setbacks, delays and discouragement until the work is finished, without needing outside encouragement to keep going.

nodes.label: dogmatic
nodes.gloss: This means holding to fixed beliefs and refusing to change them based on evidence or argument.

nodes.label: doing whatever works
nodes.gloss: This means choosing whatever approach gets results in the present situation, setting aside fixed methods or principles whenever another course would work better right now.

nodes.label: doltish
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp things, missing obvious points, and saying foolish things without any awareness of how dim-witted one sounds.

nodes.label: domiciled
nodes.gloss: This means having a permanent home in a particular place.

nodes.label: dominant
nodes.gloss: This means taking charge of conversations and decisions without waiting to be asked, giving direction to others and expecting them to follow it.

nodes.label: double-crossing
nodes.gloss: This means betraying the people who trust one, turning on allies and confidants for one's own advantage once they have relied on one's word.

nodes.label: double-minded
nodes.gloss: This means wavering between one course and another, taking up an opinion and dropping it again, and never settling firmly on a single decision or conviction.

nodes.label: doubtful
nodes.gloss: This means withholding belief from claims until they are proven, questioning sources and assertions, and never accepting something as true just because it is stated confidently.

nodes.label: doubting
nodes.gloss: This means questioning every claim before accepting it, asking for evidence, weighing what is offered against what is known, and holding back belief until the case has been made.

nodes.label: dough-faced
nodes.gloss: This means yielding to whoever pushes hardest, having no firm position of one's own and bending one's views to match the nearest strong opinion.

nodes.label: doughty
nodes.gloss: This means facing danger and hardship without flinching, pressing forward with courage and valor even when the odds are against one.

nodes.label: dovish
nodes.gloss: This means favoring negotiation and compromise to resolve conflicts rather than military force.

nodes.label: down to earth
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feet on solid ground, valuing what works over what merely sounds good, and seeing things as they are.

nodes.label: drab
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a flat, unremarkable way, offering no wit, opinion or vivid detail, and showing little personality or spark in how one presents oneself.

nodes.label: dramatic
nodes.gloss: This means turning ordinary setbacks and feelings into showy, overblown emotional scenes, reacting with theatrical sighs, tears, and pronouncements that draw attention to one's own feelings.

nodes.label: dreamer
nodes.gloss: This means holding lofty hopes for a better world and chasing grand visions with sincere idealism, while paying little attention to whether the plans can be carried out in practice.

nodes.label: dreamy
nodes.gloss: This means drifting off into daydreams mid-conversation and letting one's attention wander, so that one often seems absent-minded and slow to register what is happening around them.

nodes.label: dreary
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a gloomy, melancholy disposition, seeing little brightness in the day and speaking of things in a flat, low-spirited tone.

nodes.label: drifting
nodes.gloss: This means going through each day without a goal, letting circumstances decide where one lands next, and feeling no pull toward any particular purpose or future.

nodes.label: drinker
nodes.gloss: This means drinking alcohol regularly and in large quantities.

nodes.label: drole
nodes.gloss: This means answering with dry, understated wit, finding the humor in situations and saying it in a way that amuses rather than strains for laughs.

nodes.label: droll
nodes.gloss: This means delivering one's humor with a straight face, letting wry understatement do the work so that observations land amusingly without any obvious effort to be funny.

nodes.label: drunkard
nodes.gloss: This means drinking alcohol heavily and repeatedly as a settled habit, so that one is routinely intoxicated and cannot easily stop or go a day without it.

nodes.label: dry
nodes.gloss: This means delivering jokes and observations with a flat, unsmiling tone, letting the humor sit unstated so that the listener must notice the wit for oneself.

nodes.label: dry-as-dust
nodes.gloss: This means being dull and tedious company, with a flat, plodding manner that bores others and draws no interest from anyone listening.

nodes.label: dry-bones
nodes.gloss: This means going through life drained of energy and enthusiasm, speaking in a flat, lifeless way and bringing nothing vivid or engaging to any conversation or task.

nodes.label: dubious
nodes.gloss: This means withholding belief from claims put forward, questioning their evidence and staying unconvinced until one's own reasoning has been satisfied by them.

nodes.label: dull
nodes.gloss: This means keeping conversation to routine matters, offering flat opinions and no curiosity, and leaving others with nothing memorable to remember or repeat afterward.

nodes.label: dull-brained
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp things, taking longer than others to follow a point and often missing the quick connection in a conversation.

nodes.label: dull-head
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp things, needing explanations repeated before one follows them, and reasoning more slowly than the people around one.

nodes.label: dull-witted
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp new ideas or instructions, needing things explained several times over, and taking longer than most to work out what is going on.

nodes.label: dumb
nodes.gloss: This means having a mind that grasps ideas slowly, misses connections others see at once, and works through even simple problems with difficulty.

nodes.label: dumb-bell
nodes.gloss: This means being a foolish, slow-witted person who keeps making careless mistakes and misreads what is plainly in front of one.

nodes.label: duncical
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp things and making foolish mistakes in one's reasoning, showing little sharpness of mind in everyday matters.

nodes.label: dunderhead
nodes.gloss: This means being slow of understanding and dull in thought, failing to grasp points that are obvious to everyone else.

nodes.label: dupe
nodes.gloss: This means being easily fooled, accepting what others tell one at face value and getting taken in by schemes, flattery or deception without noticing until the damage is done.

nodes.label: durable
nodes.gloss: This means staying with a task, goal, or commitment over long stretches of time, continuing steadily through setbacks, delays, and dull periods rather than giving up or fading out.

nodes.label: dynamic
nodes.gloss: This means moving through the day with high energy, taking on new tasks readily, speaking with animation, and staying busy and in motion from one undertaking to the next.

nodes.label: dynamical
nodes.gloss: This means approaching every task with high energy and force, pushing ahead with momentum and drive, and bringing vigorous, forceful effort to whatever one is doing.

nodes.label: dyslogistic
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a disparaging way, running down people, ideas and work with censure and belittling remarks, and reaching first for the unflattering word whatever the subject.

nodes.label: eager to understand
nodes.gloss: This means approaching each question with genuine curiosity, asking follow-up questions, and treating every new idea as something one is keen to learn from rather than something to be quickly dismissed.

nodes.label: eagle-eyed
nodes.gloss: This means watching closely and catching the small details, slips, and changes that pass unnoticed by others, and treating that steady attention as a habit of mind.

nodes.label: ear-minded
nodes.gloss: This means learning and thinking best through what one hears, preferring spoken explanations, discussion, and listening over reading text or studying diagrams.

nodes.label: early riser
nodes.gloss: This means waking before dawn as a settled habit, rising early each morning and starting the day while most others are still asleep.

nodes.label: earnest
nodes.gloss: This means meaning every word one says, approaching matters with serious good faith, and showing feelings openly rather than hiding them behind irony or humor.

nodes.label: earth-bound
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to practical facts and everyday realities, judging ideas by whether they work and dismissing flights of fancy or imaginative speculation as unhelpful.

nodes.label: earthly-minded
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's attention fixed on money, possessions, status and the practical business of getting on in the world, and letting spiritual matters take a back seat to them.

nodes.label: earthly-wise
nodes.gloss: This means being shrewd and savvy about practical worldly matters, reading people and situations quickly, knowing how money, influence and ordinary affairs actually work, and acting on that knowledge.

nodes.label: earthy
nodes.gloss: This means speaking plainly about what works, without affectation or grand claims.

nodes.label: easeless
nodes.gloss: This means being restless and anxious at all times, unable to settle into rest, carrying a low-grade unease into every task and every quiet moment.

nodes.label: easily absorbed
nodes.gloss: This means getting fully caught up in whatever one is doing, so that attention sinks into the task and the surroundings drop away without much effort.

nodes.label: easily agitated
nodes.gloss: This means being quick to fret and grow unsettled, letting small setbacks or unexpected events set off nervousness and upset that linger long after the trigger has passed.

nodes.label: easily amazed
nodes.gloss: This means being quick to feel astonishment and wonder at ordinary things, responding to most new sights and facts with open delight and surprise rather than calm indifference.

nodes.label: easily astonished
nodes.gloss: This means being quick to find things amazing, reacting with surprise and wonder to ordinary events as a settled habit of temperament rather than an occasional response.

nodes.label: easily awed
nodes.gloss: This means finding wonder readily in ordinary things, such as rain on a window, a passing bird or a plain meal, and responding to them with open delight.

nodes.label: easily captivated
nodes.gloss: This means being quick to find things charming or fascinating, so that one's attention and enthusiasm are readily caught by whatever is new, bright or engaging.

nodes.label: easily crushed
nodes.gloss: This means being easily discouraged and demoralized by setbacks, so that even minor failures drain one's confidence and leave one feeling beaten for a long stretch afterward.

nodes.label: easily delighted
nodes.gloss: This means finding pleasure readily in small things, quickly warming to whatever is put before one and showing that enjoyment openly and without much effort.

nodes.label: easily destabilized
nodes.gloss: This means being easily upset and thrown off balance by setbacks, criticism, or unexpected events, struggling to regain one's composure once emotionally shaken.

nodes.label: easily discouraged
nodes.gloss: This means losing heart at the first setback, letting a single failure or obstacle drain one's resolve, and giving up on goals before they have had a fair chance.

nodes.label: easily distracted
nodes.gloss: This means losing focus on one task after another and drifting off into side thoughts or activities before finishing what was started.

nodes.label: easily distressed
nodes.gloss: This means being readily upset by small setbacks, minor frustrations and everyday stress, so that one's composure gives way quickly whenever things go slightly wrong.

nodes.label: easily dominated by others
nodes.gloss: This means yielding to others' wishes and letting them take charge, deferring to stronger voices in a conversation or group rather than asserting one's own position.

nodes.label: easily drained
nodes.gloss: This means running out of energy quickly, tiring after modest effort, and having little stamina to keep going through long or demanding tasks.

nodes.label: easily embarrassed
nodes.gloss: This means blushing, stammering, and losing one's composure quickly when attention falls on oneself, feeling self-conscious over even small slips or compliments.

nodes.label: easily flustered
nodes.gloss: This means losing one's composure quickly when pressure builds, so that one becomes rattled, confused and slow to think straight in tense or demanding moments.

nodes.label: easily frightened
nodes.gloss: This means startling at sudden noises and movements, and letting small threats feel large, so that fear comes quickly and tends to stay with one through the day.

nodes.label: easily frustrated
nodes.gloss: This means flaring up quickly whenever one is blocked or thwarted, so that small obstacles turn into irritation and sharp words before one has time to settle.

nodes.label: easily gladdened by others
nodes.gloss: This means being quickly cheered up by the company of others and by small kindnesses, finding pleasure in other people's presence without needing much to lift one's spirits.

nodes.label: easily goaded
nodes.gloss: This means flaring up quickly when someone provokes or taunts one, letting a jab or dig push one into anger and a sharp reply before one has had time to think.

nodes.label: easily impressed
nodes.gloss: This means being quick to feel awe or delight at whatever is put in front of one, showing wonder readily at sights, demonstrations and displays that others might take in stride.

nodes.label: easily irritated by others
nodes.gloss: This means getting annoyed quickly by other people's habits, mistakes and noise, and showing it in one's tone and manner before one has had time to let it pass.

nodes.label: easily led

nodes.label: inconfinable

nodes.label: incongenial

nodes.label: inconstant

nodes.label: inconvincible

nodes.label: incorrect

nodes.label: incredulous

nodes.label: incurious

nodes.label: indecisive

nodes.label: indefatigable

nodes.label: indefinite

nodes.label: indeliberate

nodes.label: indelicate

nodes.label: independent

nodes.label: independent-minded

nodes.label: indestructible

nodes.label: indeterminate

nodes.label: indifferent

nodes.label: indifferent to appearance

nodes.label: indifferent to others

nodes.label: indifferent to the arts

nodes.label: indigent

nodes.label: indivertible

nodes.label: individual

nodes.label: individualistic

nodes.label: indivisible

nodes.label: indolent

nodes.label: indomitable

nodes.label: indulgent

nodes.label: infectious

nodes.label: innocent
