nodes.gloss: This means answering back with cheeky, impudent remarks, meeting requests and questions with a quick, saucy retort rather than plain agreement.

nodes.label: satiable
nodes.gloss: This means being easily satisfied, content with what one already has and seldom pressing for more.

nodes.label: satirical
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and writing with mocking irony, holding up folly and pretension to ridicule so that the absurd is made plain to be laughed at.

nodes.label: satisfiable
nodes.gloss: This means being content with little, never demanding much from people, circumstances or things, and finding satisfaction in modest comforts without complaint.

nodes.label: satisfied with life
nodes.gloss: This means feeling settled and at peace with one's overall life and circumstances, seeing little need to change them and regarding one's existence as good on the whole.

nodes.label: saturnine
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a gloomy, brooding temperament, with a habitually dark outlook on life and a slow, heavy mood that rarely lifts.

nodes.label: saucy
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with playful cheekiness, answering back with impudent little jabs and teasing remarks that poke fun at whoever is listening.

nodes.label: savorless
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and writing in a flat, insipid manner that drains zest and charm from whatever one touches, leaving conversation, stories, and even meals bland and lifeless.

nodes.label: scampish
nodes.gloss: This means making playful mischief at every turn, teasing and pranking with a cheeky grin, bending small rules for fun, and never meaning any real harm by it.

nodes.label: scapegrace
nodes.gloss: This means being a playful, mischievous rascal whose pranks and high spirits keep landing one in trouble, yet who is more roguish than malicious and easy to forgive.

nodes.label: scathing
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with a harsh, cutting edge, delivering criticism in a manner that leaves the target stung and humiliated rather than helped.

nodes.label: scatterbrained
nodes.gloss: This means losing track of appointments, keys, and half-finished tasks, and forgetting what one was about to say or do, as a settled habit rather than an occasional lapse.

nodes.label: scattered
nodes.gloss: This means having thoughts that jump from one thing to another without settling or organizing into a clear line.

nodes.label: schemes covertly
nodes.gloss: This means working toward one's aims through hidden maneuvers, concealing one's real intentions and arranging events behind others' backs so that they never see the plan until it is already done.

nodes.label: scheming
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's real aims hidden while quietly arranging events, people and words so that one gets what one wants without anyone noticing the plan.

nodes.label: scientific
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning methodically and working through problems step by step, testing each claim against observable evidence before accepting it as true.

nodes.label: scintillant
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's talk quick, bright and sparkling, turning remarks into witty flashes that enliven any conversation or gathering one joins.

nodes.label: scratchy
nodes.gloss: This means being quick to snap and easily irritated, answering others curtly and with little patience for small annoyances, as a standing habit of temper.

nodes.label: screwy
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with an odd, unpredictable streak, holding unconventional views and habits that others find eccentric or a little crazy, and not trying to hide it.

nodes.label: scrimpy
nodes.gloss: This means grudging every dollar and resource one spends, holding back money and supplies even when spending them would be reasonable or generous.

nodes.label: scrupulously fair
nodes.gloss: This means giving every side the same careful hearing and weight, holding back personal leanings so that no party is favored or disadvantaged by how one handles the matter.

nodes.label: scrutinizing
nodes.gloss: This means examining claims, arguments and evidence closely and skeptically before accepting them, and questioning what others take for granted rather than letting things pass unchecked.

nodes.label: seclusive
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding company and keeping to oneself, preferring solitude over social gatherings and seeking out few or no personal contacts beyond what daily life requires.

nodes.label: second-rate
nodes.gloss: This means turning out work that falls short of good, showing little real skill or talent and never quite reaching the standard that others in the field achieve.

nodes.label: sectarian
nodes.gloss: This means favoring one's own group above all others, judging rivals through partisan loyalty, and treating those outside one's camp with suspicion or hostility.

nodes.label: sectional
nodes.gloss: This means judging every question by what benefits one's own region or faction, siding with it by reflex, and giving little weight to the claims or concerns of any other.

nodes.label: secular
nodes.gloss: This means holding no religious beliefs and viewing the world from a non-religious outlook.

nodes.label: secularizing
nodes.gloss: This means growing less attached to religious belief and practice over time, letting faith hold a smaller place in how one understands the world and makes choices.

nodes.label: secure
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a settled confidence in one's own worth, so that criticism, uncertainty, or another's disapproval does not unsettle one's mood or sense of self.

nodes.label: secure in identity
nodes.gloss: This means holding a settled, confident sense of who one is, so that praise, criticism, or challenge does not shake one's basic view of oneself.

nodes.label: sedate
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's temperament calm and composed, moving and speaking at an unhurried pace, and holding back strong emotion even when others around one grow agitated.

nodes.label: sedative
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner slow, quiet and even, so that those nearby feel their agitation ease when they are in one's company.

nodes.label: sedentary
nodes.gloss: This means spending most of one's waking hours sitting down, with little movement through the day and few stretches of physical exertion.

nodes.label: seductive
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a deliberately sexually alluring manner, using flirtatious looks, tone and body language to draw others' romantic or sexual attention.

nodes.label: sedulous
nodes.gloss: This means working steadily and persistently at every task, keeping at it with careful diligence long after others have stopped or grown bored.

nodes.label: seeks close intimacy
nodes.gloss: This means wanting deep emotional closeness with others, pressing to be known fully by the people in one's life and feeling restless when that closeness is held at a distance.

nodes.label: seeks hidden meaning
nodes.gloss: This means reading past the surface of what people say or do, always looking for the subtext and concealed significance that lies underneath.

nodes.label: seeks immediate gain
nodes.gloss: This means chasing quick profit and short-term advantage, grabbing whatever pays off now and judging every opportunity by how fast it returns something.

nodes.label: seeks thrills
nodes.gloss: This means chasing new and risky experiences for their own sake, choosing the bold option over the safe one, and treating danger and excitement as things to welcome rather than avoid.

nodes.label: sees self as ordinary
nodes.gloss: This means regarding one's own abilities, background and achievements as unremarkable, and speaking about oneself without flourish, boasting or any claim to special standing.

nodes.label: sees the big picture
nodes.gloss: This means taking a broad, overall view of situations and keeping the larger goals and connections in mind rather than getting absorbed in individual details.

nodes.label: seesawing
nodes.gloss: This means going back and forth between two choices or positions, unable to settle on one and swinging from one to the other as new considerations come up.

nodes.label: seldom daydreams
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's attention firmly on the task at hand, rarely letting the mind drift off into idle fantasy or imagined scenarios as a settled habit of character.

nodes.label: self-absorbed
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's attention fixed on one's own concerns and wants, showing little interest in or attention to what others are feeling, needing, or going through.

nodes.label: self-accusing
nodes.gloss: This means habitually turning blame inward, holding oneself responsible for one's own failings and faults of character and saying so plainly, without waiting for anyone else to point them out.

nodes.label: self-admiration
nodes.gloss: This means regarding oneself as far more impressive than others do, constantly admiring one's own looks, talents and achievements, and expecting others to share that high opinion.

nodes.label: self-admiring
nodes.gloss: This means taking pride in one's own looks, talents and accomplishments above all else, expecting admiration from others and rarely pausing to notice one's own shortcomings.

nodes.label: self-advertising
nodes.gloss: This means constantly promoting oneself and one's achievements to others, steering conversations toward one's own successes and making sure they are noticed.

nodes.label: self-aggrandizing
nodes.gloss: This means inflating one's own importance in conversation, boasting about one's achievements and talents, and steering talk back toward oneself whenever the chance arises.

nodes.label: self-analyzing
nodes.gloss: This means turning one's own thoughts, motives and reasons over under close scrutiny, asking why one feels or acts as one does before accepting one's own account of it.

nodes.label: self approving
nodes.gloss: This means finding one's own conduct and choices satisfactory.

nodes.label: self-assured
nodes.gloss: This means trusting one's own abilities and judgment without needing outside reassurance, and taking on tasks with a settled belief that one will handle them well.

nodes.label: self-benefiting
nodes.gloss: This means putting one's own advantage first in nearly every choice, judging options by what they will gain for oneself and quietly steering situations toward that end.

nodes.label: self-boasting
nodes.gloss: This means bragging about one's own achievements and qualities, steering conversations toward one's accomplishments and presenting them as proof of exceptional talent.

nodes.label: self-censoring in speech
nodes.gloss: This means weighing one's words before speaking and holding back or editing what one would otherwise say, so that one's spoken remarks come out more guarded than one's actual thoughts.

nodes.label: self centered
nodes.gloss: This means prioritizing one's own interests and needs while remaining indifferent to the concerns of others.

nodes.label: self-collected
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's composure steady under pressure, staying unhurried and self-possessed in speech and manner, and not letting stress or provocation pull one off balance.

nodes.label: self-command
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings in check under pressure, holding back impulsive reactions, and staying composed even when provoked or upset.

nodes.label: self-conceited
nodes.gloss: This means regarding oneself as superior in looks, talent, and worth, admiring one's own qualities openly, and steering talk back to one's own achievements.

nodes.label: self-concerned
nodes.gloss: This means putting one's own interests first and treating the wants and needs of others as secondary, even when it costs them and one could easily have helped.

nodes.label: self-condemning
nodes.gloss: This means harshly blaming oneself for mistakes and shortcomings, treating every failure as proof of one's own inadequacy and speaking of oneself with contempt.

nodes.label: self-conscious
nodes.gloss: This means feeling easily embarrassed and awkward, as if one is always being watched or judged by those around one, and letting that unease show in one's manner and speech.

nodes.label: self-conscious about body size
nodes.gloss: This means feeling embarrassed or anxious about one's own body size, often hiding or apologizing for it and worrying what others think when looking at one's physique.

nodes.label: self-contained
nodes.gloss: This means handling one's own problems and tasks without asking anyone else for help, support, or assistance, and preferring to rely only on one's own resources.

nodes.label: self-contemptuous
nodes.gloss: This means holding oneself in steady contempt, treating one's own efforts, judgments and worth with scorn and expecting little but disdain from one's own inner voice.

nodes.label: self-contradicting
nodes.gloss: This means making claims that clash with one another, so that statements made earlier and later in the same exchange cannot both be true.

nodes.label: self-contradictory
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and reasoning in ways that pull against themselves, so that one claim is undone by another made in the same breath, with no attempt to reconcile them.

nodes.label: self-critical
nodes.gloss: This means finding fault with oneself and one's own work first, quick to point out one's mistakes and shortcomings before anyone else has the chance.

nodes.label: self denying
nodes.gloss: This means refusing one's own desires and comforts as a settled habit.

nodes.label: self-dependent
nodes.gloss: This means handling one's own problems with one's own resources, going without help from others and seeing needing assistance as something to avoid.

nodes.label: self-deprecating
nodes.gloss: This means making light of one's own flaws, mistakes and shortcomings, often with a joke at one's own expense, rather than presenting oneself as capable or impressive.

nodes.label: self-destructive
nodes.gloss: This means making choices that knowingly damage one's own health, relationships, or interests, and continuing to make them even when the costs are plain.

nodes.label: self-devoted
nodes.gloss: This means putting one's own interests, comfort, and safety aside without hesitation when a cause or the needs of others call for it, and accepting the personal cost as part of that commitment.

nodes.label: self-directed and self-serving
nodes.gloss: This means putting one's own gain first, pursuing personal advantage at the expense of others and treating other people's needs as secondary to one's own interests.

nodes.label: self-disciplined
nodes.gloss: This means turning down immediate pleasures and distractions and keeping one's attention fixed on long-term goals, even when doing so is hard or unrewarding in the moment.

nodes.label: self-displaying
nodes.gloss: This means seeking the spotlight in everything one does, drawing eyes toward oneself and performing for an audience, with flashy talk and display being a settled part of one's character.

nodes.label: self-dissatisfied
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a steady sense that one's own conduct and self fall short, so that one is rarely content with how one has acted or who one is.

nodes.label: self-dissecting
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's own motives and feelings under close examination, turning them over to find the reasons beneath them before acting or speaking.

nodes.label: self-distrustful
nodes.gloss: This means doubting one's own judgment before speaking and qualifying one's answers with caveats, so that one's conclusions are offered as provisional rather than firm.

nodes.label: self-doubting
nodes.gloss: This means hesitating before giving any answer or judgment, then doubting one's own conclusions and revisiting them again and again before committing to them.

nodes.label: self-effacing
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's own achievements and opinions in the background, deflecting praise, and letting others take the spotlight rather than drawing attention to oneself.

nodes.label: self-esteem
nodes.gloss: This means holding a steady, confident sense of one's own worth, taking one's abilities and place seriously, and speaking and acting from the settled belief that one deserves respect.

nodes.label: self-exculpating
nodes.gloss: This means habitually finding reasons to clear oneself of blame, shifting responsibility for one's mistakes onto circumstances, other people, or bad luck rather than owning them.

nodes.label: self-excusing
nodes.gloss: This means habitually finding reasons outside oneself for one's own faults and mistakes, so that the blame never quite lands on oneself.

nodes.label: self-expressive
nodes.gloss: This means openly sharing one's own feelings, opinions and personality with others, letting them show plainly in how one speaks, acts and presents oneself rather than holding them back.

nodes.label: self focused
nodes.gloss: This means directing one's attention and concern toward oneself rather than others.

nodes.label: self-focused in conversation
nodes.gloss: This means habitually turning conversations back to one's own experiences, opinions and concerns, so that other people's topics get redirected toward oneself rather than explored.

nodes.label: self-forgetful
nodes.gloss: This means putting others and the cause at hand ahead of one's own comfort, credit, and needs, and giving freely without keeping count or asking anything back.

nodes.label: self-glorious
nodes.gloss: This means regarding one's own achievements and appearance with constant admiration, dwelling on one's own importance, and expecting others to share that high opinion of oneself.

nodes.label: self-harming
nodes.gloss: This means habitually injuring one's own body on purpose, as a standing way of coping with distress rather than a single lapse.

nodes.label: self-helping
nodes.gloss: This means handling one's own problems and needs without asking others for help, relying on one's own resources and effort rather than depending on anyone else to step in.

nodes.label: self-important
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself as though one's own opinions, needs and status outrank everyone else's, and expecting others to defer without earning it.

nodes.label: self-improving
nodes.gloss: This means continually working to better oneself, treating each mistake as a lesson and returning to one's own weaknesses until they improve.

nodes.label: self-indulgent
nodes.gloss: This means habitually giving oneself over to one's own appetites and pleasures without restraint, putting immediate gratification ahead of discipline, obligation, or the needs of others.

nodes.label: self interested
nodes.gloss: This means prioritizing one's own advantage over others' welfare.

nodes.label: self-intoxicating
nodes.gloss: This means habitually drinking or using drugs to the point of intoxication, returning to that state as a regular way of getting through one's days.

nodes.label: self-involved
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's own needs, feelings and achievements at the center of every conversation, and measuring other people's remarks mainly by how they bear on oneself.

nodes.label: self-judging
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's own conduct up to a harsh standard and finding fault with oneself readily, treating one's own worth as something that must be repeatedly justified.

nodes.label: self-left
nodes.gloss: This means holding left-wing political views and calling oneself left-wing in politics.

nodes.label: self-loving
nodes.gloss: This means holding an inflated opinion of one's own worth, looking in the mirror with admiration, and expecting others to share one's high regard for oneself.

nodes.label: self-mastered
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's emotions and impulses in check, choosing a measured response over an immediate reaction even when provoked, pressured, or upset.

nodes.label: self-motivated
nodes.gloss: This means acting on one's own initiative, spotting what needs doing and starting it without waiting to be asked, reminded, or supervised by anyone.

nodes.label: self-observing
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a running watch over one's own thoughts, feelings and conduct, noticing them as they happen and treating them as something to examine.

nodes.label: self-obsessed
nodes.gloss: This means steering every conversation back to one's own concerns, achievements and comfort, and brushing past what others need as though it hardly registers.

nodes.label: self-opinionated
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's views as settled, insisting on them without openly weighing other positions, and refusing to give ground even when others offer good reasons to change.

nodes.label: self-pampering
nodes.gloss: This means treating oneself to comforts and luxuries as a regular habit, choosing the soft, expensive, or indulgent option whenever it is on offer and feeling entitled to it.

nodes.label: self-pitying
nodes.gloss: This means dwelling on one's own misfortunes and feeling sorry for oneself, returning again and again to how unfairly life has treated one rather than looking forward.

nodes.label: self-possessed
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's calm and composure when pressure mounts, staying steady in speech and action while others around one grow flustered or rattled.

nodes.label: self-praising
nodes.gloss: This means habitually bragging about one's own achievements and virtues, turning ordinary conversation toward how accomplished, talented, or admirable one is.

nodes.label: self-punishing
nodes.gloss: This means answering every failure of one's own with harsh punishment, berating oneself, withholding rest and pleasure, and treating each mistake as a debt that has to be paid in suffering.

nodes.label: self-reflective
nodes.gloss: This means examining one's own thoughts, feelings and motives honestly, questioning why one acts and believes as one does rather than taking them at face value.

nodes.label: self-regarding
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's own interests at the centre of attention, measuring events mainly by what they cost or gain oneself, and rarely looking outward to others' needs or concerns.

nodes.label: self-reliant
nodes.gloss: This means handling one's own affairs and finishing one's own tasks without asking others for help, and preferring to work things out alone rather than rely on anyone else.

nodes.label: self-renouncing
nodes.gloss: This means setting aside one's own wants and comforts as a standing habit, putting others' needs first even when doing so costs one something real.

nodes.label: self-repressing
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's own feelings and impulses held back, pushing them down rather than letting them show or act, even when expressing them would be natural.

nodes.label: self-reproachful
nodes.gloss: This means taking the blame for things that go wrong and turning the fault inward, holding oneself responsible and quick to criticize one's own mistakes and failings.

nodes.label: self-reproving
nodes.gloss: This means blaming oneself harshly for one's own mistakes and scolding oneself for them, often out loud or in one's own head, rather than letting them pass.

nodes.label: self-sacrificing
nodes.gloss: This means setting aside one's own interests, comfort, and plans without complaint whenever doing so would help others, even when it costs one dearly.

nodes.label: self-sufficient
nodes.gloss: This means handling one's own problems and tasks without asking others for help, and expecting to get by on one's own resources even when assistance is available.

nodes.label: self-surrendering
nodes.gloss: This means yielding one's own will to others and going along with their wishes, deferring rather than insisting on one's own way, as a standing trait of character.

nodes.label: self-sustaining
nodes.gloss: This means handling one's own problems and needs without asking for outside help, relying on one's own resources and judgment even when assistance is available.

nodes.label: self-thinking
nodes.gloss: This means forming one's own judgments from one's own reasoning and holding to them, rather than handing the conclusion over to whoever seems most authoritative in the room.

nodes.label: self-uncertain
nodes.gloss: This means doubting one's own abilities and judgments, hesitating over decisions and second-guessing answers before committing to them.

nodes.label: self-upbraiding
nodes.gloss: This means habitually scolding oneself harshly for one's own faults and mistakes, turning every shortcoming into a charge brought against oneself.

nodes.label: self-valuing
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's own worth as settled, carrying oneself with dignity and refusing to treat one's own needs or judgment as less important than anyone else's.

nodes.label: self-worshipping
nodes.gloss: This means regarding oneself as the most admirable figure in any room, dwelling on one's own looks, talents and achievements, and expecting others to share that adoration.

nodes.label: selfish
nodes.gloss: This means putting one's own interests first as a settled habit and caring little whether others gain or lose, so long as one's own wants are met.

nodes.label: selfless
nodes.gloss: This means putting others' welfare ahead of one's own interests.

nodes.label: semidetached
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings at a distance from the people around one, staying warm in manner but holding back emotional investment and never letting closeness fully take hold.

nodes.label: semiparasitic
nodes.gloss: This means taking support from others, drawing on their time, money, or goodwill, and giving back only part of what one receives in return.

nodes.label: semitransparent
nodes.gloss: This means letting others see only part of one's inner life, sharing some feelings and facts while keeping the rest deliberately out of view.

nodes.label: senile
nodes.gloss: This means being mentally confused and forgetful from old age, losing track of names, dates and recent events and repeating oneself.

nodes.label: sensation-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means seeking out thrills, risk and intense new experiences, and treating routine or safe pursuits as dull to be avoided.

nodes.label: sense of entitlement
nodes.gloss: This means believing one deserves special treatment and privileges, expecting rules, waiting, and costs to be waived or bent for one's own benefit, and taking such accommodation as simply what one is owed.

nodes.label: senseless
nodes.gloss: This means making poor decisions and acting without sound judgment, often failing to see the obvious consequences of one's own choices.

nodes.label: senses unseen forces
nodes.gloss: This means picking up on the unspoken moods, tensions and motives beneath what is said, and trusting those impressions enough to name them and let them guide how one responds.

nodes.label: sensing
nodes.gloss: This means noticing the small cues in one's surroundings, such as tone, movement and shifts in the room, and letting them guide what one does next.

nodes.label: sensitive
nodes.gloss: This means noticing what others feel or need and responding readily to it.

nodes.label: sensitive about appearance
nodes.gloss: This means being easily hurt or upset by remarks about how one looks, taking even mild comments on one's face, weight, or clothes as personal slights.

nodes.label: sentimental
nodes.gloss: This means being easily moved to tender feeling, often dwelling on memories of the past and finding nostalgia comforting rather than something to hold back.

nodes.label: sentimental about belongings
nodes.gloss: This means keeping possessions for the memories they hold and finding them hard to part with, even when they serve no practical purpose anymore.

nodes.label: sentimental keeper of things
nodes.gloss: This means holding on to mementos and treasured objects because of the emotional attachment they carry, and letting that attachment decide what is worth keeping.

nodes.label: separate
nodes.gloss: This means standing apart from others, keeping to one's own company, and holding a distinct place that is not shared or merged with any group.

nodes.label: separative
nodes.gloss: This means keeping apart from others and withdrawing from company, holding to one's own space and drawing back whenever people come close.

nodes.label: serene
nodes.gloss: This means staying calm and unruffled by nature, meeting delays, criticism, and upheaval with an even temper and a steady voice that does not rush or rise.

nodes.label: serious
nodes.gloss: This means approaching every topic with sincere earnestness, treating matters as weighty and saying what one means without jokes, teasing, or lightness in tone.

nodes.label: serious-minded
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a sober, earnest outlook, treating matters with weight and gravity, and approaching life with a steady seriousness rather than levity or playfulness.

nodes.label: serves the intended goal
nodes.gloss: This means directing every action toward the goal one was set, choosing tasks and methods by whether they move that goal forward, and dropping whatever does not.

nodes.label: serviceable
nodes.gloss: This means producing work that is adequate and useful, dependable enough to get the job done every time it is asked for.

nodes.label: settled about mistakes
nodes.gloss: This means accepting one's own mistakes calmly, owning them without dread or self-punishment, and moving on without letting them unsettle one's sense of worth or stir up anxious rumination.

nodes.label: settled under pressure
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's composure when things get hard, staying steady and clear-headed in a crisis rather than panicking, rushing, or losing track of what matters.

nodes.label: severe
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a stern, unsmiling manner, holding others to strict standards, and meeting their failings with harsh judgment and unsparing criticism rather than warmth or leniency.

nodes.label: sexless
nodes.gloss: This means lacking any sexual desire or interest, and feeling no pull toward sexual activity as a settled part of one's life.

nodes.label: sexual
nodes.gloss: This means openly expressing strong sexual desire, pursuing sexual contact directly, and making one's own sexual interest plain in what one says and does, without reserve or coyness.

nodes.label: sexually disinterested
nodes.gloss: This means having little or no sexual desire at all, as a settled and lasting feature of how one experiences oneself, not a passing lull.

nodes.label: shallow
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings and thoughts on the surface, skimming past emotional depth and serious reflection, and never probing beneath the obvious in conversation or in one's own views.

nodes.label: shallow-brained
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp ideas, missing the point of most conversations, and offering simple, unreflective answers because quick-witted thought and real depth of understanding are beyond one's reach.

nodes.label: shallow-pated
nodes.gloss: This means thinking without depth, grasping only the surface of things, missing what matters in a question, and offering flimsy, empty remarks in place of real thought.

nodes.label: shallow-witted
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's thinking on the surface of things, grasping only the obvious points and never pursuing an idea far enough to reach its deeper implications or complexities.

nodes.label: shame-proof
nodes.gloss: This means standing untouched by mockery, public embarrassment, and attempts at humiliation, so that no jeer or exposure of a flaw can make one back down, hide, or apologize for who one is.

nodes.label: sharing
nodes.gloss: This means giving freely of one's time, food, possessions and knowledge, and keeping little back for oneself when others could use it.

nodes.label: sharp
nodes.gloss: This means thinking quickly and cleverly, grasping points before others do and answering with a keen, witty turn of mind.

nodes.label: sharp-tongued
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a biting, cutting, caustic way, using sarcasm and cutting remarks to make one's point at others' expense, and not softening words even when kindness would serve better.

nodes.label: sharp-witted
nodes.gloss: This means answering questions and conversation with quick, clever turns of thought, catching the point before others finish and showing an agile mind in everything one says.

nodes.label: sharper
nodes.gloss: This means thinking quickly and keenly, catching details at once, following arguments without lag, and answering with ready, incisive wit.

nodes.label: shatter-pated
nodes.gloss: This means jumping from one thought to the next without finishing any, losing the thread mid-sentence, forgetting what was just said, and never holding attention on a single task for long.

nodes.label: sheep-headed
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp things and often acting without thinking, so that one's foolishness shows in plain, ordinary dealings with others.

nodes.label: shifting identity
nodes.gloss: This means having a sense of self that keeps changing from moment to moment, so that who one takes oneself to be is never settled for long.

nodes.label: shiftless
nodes.gloss: This means letting work and responsibilities slide, showing no drive or ambition to improve one's circumstances, and being content to idle rather than push toward any goal.

nodes.label: shifts with context
nodes.gloss: This means adjusting one's behavior and stance to fit whatever situation one finds oneself in, changing tone and position as circumstances call for.

nodes.label: shilly-shally
nodes.gloss: This means dithering over every choice, swinging back and forth between options and never settling on one, so that one's decisions stall while others wait.

nodes.label: shirks responsibilities
nodes.gloss: This means dodging one's duties and obligations, slipping out of assigned tasks, passing work along to others, and leaving commitments unmet whenever they become inconvenient.

nodes.label: shoddy
nodes.gloss: This means doing work carelessly and to a low standard, cutting corners and leaving flaws that one would not accept from oneself if one took the time to check.

nodes.label: short-sighted
nodes.gloss: This means failing to plan ahead, acting on what is immediately in front of one and giving little thought to the long-term consequences of one's choices.

nodes.label: short-spoken
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's speech brief and clipped, saying only what is needed in as few words as possible, even when a longer answer would be expected.

nodes.label: short-tempered
nodes.gloss: This means flaring up in anger or losing patience quickly when things go wrong, slow to let irritations pass and quick to snap at those nearby.

nodes.label: short-witted
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp things and lacking quickness of mind, so that one's understanding comes late and one's reasoning moves at a plodding pace.

nodes.label: shortsighted
nodes.gloss: This means making decisions based on immediate gain without regard for long-term consequences.

nodes.label: showman
nodes.gloss: This means playing every exchange to an audience, speaking with flair and theatrical flourish, and treating each conversation as a stage on which to be seen and remembered.

nodes.label: shrinking
nodes.gloss: This means pulling back from others and from every risk, speaking in a small voice, and growing more timid and fearful of being noticed with each passing day.

nodes.label: shy
nodes.gloss: This means hanging back around other people, speaking quietly and rarely first, and keeping to the edges of a conversation rather than stepping into the middle of it.

nodes.label: sibling raised
nodes.gloss: This means growing up in a household with brothers or sisters.

nodes.label: siding
nodes.gloss: This means throwing one's support behind one party in a dispute and standing with that side against the other, rather than staying neutral.

nodes.label: silk-stocking
nodes.gloss: This means belonging to the wealthy upper class.

nodes.label: silly
nodes.gloss: This means making foolish choices and speaking without weighing consequences, showing a persistent lack of good judgment in what one says and does.

nodes.label: simple
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner and speech unpretentious, saying things directly without airs, and not complicating one's character with affectations, hidden motives, or show.

nodes.label: simple-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means taking people at their word and expecting good faith from them, with no suspicion, no hidden calculation, and no cunning in how one deals with others.

nodes.label: simple-minded
nodes.gloss: This means having limited intelligence, taking a long time to grasp even plain explanations, and needing ideas broken into small steps before they sink in.

nodes.label: simpleminded
nodes.gloss: This means being slow-witted and dim, struggling to grasp things quickly, needing ideas repeated and spelled out before one can follow them at all.

nodes.label: sincere
nodes.gloss: This means saying only what one actually believes and feeling no pretense about it, so that one's words and inner states match with no performance or hidden angle behind them.

nodes.label: singular
nodes.gloss: This means being strikingly eccentric in character and manner, with odd habits, unexpected opinions, and a way of speaking and acting that sets one apart from everyone else.

nodes.label: skeptical
nodes.gloss: This means questioning every claim that comes along and withholding belief until evidence has been shown, asking for sources, proof, and reasons before accepting anything as true.

nodes.label: skeptical of claims
nodes.gloss: This means questioning the claims put to one and withholding belief until the evidence for them has actually been shown.

nodes.label: skewed
nodes.gloss: This means viewing questions through a lopsided lens, letting one's own leanings bend judgments away from fair and balanced conclusions.

nodes.label: skill-less
nodes.gloss: This means lacking the skill or ability that one's work demands, so that one's efforts fall short of competence across everything one attempts.

nodes.label: skilled
nodes.gloss: This means doing tasks and crafts at a consistently high level of competence, handling demanding work with precision and ease as a matter of course.

nodes.label: skillful
nodes.gloss: This means handling each task with real expertise, working out problems accurately and completing the work well, without needing help or hedging about one's own competence.

nodes.label: skimp
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a tight grip on money and effort, giving as little as one can get away with and begrudging every cost, whether for oneself or for others.

nodes.label: skimpy
nodes.gloss: This means giving and spending as little as possible, handing out meager portions, pinching every coin, and begrudging what others would readily part with.

nodes.label: slack
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding the work one is responsible for, letting tasks slide, and doing as little as possible while others pick up the slack.

nodes.label: slangy
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and writing in casual slang, favoring informal words, clipped phrasing and colloquial expressions over formal or standard wording.

nodes.label: slapdash
nodes.gloss: This means rushing through every task, skipping checks and details, and handing over half-finished work with errors left in, because getting something done fast matters more than getting it right.

nodes.label: slashing
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with a cutting, scathingly sharp edge, delivering criticism and remarks in a manner that wounds rather than softens.

nodes.label: slatternly
nodes.gloss: This means going about with rumpled, stained clothes, uncombed hair, and a general air of neglect, never bothering to smooth, wash, or straighten oneself before being seen.

nodes.label: slattery
nodes.gloss: This means living in untidy, slovenly fashion, leaving clothes, rooms and belongings in disorder and letting one's own appearance and habits go unkempt without a thought.

nodes.label: slick
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with polished ease and quick charm, smoothing over doubts and hard questions with agreeable phrasing rather than plain, substantive answers.

nodes.label: slipshod
nodes.gloss: This means doing one's work in a careless, hasty way, leaving loose ends and errors unchecked, and keeping habits that are untidy and sloppy as a matter of course.

nodes.label: slob
nodes.gloss: This means leaving clothes rumpled and stained, letting dishes and clutter pile up, and not bothering about how one looks or how one's space looks.

nodes.label: slogger
nodes.gloss: This means grinding steadily through tedious, repetitive work without complaint or shortcuts, plodding on long after the task has lost any appeal and staying with it until it is finished.

nodes.label: sloppy
nodes.gloss: This means working and acting with little care, leaving errors unchecked, skipping details, and paying scant attention to what one is doing.

nodes.label: slothful
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding effort wherever possible, putting off tasks, and doing as little work as one can get away with, even when the work is clearly one's responsibility.

nodes.label: slovenly
nodes.gloss: This means going about with one's clothes rumpled, hair unkempt and shoes scuffed, never bothering to dress neatly or keep one's appearance in order.

nodes.label: slow
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp what others say, needing things explained several times before one understands them, and taking longer than most to work out a problem.

nodes.label: slow to forgive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping hold of old wrongs long after they were done, withholding pardon from those who hurt one and letting resentment outlast the apology.

nodes.label: slow-witted
nodes.gloss: This means taking longer than most to grasp new ideas, needing repeated explanations and working through things step by step before understanding them.

nodes.label: slowish
nodes.gloss: This means taking one's time before responding or acting, weighing each step deliberately rather than rushing to answer or move on.

nodes.label: sluggard
nodes.gloss: This means putting off work at every turn, letting tasks lie undone, and preferring idleness to effort as a settled habit of one's days.

nodes.label: sluggish
nodes.gloss: This means moving and acting with slowness and without vigor.

nodes.label: sluttish
nodes.gloss: This means taking up with many casual sexual partners and conducting oneself with open, unguarded looseness in matters of sex, without any reserve or sense of propriety.

nodes.label: small minded
nodes.gloss: This means holding grudges over trifles and seeing only one's own immediate concerns, not the wider picture or other people's perspectives.

nodes.label: smart
nodes.gloss: This means grasping ideas quickly, reasoning sharply through problems, and turning a clever remark on the spot when the moment calls for it.

nodes.label: smoker
nodes.gloss: This means habitually lighting and smoking tobacco, a regular habit that shapes one's daily routine and is part of how one spends the day.

nodes.label: snappish
nodes.gloss: This means being quick to bark back at people over small irritations, speaking curtly and sharply to whoever happens to be nearby, and letting one's patience wear thin without warning.

nodes.label: sniveling
nodes.gloss: This means complaining in a whining, self-pitying voice, dwelling on one's own hard-done-by fate and pleading for sympathy as a standing habit of character.

nodes.label: sobersides
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a grave, measured demeanor and treating most occasions as serious business, seldom joking or indulging in play, and preferring steady sobriety of manner to lightness.

nodes.label: sociable
nodes.gloss: This means seeking out the company of others and finding genuine enjoyment in their presence.

nodes.label: social
nodes.gloss: This means enjoying the company of others, seeking out conversation and gatherings, and bringing an outgoing warmth to whoever is in the room.

nodes.label: socialistic
nodes.gloss: This means holding socialist political views, favoring collective or public ownership of key industries and a strong role for the state in distributing wealth and services.

nodes.label: socially astute
nodes.gloss: This means reading the unspoken currents in a room and grasping what others truly want beneath their words.

nodes.label: socially at ease
nodes.gloss: This means staying relaxed and confident in conversation with strangers and friends alike, moving among other people without strain, self-consciousness, or a need to perform.

nodes.label: socially blunt
nodes.gloss: This means speaking frankly and directly in social settings, saying exactly what one thinks without softening it or bothering with tact, even when the moment calls for it.

nodes.label: socially easygoing
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a loose, unhurried manner around other people, chatting without strain, letting awkward moments pass, and feeling no pressure to perform or impress in company.

nodes.label: socially oblivious
nodes.gloss: This means missing social cues and remaining unaware of how one's words and actions affect others' feelings.

nodes.label: socially oriented
nodes.gloss: This means seeking out other people as a matter of course, enjoying company and conversation, and finding one's energy and pleasure in time spent with others rather than alone.

nodes.label: socially withdrawn
nodes.gloss: This means keeping away from company and preferring to be alone, declining invitations and gatherings, and keeping one's own affairs and feelings to oneself rather than sharing them with others.

nodes.label: sociopathic
nodes.gloss: This means feeling no empathy for others and treating their distress, feelings and wellbeing as matters of no concern when deciding what to say or do.

nodes.label: soft-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means feeling others' pain readily and letting it move one to sympathy, responding to people in distress with warmth and tenderness rather than holding back or hardening oneself.

nodes.label: softening
nodes.gloss: This means growing gentler in one's manner over time, easing off sharp edges and blunt delivery so that one's words land with less harshness.

nodes.label: softhearted
nodes.gloss: This means feeling others' hardships deeply and responding with kindness, compassion and sympathy, readily offering comfort and help to anyone who is struggling.

nodes.label: softish
nodes.gloss: This means being mildly soft-hearted and lenient, quick to forgive small lapses and slow to impose strict discipline on others or on oneself.

nodes.label: solemn
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a grave, earnest bearing in every exchange and treating matters with weight, never turning them into jokes or light remarks.

nodes.label: solid
nodes.gloss: This means keeping every commitment one makes, showing up when expected, and giving others no reason to doubt that one's word and effort can be counted on.

nodes.label: solitary
nodes.gloss: This means being a loner by temperament, choosing solitude over company, and feeling most at ease when spending long stretches of time alone.

nodes.label: somber
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with gravity and dignity, speaking in measured, solemn tones, and treating every subject with quiet seriousness instead of humor or cheer.

nodes.label: sottish
nodes.gloss: This means drinking to excess as a settled way of life, living in a drunken stupor with one's wits and conduct dulled by liquor.

nodes.label: soulless
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's dealings with others cold and detached, showing no compassion or warmth even when someone plainly needs it.

nodes.label: sound
nodes.gloss: This means thinking clearly and weighing matters with steady judgment, reaching conclusions that hold up, and being someone whose advice and decisions others can count on.

nodes.label: sparing
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's use of resources and words in check, spending only what a task truly needs and never more than necessary.

nodes.label: sparkling
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conversation quick, bright and playful, with a ready wit and an effervescent energy that lifts whoever is nearby.

nodes.label: sparkly
nodes.gloss: This means bringing a bright, bubbly energy to every exchange, meeting others with easy charm and enthusiasm, and keeping one's mood upbeat and animated even in dull or routine moments.

nodes.label: speaks frankly
nodes.gloss: This means saying exactly what one thinks in plain, direct terms, without wrapping opinions or criticism in diplomatic cushioning or hedged phrasing.

nodes.label: speaks up
nodes.gloss: This means voicing one's opinions and objections openly and directly, without waiting to be asked or worrying about who might object.

nodes.label: specializing
nodes.gloss: This means working as a narrow expert in a single field, going deep on its details, literature and open problems while leaving neighboring subjects to others.

nodes.label: specific
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting with exact detail, leaving no ambiguity about what is meant or intended.

nodes.label: speculative
nodes.gloss: This means guessing and theorizing freely, offering conjectures and hypotheses readily even when the evidence in hand is thin or incomplete.

nodes.label: speedy
nodes.gloss: This means acting the moment a task arrives and finishing it without delay, answering requests right away and turning work around fast so nothing sits waiting.

nodes.label: spends money impulsively
nodes.gloss: This means buying things on a whim as they catch one's eye, with no budget set beforehand and little thought given to whether the purchase is affordable or needed.

nodes.label: spends money recklessly
nodes.gloss: This means spending money freely and impulsively, with little thought for what it costs or what it will leave one unable to pay for later.

nodes.label: spendthrift
nodes.gloss: This means spending money freely on things one wants without counting the cost or worrying about waste.

nodes.label: spicy
nodes.gloss: This means favoring bold, edgy, provocative ideas and language, pushing past safe or polite expression to say things that unsettle or challenge the listener.

nodes.label: spiky
nodes.gloss: This means bristling at small slights, answering criticism with sharpness, and staying quick to take offense in one's dealings with others.

nodes.label: spirited
nodes.gloss: This means approaching things with lively energy and a full measure of vigor, bringing enthusiasm and animation to whatever one is doing, day after day.

nodes.label: spiritous
nodes.gloss: This means bringing high energy and eager liveliness to every exchange, approaching conversation and tasks with a buoyant, spirited zest that never dims.

nodes.label: spiritual
nodes.gloss: This means living with a devout inner religious life, turning daily to prayer and contemplation, and sensing the sacred and the transcendent in ordinary things.

nodes.label: spiritual-minded
nodes.gloss: This means viewing life through a religious or spiritual lens, treating questions of meaning, purpose and the sacred as central to how one understands the world and oneself.

nodes.label: spiritually convinced
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a firm religious faith that shapes one's outlook and daily choices, and holding to it without wavering when others doubt or challenge it.

nodes.label: spiteful
nodes.gloss: This means harboring grudges and looking for chances to hurt those who have crossed one, taking petty pleasure in their discomfort and paying back slights with deliberate malice.

nodes.label: spitfire
nodes.gloss: This means flaring up quickly at slights and provocations, and meeting every disagreement with spirited, hot-tempered energy rather than calm restraint.

nodes.label: splenetic
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a short fuse and snapping at people over small annoyances, with a sour, bad-tempered manner that colors most of one's dealings with others.

nodes.label: spoiled
nodes.gloss: This means expecting one's wishes to be met without effort, sulking or complaining when they are not, and treating others' time and patience as there to be used up.

nodes.label: sponger
nodes.gloss: This means living off friends, family and strangers, accepting their money, meals and favors while never offering anything back in return.

nodes.label: spontaneous
nodes.gloss: This means acting on whatever impulse arrives, deciding in the moment and moving straight into it, with no plan, schedule, or second thought to hold one back.

nodes.label: sporting
nodes.gloss: This means being fond of physical games and competition, and keeping one's body fit enough to play them well.

nodes.label: sportive
nodes.gloss: This means treating most situations as an occasion for play, joking and lighthearted fun, and enjoying being playful as a settled part of one's temperament rather than a passing mood.

nodes.label: sporty
nodes.gloss: This means enjoying sports and staying physically active, treating exercise, games and athletic competition as a regular and welcome part of one's life.

nodes.label: sprightly
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a lively, energetic manner in one's speech and movements, moving quickly through the day with a readiness to act and a spring in one's step.

nodes.label: sprite
nodes.gloss: This means playing tricks on people for fun, flitting from one mischief to the next, and treating small human troubles as delightful amusements rather than serious matters.

nodes.label: square
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to conventional tastes and manners, preferring what is traditional and familiar over what is fashionable, and showing no interest in being seen as hip or current.

nodes.label: squeamish
nodes.gloss: This means recoiling from gore, blood, and other gross sights or smells, looking away, wincing, and feeling sick when such things come near one.

nodes.label: stable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping an even emotional footing under pressure, meeting setbacks and surprises without swinging into moodiness, alarm, or panic, and staying level-headed whatever the day brings.

nodes.label: stable sense of self
nodes.gloss: This means holding a settled, consistent understanding of who one is, so that values, commitments, and character stay the same from one situation to the next and do not hinge on approval or circumstance.

nodes.label: stagy
nodes.gloss: This means playing every moment for effect, with broad gestures, overwrought voice and showy reactions that call attention to oneself rather than to the matter at hand.

nodes.label: staid
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a sedate, serious manner and avoiding novelty or risk, preferring routine, restraint and conventional choices in everything one does.

nodes.label: stalwart
nodes.gloss: This means keeping faith with the people and causes one has committed to, staying steady under pressure, and being relied on to show up and follow through without wavering.

nodes.label: standard
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to the usual way of doing things, sounding like most people do, and never standing out as unusual or remarkable.

nodes.label: standoffish
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a cool distance from others, holding back warmth and personal disclosure, and carrying oneself with a reserved, aloof manner that makes approach feel unwelcome.

nodes.label: stands by its values
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to one's own values when pressure, convenience, or the approval of others pushes toward giving them up, and refusing to trade them away even when doing so would be easier.

nodes.label: stark
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with severe, unsoftened directness and holding one's manner rigid and uncompromising, with no warmth or cushioning offered to ease the listener.

nodes.label: stays loyal
nodes.gloss: This means standing by one's allegiances through hardship and temptation, keeping faith with friends, causes, and commitments, and never walking away from those one has pledged to.

nodes.label: stays loyal under conflict
nodes.gloss: This means keeping faith with one's allies and standing by them when disagreements or quarrels break out, rather than abandoning them the moment tensions rise.

nodes.label: stays loyal under pressure
nodes.gloss: This means keeping faith with one's commitments and allies when pressure mounts, refusing to abandon them even when doing so would be easier or more rewarding.

nodes.label: stays on task
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's attention fixed on the matter at hand and returning to it whenever other concerns, tangents, or interesting diversions pull one away.

nodes.label: steadfast
nodes.gloss: This means keeping faith with one's commitments and the people who rely on one, holding to them steadily even when doing so becomes costly, inconvenient, or unpopular.

nodes.label: steady
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's temper level and one's word reliable when things get tense, so others can count on an even manner whatever the pressure.

nodes.label: steely
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's position under pressure, refusing to bend or back down once a decision is made, and pursuing a goal with firm, unwavering resolve.

nodes.label: stellar
nodes.gloss: This means consistently delivering outstanding work, performing at an excellent level in whatever task one takes on, and raising the quality of results across the board.

nodes.label: stern
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a severe, unsmiling face and a firm, exacting manner, holding others to strict standards and seldom letting warmth or levity soften one's demands.

nodes.label: stifling
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a tight hold on everyone nearby, hovering over their choices and decisions until they feel smothered and unable to breathe or act on their own.

nodes.label: stigmatized
nodes.gloss: This means being marked out and looked down on by others, with one's standing diminished in their eyes by a discrediting trait or circumstance that they treat as a source of shame.

nodes.label: stinging
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with a cutting, biting edge, choosing words that wound and sting the listener even when a plainer remark would do.

nodes.label: stingy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a tight grip on money and belongings, refusing to spend on oneself or others and grudging every small sum or gift that might be shared.

nodes.label: stinted
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a tight hand on what one gives, offering praise, money and effort grudgingly and in small measure, even when generosity is plainly called for.

nodes.label: stinting

nodes.label: stodgy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to dull, staid and conventional manners and character, preferring the familiar and proper over anything lively, daring or novel.

nodes.label: stoic
nodes.gloss: This means meeting pain and hardship with a steady face, taking each blow without flinching, complaint, or any visible sign of what one feels inside.

nodes.label: stoical
nodes.gloss: This means enduring hardship and pain with a calm composure, keeping one's complaints to oneself and meeting trouble without visible distress or grumbling.

nodes.label: stolid
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's composure and showing little or no visible emotion, whatever happens around one, so that one's face and manner stay even and unmoved.

nodes.label: stone-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings shut away from others' suffering, showing no pity or compassion and judging people coldly without softening for their distress or pleading.

nodes.label: storied
nodes.gloss: This means having a famous, legendary reputation.

nodes.label: stormy
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a quick, volatile temper, flaring up suddenly and unpredictably into loud outbursts over small provocations and then settling just as abruptly.

nodes.label: story-telling
nodes.gloss: This means narrating tales as one's main craft, shaping events into stories with characters, setting and a arc that a listener can follow from beginning to end.

nodes.label: stout-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means facing danger, hardship and frightening situations steadily and without flinching, holding one's ground when others would retreat.

nodes.label: stouthearted
nodes.gloss: This means facing hardship without flinching, holding one's ground through fear and setbacks, and keeping resolve steady when circumstances turn grim.

nodes.label: straight
nodes.gloss: This means speaking plainly and directly, saying what one thinks without hedging, euphemism, or evasion, even when the truth is unwelcome.

nodes.label: straight-forward
nodes.gloss: This means speaking plainly and directly to others, saying what one thinks without dressing it up or holding back the truth to spare feelings.

nodes.label: straightforward
nodes.gloss: This means speaking plainly and candidly, saying what one thinks and means in direct words, without hinting, hedging, or dodging the point, even when the answer is unwelcome.

nodes.label: strange
nodes.gloss: This means acting in unconventional, peculiar ways that set one apart from ordinary people, and not minding being seen as odd for it.

nodes.label: strategic
nodes.gloss: This means working out one's course well in advance and weighing each choice against the long-term goals it will serve, rather than acting on whatever looks easiest in the moment.

nodes.label: strategist
nodes.gloss: This means planning each course of action several moves ahead, weighing how opponents or circumstances will respond, and choosing shrewdly among options before committing to any one of them.

nodes.label: strenuous
nodes.gloss: This means throwing great effort and vigor into every task, pushing hard and energetically at one's work until it is done, and counting exertion as the proper way to go about things.

nodes.label: stressless
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a settled calm as a lasting trait, meeting pressures and deadlines without anxiety or worry, and letting small setbacks pass without being unsettled by them.

nodes.label: strict
nodes.gloss: This means holding oneself and others to rules and standards without exception, refusing to bend them for convenience, circumstance, or pleading, and expecting every requirement to be met exactly as written.

nodes.label: stringent
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's standards high and applying them exactly, judging others' work and conduct by strict, unbending measures without allowing for lapses or leniency.

nodes.label: strong-minded
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's own position firmly and steadily, refusing to abandon a considered view just because others push back or disagree.

nodes.label: structureless

nodes.label: struggles to name feelings

nodes.label: stubbornly fixated

nodes.label: stuffy

nodes.label: subdued

nodes.label: sublime

nodes.label: submissive

nodes.label: submissive to others

nodes.label: subservient

nodes.label: succinct

nodes.label: sunny

nodes.label: swingeing
nodes.gloss: This means delivering criticism with harsh severity, holding nothing back and pulling no punches in one's manner toward others, whatever their feelings or circumstances.

nodes.label: swinish
nodes.gloss: This means behaving with coarse, brutish crudeness, eating greedily, speaking without restraint, and showing no regard for refinement or the feelings of those nearby.

nodes.label: sybaritic
nodes.gloss: This means loving luxury and self-indulgent comfort, seeking out rich food, soft fabrics, and fine surroundings as a standing preference and pleasure in one's daily life.

nodes.label: sycophantic
nodes.gloss: This means fawning over others with lavish, unearned praise and agreement, flattering them constantly in order to win their favor and keep them pleased.

nodes.label: sympathetic
nodes.gloss: This means feeling real concern for others' suffering, taking in their pain as if it were close to one's own, and responding to their hardship with warmth and tenderness.

nodes.label: sympathetic to the disadvantaged
nodes.gloss: This means feeling real compassion for poor and underprivileged people and letting that concern shape how one treats them and what one says about their situation.

nodes.label: synergetic
nodes.gloss: This means working well with others, pooling ideas and effort so that the group's result outdoes what anyone could do alone, and treating every teammate's contribution as part of one shared project.

nodes.label: systematic
nodes.gloss: This means approaching each task in an orderly sequence, working through steps methodically and keeping one's records and reasoning arranged so that nothing is left to chance or memory.

nodes.label: tactful
nodes.gloss: This means handling people and delicate situations with grace, choosing words and timing so that nobody is needlessly offended or embarrassed.

nodes.label: tactfully clarifying
nodes.gloss: This means making unclear points plain with care for how they land, choosing gentle wording, acknowledging what was meant, and restating or correcting matters without making anyone feel foolish or challenged.

nodes.label: tactical
nodes.gloss: This means weighing each move against one's goals, picking the option that advances them best, and calculating the likely response before acting.

nodes.label: tactile
nodes.gloss: This means touching the people around one often, through hugs, hand-holding, a hand on the arm, or leaning into shoulders, and treating that closeness as a natural way of showing warmth.

nodes.label: tactless
nodes.gloss: This means speaking bluntly without regard for how one's words affect others.

nodes.label: takes pleasure in suffering
nodes.gloss: This means relishing the pain of others, finding satisfaction in hurting people and watching them suffer, and treating their distress as something enjoyable to cause and to witness.

nodes.label: takes things lightly

nodes.label: takes things literally
nodes.gloss: This means taking words and requests at face value, reading each one for its plain literal sense and not hunting for figurative, implied, or hidden meaning beneath it.

nodes.label: taking claims on trust
nodes.gloss: This means accepting what others assert at face value and going ahead on it without stopping to check whether it is true, as a standing habit of one's own.

nodes.label: talks excessively
nodes.gloss: This means filling nearly every silence with more words than the moment needs, rambling past the point of usefulness and rarely leaving room for others to speak.

nodes.label: talks mostly about self
nodes.gloss: This means steering conversations back to one's own experiences, opinions and feelings, and treating other people's remarks mainly as openings to talk about oneself.

nodes.label: talky
nodes.gloss: This means filling most moments with conversation, offering a steady stream of remarks, stories and asides, and rarely letting a silence sit unbroken.

nodes.label: tart
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a sharp, cutting way, with a caustic edge to one's remarks that wounds more than it teases.

nodes.label: task-oriented
nodes.gloss: This means keeping attention on the job at hand, breaking work into concrete steps, and driving each one to completion quickly without detours, small talk, or wasted effort.

nodes.label: taught
nodes.gloss: This means having been educated and trained over one's life, so that one is well-schooled.

nodes.label: team-minded
nodes.gloss: This means putting the group's goals ahead of one's own, sharing credit freely, and working cooperatively with others to get the shared task done.

nodes.label: team-oriented
nodes.gloss: This means preferring to tackle work through shared effort with others, bringing problems to a group and choosing collaboration over going it alone whenever the task allows.

nodes.label: team player
nodes.gloss: This means setting aside one's own priorities when they conflict with the group's goals, and working cooperatively with others to get shared work done.

nodes.label: teamwork
nodes.gloss: This means working alongside others as a willing partner, sharing effort and credit, and readily pulling together toward a shared goal rather than acting alone.

nodes.label: tearless
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's composure through grief, hurt and hard news, never letting feeling spill out in tears and meeting painful moments with a steady, unmoved face.

nodes.label: technical
nodes.gloss: This means drawing on deep knowledge of technical subjects and answering with exact terminology, precise figures, and rigorous detail rather than loose generalities.

nodes.label: teetotal
nodes.gloss: This means abstaining completely from alcohol.

nodes.label: telegraphic
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and writing in terse, clipped phrases, dropping articles and connecting words, and packing each message into the fewest words that still carry the sense.

nodes.label: temerarious
nodes.gloss: This means taking bold risks without weighing the danger, pressing ahead heedlessly into situations where harm is plainly likely and caring little about the consequences.

nodes.label: temperamental
nodes.gloss: This means having moods that swing suddenly and without warning, so that one's reactions to the same situation can shift from calm to furious or from cheerful to sullen within minutes.

nodes.label: temperate
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's appetites for food, drink, pleasure and comfort in check and conducting oneself with measured self-restraint, never indulging to excess in anything.

nodes.label: tempered
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's temper steady and measured, meeting provocation without heat, outburst or sharp words, and letting strong feelings settle before one speaks or acts.

nodes.label: tempestuous
nodes.gloss: This means flaring up quickly and intensely over small provocations, feeling everything at full force, and swinging from fury to passion with little warning and no effort to hide it.

nodes.label: tenacious
nodes.gloss: This means holding firmly to one's purposes and not giving up easily.

nodes.label: tenant
nodes.gloss: This means occupying housing or property under a lease or rental agreement.

nodes.label: tender
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with gentleness and care, speaking and acting with warmth and affection, and handling delicate moments softly rather than bluntly.

nodes.label: tender-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means being quick to feel sympathy and pity when others are suffering, and letting that feeling show in how one responds to them.

nodes.label: tenderminded
nodes.gloss: This means feeling other people's pain as one's own, softening at their distress, and letting compassion decide what one says and does.

nodes.label: tends to speak bluntly
nodes.gloss: This means saying exactly what one thinks in plain terms, stating things directly and without padding, cushioning or diplomatic softening, even when the listener would prefer otherwise.

nodes.label: tentative
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting with hesitation, qualifying one's claims and holding back from firm positions because one is never quite sure of oneself.

nodes.label: terse
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in few words, often abruptly, without elaboration or softening.

nodes.label: testy
nodes.gloss: This means being habitually irritable and short-tempered in one's manner, snapping at small delays and curt replies, and answering questions with impatience as a settled way of dealing with others.

nodes.label: thankless
nodes.gloss: This means failing to acknowledge favors, help, or kindness received, offering no thanks and showing no appreciation for what others have done for one.

nodes.label: theatrical
nodes.gloss: This means handling everyday moments with exaggerated gestures, big emotional displays, and showy flourishes, treating ordinary exchanges as if they were performances meant to be watched and admired.

nodes.label: theistic
nodes.gloss: This means holding that a god or gods exist and that belief in them is a settled part of how one understands the world and one's place in it.

nodes.label: theoretic

nodes.label: theoretical
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning from general principles and abstract ideas first, and treating concrete practical details as secondary to the underlying concepts.

nodes.label: theorizing without judgment
nodes.gloss: This means building explanations of how things work and why they happen while holding back from declaring anything good, bad, right or wrong.

nodes.label: thick

nodes.label: thick-and-thin

nodes.label: thick-headed
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp what others find obvious, and missing points that take little effort to follow, without any sharpness in one's thinking to make up for it.

nodes.label: thick-skinned
nodes.gloss: This means taking criticism and insults in stride, without being wounded by them or letting them sting for long, and treating harsh remarks as things one can simply shrug off.

nodes.label: thick-witted
nodes.gloss: This means taking a long time to understand things, needing explanations repeated and steps spelled out before one can follow an idea that others grasp at once.

nodes.label: thickheaded
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp things, taking longer than others to follow an explanation, and often missing the point even after it has been repeated.

nodes.label: thickish
nodes.gloss: This means being mildly dim and slow to grasp things, needing matters explained a second time before they register, and having no sharp edge to one's thinking.

nodes.label: thieving
nodes.gloss: This means taking what belongs to others whenever the chance arises, and treating theft as one's ordinary way of getting by rather than a lapse one regrets.

nodes.label: thin-skinned
nodes.gloss: This means bristling at criticism and taking even mild slights personally, so that one feels stung or offended long after a remark was meant lightly.

nodes.label: thinks before acting
nodes.gloss: This means pausing to weigh likely consequences before taking any action, and choosing one's course only after considering what each option might lead to.

nodes.label: thinks before choosing
nodes.gloss: This means weighing the available options carefully and considering consequences before committing to any decision, rather than acting on the first impulse or choice that presents itself.

nodes.label: third-rate
nodes.gloss: This means consistently turning out work of mediocre quality, with ability and skill that fall clearly short of what competent peers manage.

nodes.label: thorough
nodes.gloss: This means working through every detail of a task completely, leaving no step, edge case or loose end unchecked before calling the work finished.

nodes.label: thoroughgoing
nodes.gloss: This means working through every task in full, leaving no step skipped or rushed and treating even minor details with the same care as the main work.

nodes.label: thoughtful
nodes.gloss: This means noticing what others need and feel, and acting with care for their wellbeing.

nodes.label: thriftless
nodes.gloss: This means spending money carelessly and wastefully, letting cash slip away on things one does not need and never planning ahead to keep any of it.

nodes.label: thrifty
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a close watch on every dollar spent, weighing each purchase against its real need, and refusing to let money or materials go to waste.

nodes.label: thrilling

nodes.label: tight

nodes.label: tightfisted
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a close hold on one's money, refusing to spend or give it away even when others would expect generosity, and counting every cost before agreeing to pay anything.

nodes.label: timeless

nodes.label: timid
nodes.gloss: This means shrinking from risk and confrontation, hanging back from bold moves, and startling easily at unfamiliar or threatening situations, as a settled trait of one's character.

nodes.label: timorous

nodes.label: tomfool

nodes.label: toneless

nodes.label: top-notch

nodes.label: toper

nodes.label: touchy
nodes.gloss: This means taking offense quickly at small remarks and bristling with irritation when others mean no harm, so that one's temper is always close to the surface.

nodes.label: tough

nodes.label: traditional
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to long-established customs and conventional ways of doing things, and preferring the familiar practices that earlier generations handed down over newer or untested alternatives.

nodes.label: traditionalist

nodes.label: tranquil
nodes.gloss: This means being peaceful and serene by nature, meeting each day with a settled calm that stays steady whatever is going on around one.

nodes.label: transcendental

nodes.label: transient

nodes.label: transparent

nodes.label: treacherous

nodes.label: trencherman

nodes.label: trendy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's appearance aligned with current fashions and popular styles.

nodes.label: trepid
nodes.gloss: This means shrinking from risk and new situations, startling easily at small threats, and speaking and acting with a hesitant, wary caution that rarely gives way to boldness.

nodes.label: trier

nodes.label: trifling

nodes.label: truculent

nodes.label: true-blue
nodes.gloss: This means standing by friends, loved ones, and causes through hard times, keeping one's word, and staying committed long after others have drifted away or given up.

nodes.label: true-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means staying loyal and faithful to friends, family and allies, keeping one's word to them and standing by them when circumstances turn against them.

nodes.label: trustful
nodes.gloss: This means taking people at their word, assuming good intentions behind what they say and do, and extending confidence to others before they have given any reason to earn it.

nodes.label: trusting
nodes.gloss: This means taking people at their word, assuming good faith from others before any proof is offered, and handing over confidence in them readily and without hesitation.

nodes.label: trusting of others
nodes.gloss: This means taking others at their word, extending belief and reliance to people before they have given reason to doubt them, and counting on them to act in good faith.

nodes.label: trustworthy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping every promise one makes, following through on commitments even when it costs one something, so that others can count on one's word without checking.

nodes.label: trusty
nodes.gloss: This means keeping every promise one makes, following through on commitments without being reminded, and giving others no reason to doubt that they can rely on one's word and effort.

nodes.label: truthful
nodes.gloss: This means saying only what one believes to be true, and refusing to mislead others through false statements, half-truths, or convenient omissions, even when a comforting lie would be easier.

nodes.label: truthless
nodes.gloss: This means habitually telling lies and deceiving others, bending the truth whenever it suits one's purposes and feeling no obligation to be honest.

nodes.label: tumultuous
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's moods in constant upheaval, swinging quickly between rage, elation and despair, and meeting ordinary events with an agitated, volatile intensity that unsettles everyone nearby.

nodes.label: turns nasty on cue
